briefs.name: 人工智慧運算架構與系統一
briefs.tags: computer architecture, high performance computing, AI accelerator, CPU design, Artificial Intelligence
briefs.desc: High-Performance Computing (HPC) 產業因為半導體產業的相關先進技術進步，所設計的晶片越來越複雜，對於一個想跨入這個產 業的學習 者，會面臨很多的困難，台灣由於半導體產業蓬勃發展，在晶片設計的後段設計生產製造方面，多年來培育了非常多不同領域的人才，但是 在前 段晶片設計與軟硬體系統整合發展上，一直比較受限，台灣產業的屬性與學校教育的環境在HPC這個領域並未開展開來，而HPC 晶片的開發 因為 複雜度相對於Edge Computing 晶片的複雜度高，需要很多新的設計概念與方法，以及具備更多垂直整合系統設計的要求，為了因應在人 才培育 上，HPC 的發展需要新的課程與方法，ACAL 準備了一系列的課程，希望能協助想進入HPC 前段設計的學習者，了解這個領域的基本技能 需求， 並建立一個共學的環境，讓對這個領域有熱情的同好，能有一個共同學習與做研究的平台。 這門課每個階段的教學會有一個主題，可能是該主題的入門概論，可能是理論基礎課程，也可能是從實作面出發的主題討論課程，在期末專 題提 案之前，每一個探討的主題，都是為了協助同學了解人工智慧晶片設計的流程與基礎。

briefs.name: 人工智慧運算架構與系統二
briefs.tags: computer architecture, high performance computing, AI accelerator, CPU design, Artificial Intelligence
briefs.desc: High-Performance Computing (HPC) 產業因為半導體產業的相關先進技術進步，所設計的晶片越來越複雜，對於一個想跨入這個產 業的學習 者，會面臨很多的困難，台灣由於半導體產業蓬勃發展，在晶片設計的後段設計生產製造方面，多年來培育了非常多不同領域的人才，但是 在前 段晶片設計與軟硬體系統整合發展上，一直比較受限，台灣產業的屬性與學校教育的環境在HPC這個領域並未開展開來，而HPC 晶片的開發 因為 複雜度相對於Edge Computing 晶片的複雜度高，需要很多新的設計概念與方法，以及具備更多垂直整合系統設計的要求，為了因應在人 才培育 上，HPC 的發展需要新的課程與方法，ACAL 準備了一系列的課程，希望能協助想進入HPC 前段設計的學習者，了解這個領域的基本技能 需求， 並建立一個共學的環境，讓對這個領域有熱情的同好，能有一個共同學習與做研究的平台。 這門課每個階段的教學會有一個主題，可能是該主題的入門概論，可能是理論基礎課程，也可能是從實作面出發的主題討論課程，在期末專 題提 案之前，每一個探討的主題，都是為了協助同學了解人工智慧晶片設計的流程與基礎。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 經濟學, 個體經濟, 國際貿易, 比較利益, 市場均衡
briefs.desc: 本門課程簡介經濟學的基本原理。經濟學不是一門教人自私的社會科學，而是研究個人、廠商和組織如何做選擇的社會科學。 本課程主要介紹理性消費者和廠商決策的最適化，以及市場如何運作和達成均衡的原理。本課程也將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的訂價和合作競爭等決策行為。最後，本課程將分析政府在經濟社會運作中可以和應該扮演的角色（或者不扮演）。鑑於近年來各國對公平、正義的呼聲日益高漲，本課程也將針對部分大眾對於經濟學的迷思進行答辯和剖析。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Microeconomics, Market, Demand and Supply, Consumer Choices, Producer Theory
briefs.desc: This course offers an introduction to microeconomic theories and applications. We will discuss the basic economic concepts and theories concerning market functions and the choices of individual decision makers, including people and firms. This course is offered in English. After successful completion of this course, students will be able to (1) define and discuss the key economic concepts including the basic principles of rational choices, (2) identify and analyze the fundamental microeconomic issues using verbal, graphical and simple mathematical techniques, and (3) apply economic thinking to daily decisions and events.

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 市場均衡，資源配置，消費理論，生產理論，政府角色
briefs.desc: 經濟學是研究理性個人如何做選擇的社會科學。本課程主要介紹消費者與廠商如何做決策。在消費者理論方面，本課程將探討影 響消費者購買行為之因素與其決策準則。在生產者理論方面，將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的生產與定價決策行為。此外，也 將分析政府在經濟社會所扮演之角色。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: demand and supply , market failure, pricing, efficiency
briefs.desc: 此科目欲培養之核心能力為: 具備基本經濟學知識，瞭解經濟學範疇，與運用經濟思維解釋經濟議題。 授課以教師講解為主, 歡迎同學隨時發問並提出意見。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Economic model, Demand and Supply, elasticity, cost function, monopoly, oligopoly, game theory, price discrimination; 經濟模型, 需求與供給, 彈性, 成本函數, 獨佔, 寡占, 賽局理論, 差別取價
briefs.desc: 本課程為經濟學原理的第一部分，主要介紹個體經濟學的基礎知識與應用。在這門課程中，我們將會介紹一些最核心 的經濟概念，並介紹經濟學中最重要的模型-需求與供給模型。另外，我們將介紹經濟體中不同參與者，如消費者、生產者、 與政府的各項決定之形成與背後的原因。最後，一些個體經濟學的應用例子，如外部性，賽局理論，公共財等問題也會被討論。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: 供給與需求, 市場均衡, 消費者行為, 生產者行為, 產業組織, demand and supply, market equilibrium, consumer behavior, producer behavior, industrial organization
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在介紹經濟學的基本分析工具與核心議題。內容以市場機制之運作為主軸， 包括經濟學的基本概念，如機會成本、比較利益、專業分工，以及個體經濟學的議題，如 供給與需求、市場均衡、消費者行為、生產者行為、和產業組織等。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理一
briefs.tags: Microeconomics
briefs.desc: Basic Microeconomics

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: 會計學(Accounting), 財務會計(Financial Accounting), 國際會計準則(IFRSs), 美國會計準則(US GAAP)
briefs.desc: The role of accounting is to provide information to investors, policy-makers, regulators, and other decision-makers to facilitate the allocation of resources in society. The purpose of this course is to understand the accounting process and to develop skills necessary to evaluate an enterprise’s financial position and its operating, investing and financing activities.

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: 財務報表, 財務分析, 舞弊, 投資, IFRS
briefs.desc: This course aims to make students familiar financial reporting procedures and assist them in reading financial statements.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: Demand, Supply, Consumer welfare, Cost, Competitive Market
briefs.desc: This course is an advanced undergraduate course that teaches the fundamentals of microeconomics. The course begins with an overview of how a market economy works, introducing demand and supply analysis and elasticity concepts. Next, we study the decision-making process by consumers and producers. The last part of the course introduces different market structures, focusing on perfect competition.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: 效用最大化,消費者理論,市場失靈,政府干預,外部性,利潤最大化,生產者理論; utility maximization, consumer theory, market failure, government intervention, externality, profit maximization, producer theory
briefs.desc: This course is offered in English and is the first part of an one-year course of Microeconomics which is a requirement for Economics program. Knowledge of calculus will be expected as it is used frequently for solving problems. The course starts with the introduction of supply and demand, and it studies how a consumer makes choices about which good to consume. After understanding consumer theory, the demand curve and its properties can then be analyzed in a more rigorous manner. Moreover, we will discuss how to measure the consumer welfare and provide policy implications. In the second half of the course, we study how firms make choices on how much to produce for both short and long-run analysis. Similar to the consumer's problem of maximizing utility, firms minimize their costs, and the properties of the cost function will be studied. We then introduce the most important mode of market structure, namely the perfect competition and discuss how firms

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: consumer choice, production, competitive market, general equilibrium, Pareto efficiency, 消費者選擇, 廠商生產, 競爭市場, 一般均衡, 柏拉圖效率
briefs.desc: This course is the first part of Microeconomics. This course intends to apply more advanced tools, including algebra and calculus, to analyze various microeconomic issues. In this semester, we will mainly study consumers’ constrained choice, demand and welfare. We will also examine firms, their production and costs, and the market supply. Given both the market demand and supply, we can then discuss the competitive market equilibrium and evaluate the property and the social welfare in the competitive equilibrium.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學一
briefs.tags: demand; supply; utility maximization; consumption; price
briefs.desc: Economics is the study of human behavior. To understand how people can cooperate in social orders, and why they often cannot, we need to have a framework for understanding human action and its consequences. Economics provides one such framework. Microeconomics has been applied to issues ranging from those expected in economics, such as what determines the price of consumer goods, to such things as how people vote, how much education they acquire, and how many children they have. This course offers an introduction to the theory and methods of microeconomics. In the first semester, we will cover topics include the simple demand and supply framework, consumer choice and demand under constrained maximization; price and output determination of the firm, and the perfect competition model.

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學一
briefs.tags: 貨幣, 金融體系, 金融工具, 金融市場, 金融機構, 金融中介, 商業銀行
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹現代自由市場經濟體系下，與交易及資金供需間流通相關的貨幣與金融重要觀念如下： (1) 貨幣的定義與功能 (2) 金融體系 (3) 金融市場與金融工具 (4) 金融機構與金融中介理論

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學一
briefs.tags: financial system, monetary policy, interest rate, money, inflation
briefs.desc: 本課程分析貨幣、銀行體系、與金融市場對現代經濟活動的影響以及其交互作用。課程內容以指定用 書為主並輔以其他補充教材。

briefs.name: 統計學一
briefs.tags: 統計, 機率, 資料分析, statistics, probability, data analysis
briefs.desc: This course is the first part of a two-semester sequence. The purpose of Statistics I is building the mathematical foundation for understanding statistical concepts and methods. We will focus on topics including data, probability distributions, sampling, estimation, and conclude with hypothesis testing. We will also start familiarizing ourselves with basic programming as we use visualization and simulations to introduce statistical concepts.

briefs.name: 統計學一
briefs.tags: 統計、機率、機率與統計、統計學、計量
briefs.desc: 本課程為統計學的入門課程，適合商學院學生修習，旨在建立學生分析資料與解讀數據的基礎能力。內容涵蓋統計的核心理論與 基本應用方法，從資料的整理與視覺化、敘述統計（如集中趨勢與離散程度指標），到機率理論、常見機率分配（如二項分配與 常態分配）、抽樣理論、信賴區間估計與假設檢定等。本課程重視資料素養的培養，並會在課程中透過軟體進行實作，使學生能 從資料中萃取關鍵資訊，做出有根據的統計推論與判斷。課程結合理論、操作與應用，為學生未來深入學習計量經濟學、商業資 料分析或從事實證研究提供必要的理論基礎與分析能力。

briefs.name: 成本與管理會計一
briefs.tags: 成本，成本管理，成本會計，管理會計，平衡計分卡，作業基礎成本制，獲利能力分析，組織績效衡量
briefs.desc: 「成本」經常是管理者做決斷時所需要的關鍵性資訊，本課程主要的目的，在循序漸進地介紹與討論各類成本計算的方法 與成本管理的理論，引導學生瞭解處於動態環境下的組織，如何運用成本會計的技術進行規劃、控制及做決策。

briefs.name: 成本與管理會計一
briefs.tags: Managerial Accounting, Planning, Performance Evaluation, Pricing, Cost Accounting
briefs.desc: The goal of cost and managerial accounting is to acquaint students of management with the fundamental tools of management accounting, but also to promote their understanding of the dramatic ways in which the field is changing. The emphasis throughout the course is on using accounting information in managing an organization. In this course, the traditional tools of managerial accounting, like product costing, budgeting, and performance evaluation, will be augmented and updated with contemporary approaches such as activity-based costing, customer profitability analysis, value-chain analysis, target costing, balanced scorecard, and strategic cost management.

briefs.name: 財務報導與實務
briefs.tags: Financial Reporting,Financial Accounting, business Analysis, Enterprise Valuation, Earning Forecast
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide a strong conceptual, analytical and procedural foundation for the study of financial reporting and practice. The historical development of accounting thought and the role of financial accounting in today’s economy are investigated. Socioeconomic, political, legal, and ethical influences on financial reporting are considered. Discussions include procedures to record, summarize, and report results of business events; content and presentation of financial statements and specific reporting issues related to cash and receivable. An overview of financial statement analysis is also presented. International issues are addressed as appropriate.

briefs.name: 計量經濟學一
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics 統計、計量
briefs.desc: There are two sequences for undergraduate econometrics. This course is the first part of the introduction to econometrics sequence. We will review probability and statistics at the first beginning and then introduce the basic idea of regression models. You are expected to have a firm grasp of the types of empirical research designs that can lead to convincing analysis and be comfortable working with actual data sets. Although the aim will remain on the underlying theory, students will be given several opportunities to gain "hand on" experience with real data set through homework assignments. I would encourage students to make use of my office hours (or TA's office hours) during the semester and not wait until the day before the exam. If you are having difficulty with concepts early on, then it is likely that your difficulties will snowball and that there will be insufficient time to deal with your puzzles close to the exams. So please make use

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: macroeconomics
briefs.desc: 本課程為教授基礎總體經濟理論的要旨與其內涵。其重心與目的有三。第一、介紹總體經濟理論對於總合變數與宏觀現 象的解釋，預測與分析。第二為注重經濟模型的介紹，簡言之是以模型為分析工具，使學生熟捻對模型的設定，操作與 對其之詮釋。第三點注重在當代總體經濟理論的演化與其歷史背景。

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Intermediate Macroeconomics Theory, Economics, 總體，總體經濟
briefs.desc: Students understand the systematic study of human behavior and cognition; the structure of human societies, cultures, and institutions; and the processes by which individuals, groups, and societies interact, communicate, and use human, natural, and economic resources.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學一
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Growth, 總體, 經濟, 成長
briefs.desc: In this course, we will cover theories and empirical findings about macroeconomics. The topics include consumption, saving and investment, economic growth, and business cycles. This is the first part of the Macroeconomic sequence.

briefs.name: 期貨市場
briefs.tags: 期貨 (Futures),期貨市場(Futures Market),選擇權(Options),衍生性商品(Derivative Products ), 衍生性商品市場(Derivative Products Market)
briefs.desc: 介紹期貨市場之運作方式及各期貨交易所之 商品內容 , 除深入淺出說明期貨與選擇權 的理論定價模式外, 將充分探討實 務上的策略應用。整個課程設計兼顧理論與 實務，搭配介紹其他衍生性金融商品之操 作，期使同學們能完全領會期貨市 場的奧妙與威力! The operation mechanism of futures market and the products in major Futures Exchanges will be introduced in this course. By taking the course, students will learn the futures trading both from pricing theory and practical transactions. Additional material about other derivative products is also provided to let students understand the most delicate knowledge in futures market.

briefs.name: 全球化經濟一
briefs.tags: 全球化，世界經濟，跨國企業，國外直接投資，外包。Globalization, World Economy, Multinational Firms, Foreign Direct Investment, Outsourcing
briefs.desc: The growing economic openness expressed in the globalization of independent economic systems has created problems as well as opportunities in new and unexpected ways. In particular, globalization has allowed many counties to emerge from underdevelopment, as well as increase world production and employment. Outward-oriented policies brought greater prosperity to much of East Asia, transforming it from one of the poorest regions of the world about sixty years ago. Multinational firms have been the driving force behind these transformations, favoring the international division of productive processes and the spread of technologies and know-how. This course focuses on the aspects of economic globalization, such as the role of multinational firms as major participants of the globalizing world, global trade, and foreign direct investment, by providing an analytical framework for students to understand decisions of multinational firms.

briefs.name: 財政學一
briefs.tags: Public Finance, Public Economics, Public Policy, Public Sector, Government Expenditure
briefs.desc: This is the first course in the two-semester undergraduate sequence of Public Finance. Public Finance is the branch of economics that studies the role of the public sector in the economy, and the approach is primarily based on microeconomics. In this semester, we will have a focus on the expenditure side of public finance. The course will begin with an introduction to the public sector and basic economic tools, followed by the economic reasons and outcomes of government interventions. We will then look at what the public sector actually does using examples from the expenditure policies in the United States and in Taiwan, and how it affects individual decision-making and welfare. This course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 中級會計三
briefs.tags: Intermediate Accounting ,Applications, Financial Analysis, Annual Report
briefs.desc: This course is a continuation of Intermediate Accounting, designed to enhance both theoretical understanding and practical application of accounting concepts. In addition to fulfilling the requirements of accounting certification exams, the course emphasizes real-world financial analysis, corporate reporting, and applied accounting practices through group projects and case studies.

briefs.name: 中國大陸財政與經濟發展
briefs.nameEn: China’s Public Finance and Economic Development
briefs.tags: China, fiscal incentives, fiscal institutions, political institutions, economic development
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide a foundational understanding of China’s public finance and analyze China’s economic development within the framework of political and fiscal institutions. It will commence with an overview of China’s fiscal reforms, tracing their evolution to the present state and exploring their implications. The core of the course will focus on the dynamics of China’s political and fiscal institutions. Additionally, the course will address various contemporary issues concerning China’s public finance, including expenditure allocation (e.g., education, healthcare, and pension systems), intergovernmental fiscal relations, budget cycle, government debt, and land finance. Lastly, we will deliberate on the prospective trajectory of China’s economic development.

briefs.name: 審計學一
briefs.tags: 審計, 查核, 內部控制, 舞弊, audit
briefs.desc: 說明審計理論及查核實務，主要以講義授課彙整重點，輔以補充審計公報內容補充。

briefs.name: 歐洲經濟史：貨幣與金融
briefs.nameEn: The Economic History of Europe: Money and Finance
briefs.tags: Money, banking, gold standard
briefs.desc: This course is an analytical survey of European historical economic development, in the perspective of finance, from 1250 to 1914. The following ten topics are covered in the course. By examining these issues, this course explores financial developments from the late medieval period century to the WWI.

briefs.name: 數理經濟學一
briefs.tags: 微積分, 線性代數, 靜態最適化, 基礎微分方程, 差分方程, calculus, linear algebra, static optimization, differential equations, difference equations
briefs.desc: 數理經濟學是一門經濟學的分支，其目的在為經濟分析提供嚴謹的架 構，尤其當經濟理論過於複雜而超過口語或圖形的表達範圍時，數理經濟學提供分析 的工具。除了在經濟理論的發展中發揮了關鍵的作用，數理經濟學也普遍應用於經濟 學的各個領域，提供數學工具對經濟現象進行建模及分析，進而發展出明確且可檢驗 的理論假說。

briefs.name: 個體經濟專題一
briefs.tags: 賽局理論 (Game Theory)，不對稱訊息理論 (Information Asymmetry)，外部性與公共財 (Externalities and Public Good)，非合作賽局 (Noncooperative Game)，內許均衡 (Nash equilibrium)，市場失靈 (Market Failure)
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹1960年代後受經濟學界重視的重要課題及應用，包括：賽局理論 (Game Theory)，不對稱訊息理論 (Information Asymmetry)，外 部性與公共財 (Externalities and Public Good)。後兩者為造成市場失靈的重要原因，為近代經濟學家重視的重要課題。賽局理論中我們將著重 探討非合作賽局，以 Nash 均衡為基本架構，進一步介紹 Nash 均衡的精煉 (refinement) 及混合策略的均衡。

briefs.name: 專題：總體經濟
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學, 實證, 理論, Macroeconomics, Empiric, Theory
briefs.desc: In this course, we will discuss several recent Macroeconomic issues and learn how to apply what you learned in Intermediate Macroeconomics to tackle real world Macroeconomic issues, e.g., wage stagnation, growth, inflation, among others. Accordingly, we will have lectures quickly reviewing Macroeconomic concepts and demonstrating presentation skills. Then, presentations and a term paper are required for each student to demonstrate their ability in critical thinking about current Macroeconomic issues as well as in providing clear and well-organized presentations.

briefs.name: 國際經濟學一
briefs.tags: 國際貿易、貿易政策, international trade, trade policy
briefs.desc: 在全球化的潮流下，近30年來世界各國紛紛降低貿易障礙，加速商品貿易的流量。此外，國際間生產分工的方式，已從過去 產品之間的分工，逐漸轉為生產同一種商品在不同製程上的分工。在貿易自由化與國際分工的趨勢下，加速商品、人才與資 金的跨國移動，提升國家與國家間生產活動的關聯性。透過國際貿易，各國可專注於本國較具生產優勢的商品，在國際市場 換取本國生產成本較高的商品，進而提升本國的生產效率與福利。雖然自由貿易可提升一國福利，但同時也可能對一國所得 分配造成不均度惡化。因此，各國政府在制定貿易相關政策時多受到許多爭議。 本課程主要介紹當前國際貿易理論模型，分析國家間為何會進行貿易，以及自由貿易與貿易政策(如:關稅)下對一國福利的影 響，期望學生未來能對國貿相關議題有初步認識及相關分析能力。

briefs.name: 專業經理人職能培養
briefs.tags: Resume and interview techniques, written skills, career advancement, personal promotion, effective presentation, teamwork, leadership 簡歷和面試技巧、商業溝通寫作、職業發展、個人行銷、有效的簡報、團隊合作、領導力
briefs.desc: The ability to advance in the corporate world depends not only on the professional discipline for which a person is hired but also on softer skills seldom taught in schools. The course covers the concepts and skills needed to promote or market oneself within an organization, such as motivation, relationship building, effective self-presentation, teamwork, and leadership. Finally, the course will provide students with a series of discussions and role plays that will increase the students’ sensitivity to group behavior, awareness, and skill in dealing with group dynamics.

briefs.name: 跨文化創造力與創業家精神
briefs.tags: Entrepreneurship,Cross-Cultural Creativity,Creative Industries, Social Business,跨文化創造力,創業家精神,社會企業, 創意產業
briefs.desc: This course is specifically designed for our Taiwanese and International students who have the heart of passion and willingness to become great leaders after graduation for their future career. Through dynamic brain-power training, knowledge learning and intelligence advancement, case study and international simulations, we will activate the creative genes in each one of our students. We will build their creative thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem solving abilities. In the spirit of inspirational leadership, we will develop their creative marketing, managerial and organizational skills in the process of entrepreneurial case study and simulations. Students will be able to draw upon their cross-cultural understanding and practice how to apply what they have learnt in our business schools. The main topics to be covered include cross-cultural business etiquettes, creative designing, innovative marketing, cross-cultural communication, analytical planning, creative te

briefs.name: 經濟計量方法一
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics, policy evaluation 統計、計量、政策評估
briefs.desc: This course is designed for Örst-year Economics graduate students. The basic methods, modern econometric methods and theory are covered. The intention is that the material will provide a foundation for applied research in economics. It will provide an initial opportunity for you to develop the skills to conduct and understand empirical work. The coursework will be theoretical in nature, but students will also be required to use the methods to estimate certain models and test certain hypotheses.

briefs.name: 數據分析與機器學習
briefs.tags: Bayesian, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Python Programming, Regression, 貝氏, 機器學習, 數據分析, 程式設計, 迴歸
briefs.desc: This course surveys basic concepts and technical tools required for proceeding the Bayesian data analysis. The goal of this course targets to equip students with the understandings of how to interpret and what are the limits of common data analytical results. In addition to introducing theoretically analytical models, proper programming skills are covered in this course.

briefs.name: 機器學習與經濟計量
briefs.tags: Feedforward neural network; recurrent neural network (RNN); long short-term memory network (LSTM); convolutional neural network (CNN); “You only look once” (YOLO)
briefs.desc: While academically rigorous theorems are much appreciated, they are not the focus of this course. Instead, this course starts with basic concepts of machine learning and econometrics; and ends with procedural computer codes. Students are required to be familiar with at least one software such as Python, R or C++.

briefs.name: 個體經濟分析一
briefs.tags: 個體經濟學, microeconomics, 消費者理論， 廠商理論
briefs.desc: This course covers some fundamental theories in microeconomics, such as the decision making of consumers and firms. We first introduce some basic mathematical tools for solving optimization. We next study the behavior of individual consumers and firms. Finally, we explore the partial equilibrium and general equilibrium theorem. The goal of this course is to provide some basic tools for you to develop a formal treatment of these subjects and apply them to relevant issues.

briefs.name: 家庭經濟學
briefs.tags: family, divorce, marriage, household bargaining, children
briefs.desc: This course focuses on research on family and demographic economics. Students will be introduced to a wide range of research topics related to family and demographic economics and learn to develop the ability to conduct research in this field. The study of families and households is an important research area given the increasingly complex organization of families, which have produced substantial effects on behavior of households and welfare of children as well as spouses. We will focus on the theoretical modeling and empirical investigation of how individuals sort into families (cohabitation, marriage and divorce) and of the major economic outcomes determined in a family context (such as spousal time allocation, labor supply (particularly the changing role of women in the labor force), fertility, consumption, investments in children and intergenerational transfers. Of particular importance are the various classes of household models and their testable implications on family decis

briefs.name: 總體經濟分析一
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學, 經濟成長, 實質景氣循環模型, Macroeconomics, Growth, RNC model
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to familiarize graduate students with quantitative methods in advanced macroeconomics and introduce some fundamental workhorse models and methods of formal macroeconomics analysis. The main difference between undergraduate and graduate macroeconomics is the use of models that are explicitly dynamic and stochastic. Dynamic general equilibrium (DGE) macroeconomics by providing microeconomic foundation for macroeconomics has emerged in recent years and been adopted by most modern research in macroeconomics as a leading approach.

briefs.name: 公共經濟理論一
briefs.tags: tax effect, tax avoidance, inequality, mobility, donation, 租稅效果, 避稅, 不均, 流動性, 捐贈
briefs.desc: The course will analyze issues in public economics, which can be categorized into four parts: (1) tax effects on economic behaviors; (2) issues on the income and wealth inequality in Taiwan and the world; (3) individual charitable donations; and others. The part of tax effects will investigate the tax effects on individuals’ economic behaviors, mainly including business investment and tax compliance. The part on inequality will discuss empirical evidence on income and wealth inequality and examine various rationales for the increasing inequality around the world since the 1980s. It will also analyze the negative impacts of income and wealth inequality on the society and evaluate possible remedies, especially tax policies, to alleviate the increasing inequality. The part on individual charitable donations will discuss the theoretical rationales underlying individuals’ charitable giving and analyze the buzzing empirical studies based on field experiments in

briefs.name: 教育經濟：理論與應用
briefs.nameEn: Economics of Education: Theory and Application
briefs.tags: economics of education, econometrics, empirical study; 教育經濟、計量經濟、實證研究
briefs.desc: This is a topic course in economics of education. We will discuss central issues regarding this field such as estimating the returns to education, human capital and signaling theories of education, education and economic growth, education and economic equality, peer effects, entrance channels and students academic performance,..., etc. We will primarily focus on empirical applications while sometimes theoretical work will be referred to. The introduction of suitable empirical strategies (i.e., a variety of econometric techniques) along with the search for identification will be much emphasized throughout this course. The utimate goal of this course is to motivate PhD or master students conducting a quality research on economics of edcucation. Thereby, students will be required to initiate a new project related to the course, survey the literature, collect data, summarize basic statistics, estimate the specified model, test certain hypothesis, conduct sensitivity ana

briefs.name: 數量方法導論
briefs.tags: Useful results in calculus; static optimization; useful results in matrix algebra; probability theory and modes of convergence; differential equations
briefs.desc: As a preliminary course for some other courses offered in the same semester, this course is supposed to be delivered in the first month of instruction. Thus, classes are scheduled in the evenings and weekends of the first month of instruction.

briefs.name: 偏微分方程與複變函數
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Variables
briefs.tags: Partial differential equations; complex variables;
briefs.desc: The course consists of Part A - partial differential equations and Part B - complex variables. Part A discusses how to solve partial differential equations e,g., wave equation, heat equation and etc. frequently encountered in engineering and physics. Part B discusses the theory of complex variables covering analytic functions, differentiation, contour integrals and etc., useful to engineering and physics.

briefs.name: 偏微分方程與複變函數
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Variables
briefs.tags: 偏微分方程、複變函數
briefs.desc: 本課程銜接常微分方程，涵蓋偏微分方程及 複變數函數兩者，提供修習其他工程或物 理學科所需之數學基礎。修完本科目 可對偏微分方程之物理意義、基本解法與複變函數之理論、應用等有一概括性 之認識，有助於修習電磁學、近代物理、控制系統、電力工程等課程。本科目 需具有大一微積分、常微分方程(Ordinary Differential Equations) 及傅氏/拉氏 (Fourier/Laplace)變換之基礎。

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 線性代數, 工程數學, Linear Algebra, Engineering Mathematics,
briefs.desc: Linear algebra is a branch of mathematics that studies systems of linear equations and the properties of matrices. The concepts of linear algebra are extremely useful in engineering, physics, economics and social sciences, and natural sciences. In this class, the foundation of elementary linear algebra is illustrated for students. Various applications of linear algebra in different areas will also be addressed.

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 向量空間, 正交基底, 線性轉換, 內積, 矩陣運算, vector space, prthogonal bases, linear transformation, inner product, matrix operation
briefs.desc: This course offers a rigorous and foundational journey through one of the most elegant and widely applied branches of mathematics. We will explore the theory and applications of vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, and inner product spaces with a level of depth suited for serious study in mathematics, physics, computer science, and engineering.

briefs.name: 近代物理
briefs.tags: Physics, Relativity, Quantum mechanics, Atoms, Molecules, electrons
briefs.desc: This course offers introduction to “Modern Physics” established in the 20th century. Knowledge on “Modern Physics” is fundamental to understanding practically developed various optoelectronic contemporary devices such as transistors and lasers. The main purpose of this course is to learn fundamentals of relativity and quantum mechanics, which are representative fields beyond the concept of Newtonian mechanics. Relativity is the law for time and space and is usually concerned with high velocities comparable to the speed of light. Quantum mechanics is the law of the microscopic world for atoms, molecules and nuclei. Throughout this course, we mainly focus on learning how relativistic effects appear when dealing with high velocities, how ways of viewing materials have been developed and how materials are structured from microscopic viewpoints. * The course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 電磁學
briefs.tags: 靜電, 靜磁, 馬克士威爾方程式, 波動方程式, 傳輸線理論
briefs.desc: 本課程為電磁波、光電工程、固態電子元件以及光電領域各項研究所課程的基礎，課程內容將帶學生了解電磁學理論基礎與應 用，搭配數學公式和物理圖像幫助學生理解靜電場、靜磁場、電磁交互作用以及傳輸線理論等物理現象，最後將推廣至馬克士威 爾方程式以及時變電磁場。

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: Electric circuit電路, resistive circuit電阻電路, circuit theorem電路理論, first order circuit一階電路, second order circuit二階電路, ac power analysis交流電路功率分析, OP amplifier運算放大器
briefs.desc: This is one of the mandatory courses for the EE Department. This course introduces the basic theory of linear circuit analysis, which helps students for solving realistic problems involving these circuits and further being able to design complex electronic, communication, computer, power, and control systems.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: resistor, capacitor, inductor, first-order circuits, second-order circuits, sinusoidal steady state
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental techniques of circuit analysis.

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗
briefs.tags: 電晶體、運算放大器、被動元件、濾波電路、振盪電路、transistor, operational amplifier, passive devices, filters, oscilators
briefs.desc: This course is intended for EE students at the junior level who have already taken the basic circuit theory and micrelectronics. Students will get hands-on experiences through experiments to complement the learning of microelectronics and circuit theories. Op-amps, passive elements (e.g. R, L, and C), and transistors will be used extensively to implement various circuits.

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗
briefs.tags: 電晶體、運算放大器、被動元件、濾波電路、振盪電路、transistor, operational amplifier, passive devices, filters, oscilators
briefs.desc: This course is intended for EE students at the junior level who have already taken the basic circuit theory and micrelectronics. Students will get hands-on experiences through experiments to complement the learning of microelectronics and circuit theories. Op-amps, passive elements (e.g. R, L, and C), and transistors will be used extensively to implement various circuits.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: microelectronics, semiconductor devices, IC, device physics, circuit design, CMOS, BJT
briefs.desc: This course is an introductory course of microelectronics. We will focus on the fundamental knowledge of microelectronic circuits and emphasize the design-oriented approach. This course introduces the most important concepts for design of analog circuits such as characteristics of semiconductors, operating principles of diodes and transistors, and various amplifier configurations for both BJTs and MOSFETS. By developing solid understanding of basic knowledge, learning microelectronics could be enjoyable.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: Analog Integrated Circuit, Integrated Circuit, Linear Circuit, Operational Amplifier Circuit.
briefs.desc: This is a consecutive course after EE2255 Electronics. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications for linear circuits, especially for operational amplifiers in feedback systems.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: Microelectronic II, Analog IC design, 類比積體電路設計, CMOS, 互補式金氧半元件
briefs.desc: This is a fundamental course for analysis and design of analog integrated circuits. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications from circuit and physical viewpoints. Most material is for CMOS technology. BJT will be introduced briefly.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: Computer programming, declarations, statements, efficiency, legibility, structure programming, object oriented programming; 電腦程式，宣告，執行動作，效率，可讀 性，結構型程式，物件導向程式
briefs.desc: The main objective of this introductory course is to help students develop programming skills to solve problems. As computers are becoming more powerful and ubiquitous, proper use of computers can increase productivity significantly. Thus, the ability to write efficient programs to solve problems improves one’s core competence and can be an important differentiator for one’s career. Among today’s popular programming languages, C is found to have the biggest impacts. Many modern computer languages borrowed heavily from C. Thus, proficiency in C language would pave ways to good programming in other languages. In this course, we will devote most of the time in C programming. object-oriented programming and classes, however, will also be briefly introduced.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: 電腦程式語言; 邏輯思考; 物件導向程式設計; Computer Programming Language; Logic; object-Oriented Programming
briefs.desc: 本門課程有幾個重要的學習目標: 1. 培養程式設計能力。即能將自己的邏輯或想法，轉換成程式語言，並輸入電腦執行。 2. 承上，培養嚴謹的邏輯思考能力。一段沒有邏輯的想法，可能前後矛盾或是產生謬誤，無法得到正確的結果。而透過撰寫 程式語言，則是檢視自己邏輯是否清晰的最佳方式之一。 3. 本門課為電腦科學的入門課程，希望藉由本門課之訓練，幫助同學打下良好的基礎，並銜接較高階的課程。 4. 程式設計不僅是一門工程學，更是一門「藝術」。好的程式不光是「可執行」、「結果正確」而已，簡潔、效率、可讀性、 方便維護與擴充、風格，都是衡量的重點，期望同學也能寫出漂亮的程式。

briefs.name: 微處理機系統
briefs.tags: 微處理機、微控制器、組合語言、8051、ARC
briefs.desc: 講授微處理機系統基本概念。學習與編寫微處理機的組合語言及 C 語言程式。透過 8 位元微控制器 (8051) 及 32 位元 (Synopsys ARC EM)處理器範例學習微處理器的結構、指令集、記憶體定址、中斷控制以及週邊介面設計。

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.tags: probability, statistics, random variable, machine learning, inference
briefs.desc: Probability is arguably one of the most important math tool in the areas such as computer science, information theory, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. The course will be taught with a clear goal of using probability as a computational tools with many examples from practical applications. Fundamental aspect such as axioms, conditional probability, random variables, and joint distribution will be covered. Efforts will be made to make sure that the students learn the important foundational concepts necessary for their subsequent exploration of communication, modern machine learning and artificial neural network.

briefs.name: 電磁波
briefs.tags: electromagnetics, wave, waveguide, resonator, antenna, transmission line
briefs.desc: This course is to study electromagnetic waves. We will first understand the basic concepts of a wave. An electromagnetic wave contains vector components of electric and magnetic fields. It is better to learn the subject from the viewpoint of a scalar field. Following the conceptive understanding of a wave, we will start to study the voltage and current (scalar quantities) waves on a transmission line. We then study the vector components of electric and magnetic fields in a plane wave. Once we learn about the reflection and transmission of an electromagnetic wave at boundaries, we will try to understand waveguide and cavity as elements for propagating and storing electromagnetic waves in a confined space, respectively. To send and receive an electromagnetic wave, one needs an antenna. The last part of the course is about transmission and receiving antennas for electromagnetic waves.

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: IC designs, VLSI designs, Circuit designs, Chip designs, Semiconductor
briefs.desc: In this course, students will learn the basics knowledge of IC designs, focus on transitor-level circuits and chip-level designs methdology. You will also get familiar with the transitor-level IC- related CAD tools (design, simulation, layout, RC-extraction) after finishing all the assigned homeworks and project. This course targes at both "知識學習"與"動手做".

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: (1) CMOS技術中的數字積體電路設計(Digital VLSI design in CMOS technology) (2) 基於矽的CMOS 電路 (Si based CMOS Circuit) (3) CMOS 邏輯門的靜態和動態行為 (Static and dynamic behaviors of CMOS logics) (4) 組合和時序邏輯電路 (Combinational and sequential logic circuits) (5) 工業標準電路設計工具(Industrial standard circuit design tools)
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide the fundamental theories & techniques of digital VLSI design in CMOS technology and carry out a digital VLSI deign. In this course, we will study the fundamental knowledge of designing digital VLSI systems include the operating mode of a MOSFET transistor and basics of MOSFET modeling, the description of CMOS fabrication and design rules, the analysis of static and dynamic behaviors of CMOS logic gates, the design of combinational logic and the system-level circuits, the optimization concepts of circuit and layout designs. Laboratory and project works will be utilized on industrial standard tools.

briefs.name: 類比及射頻設計實務
briefs.nameEn: Case Study for Analog and RF Designs
briefs.tags: Analog IC, Radio-Frequency IC, System Integration, Cellular phone application
briefs.desc: 由聯發科技業界講師, 從產品應用、技術開發、與系統整合等實際案例，使電機系大學部學生能從實際產品開發, 認識類比及射頻設計領 域，並促進研究動機。(受限於課程參訪行程, 修課人數有上限) 以聯發科的手機晶片系統為例, 分成三大部分介紹: 1. 類比部分 (包含sensor, driver, data converter, PMIC, Clock & SERDES) 2. 射頻部分 (包含Receiver & Transmitter) 3. 業界實驗室參訪

briefs.name: 固態電子元件導論
briefs.tags: Semiconductor, Device Physics, VLSI, Integrated Circuit, Transistor, Diode, BJT, MOSFET
briefs.desc: The course of “Introduction to Solid-State Electronic Devices” (固態電子元件導論) is a foundational course designed for undergraduate students who wish to acquire a comprehensive understanding of semiconductor devices, including their fundamental characteristics, mechanisms, and underlying physics. In this course, students will learn important topics such as semiconductor band theory, carrier transportation and conduction in semiconductors, semiconductor junctions and diodes, MOS capacitors, MOSFETs, bipolar transistors, as well as VLSI memory technologies. Additionally, this course incorporates contemporary knowledge on semiconductor devices, ensuring students stay up to date with the latest advancements in the semiconductor field.

briefs.name: 光電元件
briefs.tags: Light-emitting devices,Light-receiving devices,Light-guiding devices,Other photonic devices
briefs.desc: 此門課適合已修過電磁學的大二或大三同學修習，課程內容簡介數種光電元件的原理與應用，包含Background and fundamentals, light-emitting devices, light-receiving devices, light-guiding devices, and other photonic devices

briefs.name: 計算機結構
briefs.tags: computer architecture, organization, computer design, instruction set architecture, computer arithmetic, pipelining, cache, virtual memory.
briefs.desc: This course will discuss the basic architecture, organization, and design of a modern computer system. The contents cover instruction sets, computer arithmetic, processor core and pipelining, and caches. Students are assumed to have taken courses on logic design and programming in C/C++.

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理實驗
briefs.tags: 訊號處理 (signal processing), 聲音處理 (audio processing), 影像處理 (video processing), 生醫訊號 (biomedical signal processing, 實作 (hands-on experiment)
briefs.desc: 從應用出發，培養訊號處理實際解決問題的設計與經驗。修課條件: 必需修過至少訊號與系統以上以及會 C 或 C++程式設計 建議修過數位訊號處理概論為佳。本課程採音訊、影像、生醫三個大的單元，每個單元 4 週，由負責之教師負責實際授課與帶實 驗。 期末則留有一些時間進行自訂專題.

briefs.name: 機器學習導論
briefs.tags: 機器學習 (Machine Learning), 統計學錫 (Statistical Learning), 集成學習 (Ensemble Learning), 強化學習 (Reinforcement Learning), 分類 (Classification), 迴歸 (Regression)
briefs.desc: 機器學習是一個重要的研究領域，有許多成功的應用，尤其近幾年在電腦視覺、人機介面及社群網路之資料探勘等領域之技術 發展，機器學習皆扮演相當重要之角色。基於機器學習所發展的方法已被應用於多媒體信號處理、電腦視覺、語音和手寫識 別、生物特徵識別、資料探勘、搜索引擎、醫學診斷、證券市場分析、戰略遊戲和機器人運用，乃至於生物資訊等新興產業。 機器學習結合了統計、數學與資訊科學等學門。廣義來說，機器學習研究如何讓電腦具有學習的能力，從以往的經驗及數據中 學習到知識，以增進電腦本身的效能，因此機器學習也可解釋為利用資料來建立一些模擬真實世界的模式（Model），利用這 些模式來描述資料中的特徵（Patterns）以及關係（Relations）。這些模式有兩種用處，第一，瞭解資料的特徵與關係可以 提供決策所需要的資訊。第二，資料的特徵可以幫助進行預測。 本課程介紹機器學習之基本數學理論基礎及其在不同領域(如樣型識別、信號處理及資料分析及統計)之實際應用。本課程將 要求修課同學以電腦程式作業及修課專題的方式實作機器學習演算法，以深入了解機器學習理論及演算法特性。

briefs.name: 電動機械
briefs.tags: 磁路分析 Magnetic circuit analysis, 變壓器 Transformers, 步進馬達 Stepping motors, 直流馬達及發電機 DC motors and generators, 同步馬達及發電機 Synchronous motors and generators, 感應馬達及發電機 Induction motors and generators
briefs.desc: 介紹機電能量轉換原理、各式電機之結構、操作原理、運轉特性以及固態控制。另外，亦介紹電力系統之組成、輸配、應 用、用電安全、電源品質、備用電源及一些特殊設備之電源系統等。供同學通盤了解電力工程之有關事務 (與電動機械實 驗配合進行，欲修電動機械實驗者請修電動機械課程)。 This course introduces the following topics for various electric machines: electro-mechanical energy conversion principle; structures, operation principle, running characteristics, power electronic control, etc. In addition, some basic power engineering concepts are also introduced, such as power system configuration, transmission and distribution, electricity applications, electric safety, power quality, standby power and some special electric power systems. From this course the students can generally understand the basic electric power engineering affairs. The students are suggested to take this course if they want to participate the course of “Electric machinery laboratory” offered in the followed semeste

briefs.name: 實作專題一
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of research project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of reseach project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 固態物理導論
briefs.tags: solid-state physics, chemistry and crystal, fundamental properties and their elements, quantum physics and statistical mechanics
briefs.desc: Welcome to solid-state physics! This lecture will build the basic understanding of physics at the undergraduate level of students from various background. In order to prepare everyone for this topic, the lecture will cover the following elements in solid-state. 1. Chemistry (needed in this lecture) 2. Quantum physics (needed in this lecture) 3. Statistical mechanics (needed in this lecture) 4. Electrical properties – Electron in solid 5. Heat properties – Phonons in solid 6. Optical properties – band structures and excitons 7. Crystal structures 8. Semiconductor devices 9. Magnetic properties of atoms Three textbooks are recommended for this lecture. I will opt a modern aspect and interpretation of solid-state physics, The Oxford solid state basics, as the main materials. Simon, Steven H. The Oxford solid state basics. OUP Oxford, 2013. Kittel, Charles. Introduction to solid state physics. Ashcroft, N. W., and N. D. Mermin. "Solid State Physics"

briefs.name: 光電實驗
briefs.tags: geometry optics, diffraction, interference, optoelectronics
briefs.desc: This Course will introduce classical optics in an undergraduate level. The theories of geometry optics, diffraction, interference, and optoelectronics will be systematically present. Also, students will get hand-on experience on developing diverse optical systems.

briefs.name: 微波電路導論
briefs.tags: Microwave, waveguides, network, filters, couplers, transformers
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth study of microwave engineering principles, concepts, and applications. Topics include microwave transmission lines, passive components, microwave network analysis, microwave resonators, and microwave measurements.

briefs.name: 積體電路設計實驗
briefs.tags: 數位電路設計、硬體描述語言、邏輯合成、晶片自動佈局繞線；Digital circuit design, hardware description language, logic synthesis, layout APR
briefs.desc: 本課程依數位電路設計的標準元件設計流程分為三單元：Verilog硬體描述語言、邏輯合成、自動佈局繞線。 除了講堂上的授課以外，每週皆有上機實驗課程，另有五次數位電路設計作業與期末專題。本課程強調深入的Verilog語 言撰寫以及EDA工具的操作，以實際體驗與了解數位電路設計的趣味與精髓。

briefs.name: 硬體安全導論
briefs.tags: cryptography, security, hardware security, anti-tampering, PUF, root of trust, 密碼學, 硬體安全, 抗攻擊設計, 不可複製功能, 信任根
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在探討各項與硬體相關的資安議題，核心內容包括密碼學演算法、物理攻擊與抗攻擊設計、信任根與安全操作，此外也 將介紹較為進階的演算法和硬體模組設計。本課程主要分為三大部分，第一部分講述密碼學與安全硬體設計所需的知識基礎，會 針對常用的密碼學算法以及相關數學原理做概要性的介紹。第二部份講述在硬體上常見的攻擊以及相對應的防禦方式，涵蓋物理 攻擊簡介、旁通道攻擊理論與實作以及抗攻擊設計。第三部分將針對晶片底層的信任根作介紹，涵蓋隨機數產生器、系統單晶片 內的安全操作以及物理不可複製函數。在核心內容之外，也會針對越趨重要的後量子密碼學以及其基礎做初步介紹。

briefs.name: 固態電子實驗--半導體製程與實驗
briefs.tags: 半導體製造Semiconductor manufacturing, 場效電晶體 Field-effect transistors, 微影 Optical lithography, 鍍膜 Deposition, 濕式蝕刻 Wet Etching
briefs.desc: The silicon integrated circuit is surely one of the wonders of our age. The ability to fabricate tens of millions of individual components on a chip with an area of a few centimeter square has enabled the information age. This course attempts to describe not only the manufacturing practice associated with the technologies used in silicon chip fabrication, but also the underlying scientific basis for those technologies. This course will show the students how silicon field-effect transistors are made using the knowledge learned in the ULSI technologies. However, due to the limited implementation hours, students can only fabricate p-type or n-type MOSFET with characteristics measured and simulated.

briefs.name: 生醫影像導論
briefs.tags: Biomedical Imaging, Signals and Systems, Ultrasound, Magnetic Resonance Imaging, X-ray, Computed Tomography, Nuclear Medicine
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of biomedical “imaging” (i.e., designing a camera which is capable of seeing through human body and small animals) with emphasis on the signals and systems aspects. It will cover the most important imaging modalities - projection radiography, X- ray computed tomography, nuclear medicine imaging, ultrasound imaging, and magnetic resonance imaging. Basic principles, instrumentation, image characteristics, clinical applications, and recent progress of these imaging modalities will be discussed. In this course, the students will learn how to apply the knowledge learned in the course "Signals and Systems" to biomedical imaging.

briefs.name: 通訊系統二
briefs.tags: Communication system, modulation, demodulation, information theory
briefs.desc: This is a core course for students who would like to understand or enter the field of digital communications engineering. As analog communication has been covered in the course "Communication System I", "Communication System II" introduces Digital Communication. This course covers Digital Transmissions, Spread-Spectrum Modulation, Multiuser Communications and Information Theory. This course is designed in parallel with "Communication System I". For students taking this course, the background of "Communication System I" is preferred. For the practicing engineer in the communications industry and those who (such as the senior/beginning graduate student) plan to have communications as major area,this course is necessary to build solid background on digital communications. For those who are to engage in signal processing and IC design for communications, this is also a course worth taking.

briefs.name: 通訊系統實驗
briefs.tags: 通訊系統(Communication Systems), 軟體定義無線電(Software-Defined Radio), 圖像化程式語言程式(LabView), 數位調變(Digital Modulation), 實作課程(Hands-on Course)
briefs.desc: 本課程專注於提升學生的通訊系統實作能力，透過模組化設計將複雜的通訊系統分解成易於理解的部分。課程包含理論講解與 實作練習，每週一小時的理論講解與兩到三小時的實驗課程。學生將使用軟體定義無線電硬體設備及圖像化程式語言Labview來進 行實驗，並在期末完成綜合專題。

briefs.name: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 線性與非線性規劃
briefs.tags: 線性規劃;非線性規劃; Linear Programming; Nonlinear Programming; Euclidean Space; Convex Sets; Convex Polytopes
briefs.desc: This course is an introduction to linear and nonlinear programming and its applications.

briefs.name: 時序電路設計及應用
briefs.nameEn: Timing Circuit Designs and Their Applications
briefs.tags: Timing Circuit, Delay-Locked Loop (DLL), Phase-Locked Loop (PLL), Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC), Speed Grading, Interconnect Delay Testing and Monitoring
briefs.desc: 晶片內部的執行有一定的時序，就像人的脈搏一樣。因此，每一個晶片內部都有時序相關的控制電路，譬如鎖向迴路 (Phase-Locked Loop)、鎖延遲迴路 (Delay-Locked Loop)、時間量化器 (Time-to-Digital Converter)、數位轉時 間之轉換器 (Digital-to-Time Converter)等，這些電路在晶片設計、設計自動化與測試等領域都有廣泛的應用 (如全 晶片高速時脈之控制，異質整合晶片時脈訊號同步、電路速度測試與分級、晶片線上健康狀況監控等)。過去十幾年，有許 多全數化的時序相關電路之設計理念的發展，因此希望透過此門課程，提供有志於電路設計領域發展的同學相關的札實訓 練，並建立相關的研發能力。

briefs.name: 類比電路設計
briefs.tags: 類比積體電路, Analog IC, 超大型積體電路, VLSI, 線性電路, Linear Circuits, 金氧半導體, CMOS
briefs.desc: This is an advanced course for analysis and design analog integrated circuits. It covers quantitative analyses, design considerations and system applications for linear circuits, especially for operational amplifiers.

briefs.name: 射頻積體電路設計
briefs.tags: radio frequency, RFIC, amplifiers, transceivers, mixers, oscillators
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamentals and the design of RF and millimeter-wave circuits based on CMOS technology.

briefs.name: 計算機算術
briefs.tags: 1補數, 2補數, 正負數, 餘數, IEEE標準浮點表示, 加, 減, 乘, 除, Carry look-ahead adder, carry select adder, carry skip adder,
briefs.desc: 本課程教導現有計算機中基本表示方法 及其算術運算(加, 減, 乘, 除)之硬體電路設計與其速度和面積的取捨.

briefs.name: 系統理論
briefs.tags: 最佳控制, 穩定度, Bellman Optimality Principle, Dynamical Programming, 資料驅動, 強化學習
briefs.desc: 本課程首先探討最佳控制. 之後以Bellman Optimality Principle與動態規劃, 研究有模型系統之最佳控制策略. 最後將有 模型之最佳控制, 拓展至無模型下, 資料驅動之各種強化學習策略.

briefs.name: 高等電力網路分析
briefs.tags: 電力系統，運轉與調度，電力潮流，故障電流，穩定度
briefs.desc: To let the students have a clear knowledge about how a power system is configured and operated to meet the basic steady state and transient requirements based on the pre-analyses of power flow, short- circuit, steady state stability and transient stability.

briefs.name: 固態能量轉換
briefs.tags: Pulse-width modulation, current control, voltage control, inverter
briefs.desc: The civilization of electricity is going through a paradigm shift at this moment. The semiconductor pioneered by John Bardeen, William Shockley and Walter Brattain in the 1950s leads to the revolution of information technology, and the way we share and exchange information is forever changed. In the next decades, this paradigm shift will revolutionize the way we share and exchange energy. Power electronics technologies will shape the internet of electric power as more and more renewables and distributed energy resources are developed to reduce CO2 and prevent global warming. This course focuses on the fundamentals of DC/AC power converters the technologies of their applications in the smart grid.

briefs.name: 切換式電源供應器
briefs.tags: Power Converter, Graft technique, layer technique , Small-signal modeling, Peak-current control, Change-mode control, average current control
briefs.desc: 1. Introduction：電力電子技術和應用介紹與學習範疇。 2. Basic DC to DC converters：電力轉換器之組成基本元件、轉換器應用介紹。 3. Graft & layer techniques：電源轉換器拓樸結構、工作與組成原理。 4. Dynamic modeling of DC converters：動態時域/頻域分析、升降壓轉換器建模。 5. Closed loop control of DC converters：電壓電流控制。 6. Soft switching techniques：切換分析與組合、緩衝器介紹。 7. Quasi resonant & resonant converters：準諧振與諧振轉換器。 8. Switched capacitor converters：昇壓型轉換器。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, DSP, AI, Circuit Design, EDA
briefs.desc: Seminar talks will be arranged and offered to EE students to cover related areas in industry and academia.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 專題演講,邀請演講,Keynote speech, invited talk
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程每週邀請演講者進行專題演講，演講主題以電力組相關領域為主，由電力組老師邀請演講者，演講時間約 1~1.5 小時，同學在演講結束後可與演講者互動。

briefs.name: 系統生物學
briefs.tags: Modeling(建模),Bioinformatics(生物資訊),Synthetic biology design(合成生物學設計),Gene regulation network(基因調控網路),protein-protein interaction network(蛋白質網路)
briefs.desc: Systems biology is a discipline that integrates biochemistry, cell biology, computer science, and systems engineering to provide a holistic view on biological functions and structures. The genomic revolution of high- throughput techniques has opened up systematic investigations and engineering designs for various life forms. System biology entails synthetic biology and creates many emerging applications in energy, pharmaceuticals, bio-materials, foods, ecosystem protection, etc. through engineering principles. This course will discuss the system-level models of various basic biological process, analysis of experimental and literature data, and deduce interesting theoretical insight. Students will need basic understanding of linear algebra, probability, and control theory. No prerequisite of biology courses is essential to take this course.

briefs.name: 高等計算機結構
briefs.tags: Computer Architecture, Memory Hierarchy, Cache Coherence, Instruction-Level Parallelism, Data-Level Parallelism, Thread-Level Parallelism, Domain-Specific Architectures
briefs.desc: We will discuss several advanced concepts of computer architecture for modern machines. Topics include memory hierarchy, DRAM, ILP, dynamic scheduling, SIMD, vector, GPU and DSA accelerators. It is recommended that students have taken undergraduate computer architecture course. It's essential to have prior knowledge about ISA, arithmetic, pipeline, and cache.

briefs.name: 深度生成式影像模型：理論與應用
briefs.nameEn: Deep Generative Image Modeling: Theory and Applications
briefs.tags: 生成式人工智慧 (Generative AI)、影像生成式模型 (Image Generative Models)、深度學習 (Deep Learning)、
briefs.desc: 隨著深度學習技術及基於深度學習生成式AI (GenAI) 基礎模型近幾年快速的進展，及受益於巨量影像、語言資料庫的建立 及 GPU 運算能力的強化及普及，已大幅地改變了目前影像處理、影像內容生成及電腦視覺的技術發展與走向，造成典範轉 移。很多傳統的影像處理及電腦視覺方法已遠跟不上目前技術的演進，深度生成式影像模型已成為目前的技術主流，因此開授 新的相關課程。以建立同學的研究基礎。 此課程將以統計學習的理論基礎，介紹近幾年來主要的深度生成式影像模型，主要分成三個部分，第一部分為基本的統計學習 及深度學習技術(包含CNN，RNN及Transformer)的簡要介紹；第二部分為介紹近幾年主要的深度生成式影像模型，包 VAE， GAN，Diffusion Models及Vison-Language 生成模型等；第三部分則為這些深度生成式影像模型在影像處理、內容生成及 電腦視覺的應用，包含影像復原、深偽內容生成及影像場景理解等。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: logic design, digital circuit, logic optimization, sequential circuit, boolean algebra
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic theories and the implementations of logic circuits and digital systems. We will start with the topics of number systems and Boolean algebra, which are fundamental to all digital systems, followed by the optimization, storage elements such as flip flops, and sequential circuits. With both combinational logic and sequential circuits, we will discuss the design of registers, counters, memory as well as programmable devices.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: Logic Design, Logic Optimization, Combinational Logics, Sequential Logics
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹邏輯電路的設計與實作理論，包含了二進位、布林代數、組合電路設計，儲存單元正反器、記憶體。並將介紹同步序列邏輯 電路與有限狀態器之設計以及暫存器轉移階層設計方法。

briefs.name: Python語言程式入門
briefs.tags: introduction to programming, Python language, computer science, structured language, modules
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental programming concepts in the Python language and related environment. Fundamental concepts include overview of computer systems, python environment setup, Python language overview, command line interface, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exception, file, function, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, and modules.

briefs.name: 訊號與系統
briefs.tags: convolution, Fourier series, Fourier transform, Laplace transform, and z-transform operations
briefs.desc: This is a mandatory course intended to consolidate the mathematical foundations to various fields of electrical engineering, such as signal processing, communications, optics, and control. In this course, we will introduce various analysis methods along with some practical examples. We will focus on continuous-time/discrete-time deterministic signals and linear time-invariant systems. We will cover the convolution, Fourier series, Fourier transform, Laplace transform, and z-transform operations.

briefs.name: 常微分方程
briefs.tags: 工程數學engineering mathematics, 線性系統linear systems, 傅立葉分析Fourier analysis, Laplace轉換, 特殊函數 special functions
briefs.desc: 本課程為工程數學之第一部分，內容主要以 微分方程 及 Fourier 分析為主。相較於一般工程數學教科書，本課程在授 課方法與次序上，將由微分算子特性貫穿全程，並且注重線性系統方面之理解，並將引入在各種工程領域應用之例。此與 傳統工程數學上課頗有不同，因此課程的出席參與十分重要。

briefs.name: 常微分方程
briefs.tags: Engineering problems, Differential equations, Laplace transform, Series solutions, Fourier series
briefs.desc: Ordinary Differential Equations class is to teach how to solve differential equations, which are models in many engineering problems. This post-calculus mathematics is needed and used by today's scientists and engineers. It will cover the following topics: 1. First order differential equations 2. Second order differential equations 3. Laplace transform 4. Series solutions for differential equations 5. Systems of differential equations 6. Fourier series

briefs.name: 離散數學
briefs.tags: Mathematics, Logic, Reasoning, Proofs, Problem Formulation, Analysis
briefs.desc: This course is about the study of discrete structures, and is one of the foundation courses in Computer Science. We will introduce a couple of basic concepts, and we hope that through the understanding of these concepts, we can strengthen our ability to understand a problem formulation, define a new problem, think critically, and analyze the correctness and efficiency of a solution to a problem. ** This course does not involve the usage of AI.

briefs.name: 計算機網路概論
briefs.tags: 網際網路協議(Internet Protocol), 路由(Routing), 擁塞控制(Congestion Control), 傳輸控制協議(Transmission Control Protocol), 網路安全 (Network Security)
briefs.desc: This is a first course in computer networks. It introduces the basic concepts and building blocks in the current computer networks. Here is a list of lecture topics.

briefs.name: 音樂x科技：互動與生成式音樂設計
briefs.tags: 互動設計 Interactive Design, 生成式音樂 Generative Music, 資料聲音化 Sonification, 跨領域創作 Cross-disciplinary Creation, 演算法作曲 Algorithmic Composition, 數位訊號處理 Digital Signal Processing, 健康促進 Health Promotion
briefs.desc: 本課程以音樂、聲音為媒介，探討互動裝置、系統與工具之設計與應用，並鼓勵學生探索其於藝術創作、創意實踐及健康促進等跨領域應 用。學生將透過理論講授與實務操作，學習互動音樂與生成式音樂之基本概念，並整合音樂軟體（如 Ableton Live、Max/MSP）、微 控制器、MIDI 裝置、聲音及影像輸入及感測器等，實踐創意互動音樂體驗。 This course explores the design and application of interactive music and sound systems, encouraging cross-disciplinary projects in art, creativity, and health. Through theoretical lectures and practical exercises, students will learn the fundamentals of interactive and generative music, and integrate music software (e.g., Ableton Live, Max/MSP), microcontrollers, MIDI devices, sound and video input, and sensors to realize creative interactive music experiences.

briefs.name: 運用生成式AI學習學術英語寫作
briefs.tags: 學術英文寫作, 生成式AI, 論文結構, 提示工程, 資訊設計 Academic English Writing, Generative AI, Thesis Structure, Prompt Engineering, Information Design
briefs.desc: 本課程結合寫作理論、範本應用與生成式 AI，系統性教授學術與科學寫作，涵蓋從標題、摘要、簡介、相關研究、方法、結 果、討論到結論的完整架構。課程以經典寫作理論為基礎，如 John Swales 的 CARS 模型，解析論文「簡介」的撰寫策略， 並參考 Writing up Research 指導「相關研究」的組織方式。此外，透過分析 Learning to Find Answers to Questions on the Web 這篇經典論文，說明方法章節的撰寫技巧，強調問題陳述、步驟描述與虛擬碼應用，以取代過時的流 程圖呈現方式。對於數據與圖表的使用，則參考《Presenting Numbers, Tables, and Figures》，介紹 Edward Tufte 的資訊設計理論，幫助學生提升研究成果的視覺化表達能力。 課程採翻轉教學模式，結合實體與線上學習，在課堂上以作業解答、問題討論與論文修改示範為主，強調即時實作與累積評分 制度，以提升學習成效。此外，課程導入生成式 AI，協助範本分析、草稿修改與文獻檢索，並提供寫作輔導時段（Writing Clinic），讓學生獲得個別指導。透過傳統與 AI 工具的結合，本課程幫助學生掌握學術英文寫作，提升論文品質與寫作效 率。

briefs.name: 實作專題一
briefs.desc: 實作專題為本班必修課程，所有學生必須修滿2學期。課程由選修學生跟隨實作的老師，透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式，學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: 課程說明： 實作專題為本班必修課程， 所有學生必須修滿2學期。 課程由選修學生跟隨實作的老師， 透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式， 學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。 教學方式、成績考核： 修課學生於修課期間需跟隨專題指導教授進行相關專題研究進度，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。 電資院學士班實作專題課程相關規定請見以下連結： https://u-eecs.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/404-1176-171054.php?Lang=zh-tw

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 全球經濟
briefs.tags: international trade, international finance, globalization, new challenge of central banking, WTO
briefs.desc: Course objective: This course is intended to have students understand the current important issues about global economy. The regular lectures are organized under the framework of Trade and Development, with topics cover theory, history, institution, and policy. In addition, selective lectures will explore recent hot issues of globalization – cultural diversity and creative industries, and new challenge of central banking. These lectures are given by the professors from the Department of Economics.

briefs.name: 科技與產業
briefs.tags: 科技與產業，科技與產業發展概念，5G/大數據，人工智慧/ChatGPT、DeepSeed，生醫/材料/淨零碳排，數位化/物聯網，跨領域及價值創新
briefs.desc: ◆近年來全球資通訊與網路及AI等科技的快速發展，以及自2020年起Covid-19新冠疫情席捲全球加上中美貿易戰、俄烏戰爭等 地緣政治與2050淨零碳排等因素之衝擊，世界產業與經濟進入嶄新的數位轉型銳變時代。不僅影響消費者行為與人類的生活型 態，科技產業的發展生態體系以及市場遊戲規則也產生革命性巨變，例如：5G、人工智慧、ChatGPT、DeepSeed、大數據、數 位轉型、生醫、材料、綠能、電動車及物聯網等各領域技術皆帶來很多嶄新的產品、服務與商業服務模式等。本課程邀請工研院 多項領域之單位主管及相關專家，以講座方式介紹最新各科技領域發展趨勢及台灣產業發展的機會，期望同學瞭解與掌握這些領 域的發展趨勢，以利學員及台灣產業競爭力之提升。

briefs.name: 行銷管理
briefs.tags: 行銷Marketing
briefs.desc: This course focuses on the application of marketing concepts and theories to high technology- based and traditional products/services.

briefs.name: 創新與創業
briefs.tags: innovation 5.0, innovation planning, business models, innovation policy, industrial transformation, entrepreneurship
briefs.desc: 1.介紹創業管理的基礎知識與技能，使學生能瞭解創業精神與經濟發展、企業管理之間的關係及 實務創業家所關心主要問題。 2.開拓學生的視野，瞭解專業經理人除了要為股東善盡效率管理人之責任外，發揮創業精神才是 創造企業成長及獲得超額利潤的來源。有助於培養MBA學生以創新思維，處理既有企業的新事業 發展管理、創投事業經營與自行創業的能力。 3.使學生瞭解新創事業的特性與其所面臨的相關管理問題，如分析創業商機、撰寫創業計畫書、 籌募資金、管理成長與經營團隊管理。 The objective of this course is to provide the student with an understanding of the problems and challenges facing an entrepreneur in the process of creating a business. The course will use the development of a business plan as the focal point. Groups of students will develop a business plan piece by piece. Each group will make 2 case presentations and write a business plan during the semester. Therefore the focus of this course is the planning and development of new ventures for the growth and profits.

briefs.name: 服務科學
briefs.tags: 服務主導邏輯, 服務系統, 價值共創, 服務設計, 城鄉創生, Service-Dominant Logic, service system, value co-creation, service design, urban-rural revitalization
briefs.desc: 眾所週知，世界已經邁向了服務經濟的時代。「服務」存在人類社會遠在所謂的「服務業」的產業 分類。但究竟「服務」是什麼？而當IBM於2004年倡導所謂的「服務科學」，或者後來加上工程與 管理，統稱「服務科學工程與管理」(Service Science, Management, and Engineering, SSME)。近年來，在原有的SSME外加上Design，成為現在一般談及服務科學時，以SSMED來描述 它。究竟其內涵與實質內容為何？究竟服務科學的範圍與議題為何？服務科學與現有的學術與實務 領域有何關聯？如何將服務科學的理論應用於實務上？實務上的議題與需求如何來成為服務科學的 研究內容與貢獻？本課程的課程內容規劃即在滿足大家對服務科學的好奇心。同時也希望學生能勇 敢地探索此一新的領域，成為服務科學發展學術與實務社群的生力軍。 本課程的目標簡述如下： 1. 學生能完整定義服務科學的內涵與範疇。 2. 學生能應用服務體驗設計，進行服務設計。 3. 學生能分析與規劃服務價值網絡以提供服務價值。 4. 學生能針對不同的產業提出創新的服務模式。 5. 學生能指出重要的服務科學相關的重要議題，進行研究。 本課程的內容與教學具有以下的特色： 1. 理論與實務並重； 2. 講授與個案教學

briefs.name: 企業及管理論壇
briefs.tags: 科技管理、科技治理、產業發展、企業經營、孫運璿科技講座
briefs.desc: 本課程之主旨在透過專題演講的方式，讓學生對於全球趨勢、政經環境、社會文化、法規政策、產業發展與企業經營管理等不同 面向有更為深入的認識與瞭解。專題演講擬邀請的對象包括各領域的專家學者、孫運璿科技講座主講者與不同產業之企業家和專 業經理人等。學期成績將由課堂參與、期末心得口頭報告以及書面報告等成績計算。

briefs.name: 商務溝通
briefs.tags: 商務溝通,Business Communications
briefs.desc: This course will cover the theory of communication and its applications in the business environment. The process, channels and key success factors of effective business communication will be discussed in detail. Sources of miscommunication will also be discussed. Examples will be used to illustrate different communication situations such as public speech, presentation, sales call and negotiation. The students will be asked to do role playing in various business communication situations.

briefs.name: 公司治理與法律
briefs.tags: 公司法,公司治理,證券市場,證券交易法,企業併購
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹公司治理相關的國內外議題以及台灣之公司法制。

briefs.name: ESG與企業永續發展
briefs.nameEn: ESG and Sustainable Development of The Enterprise
briefs.tags: 永續發展, ESG, ESG 投資, 綠色金融, TCFD, GRI, 企業永續報告書
briefs.desc: 透過對永續發展、ESG 投資、企業永續報告書及相關議題之介紹，讓同學掌握 ESG 的發展，運用 ESG 相關資訊，以評估企業之表現。為讓學員更了 解相關內容, 我們建立了一個 ESG 網頁，內包含上次的修課內容，講師簡介，以及各組同學的報告內容:網址如下 https://esg.course.ctm-nthu.com

briefs.name: 企業經營與智財實務
briefs.nameEn: Business management and intellectual property practice
briefs.tags: 家登精密, 企業經營, 個案教學, 專利訴訟, 智財實務
briefs.desc: 本課程透過閱讀個案公司－家登精密歷年累積的企業經營個案，了解個案公司如何從傳統產業的CNC加工，踏入半導體產業， 並主動發掘顧客需求，提出客戶價值主張（Customer Value Proposition）；透過服務半導體客戶，伴隨客戶一起成長，而 不斷地累積研發能力、調整商業模式，最終研發與生產出市占率全球第一的 EUV Pod。 企業成長茁壯過程，並非一帆風順，伴隨人員理念不和、產品開發失敗、客戶對產品的不滿、競爭對手專利訴訟等。閱讀家登 精密管理個案，公司成長血淚史歷歷在目，不僅能讓學生接觸企業經營的思維，更學習到「一場代價十億的教訓」。

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: Financial Management、Financial Statement Analysis、Capital、Valuation、Risk and Return Analysis
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to introduce the fundamental principles of corporate finance to students. An emphasis will be placed upon on (1) Introduction to Corporate Finance and Financial Statement Analysis, (2) Value and Capital Budgeting, (3) Risk and Return Analysis, (4) Capital Structure and Dividend Decision, and (5) Other related Financial Topics.

briefs.name: 數據經營管理
briefs.tags: data analytics, business analytics, management; 資料分析,商業數據、經營管理
briefs.desc: This course aims to introduce basic economics concepts in particular how to recover the causal relationship. Learning economic theory and empirical methods is able to make a quality decision making in a company. Taking this course, EMBA students would: R26; Learn how to interpret the economics data and human behavior R26; Cultivate the ability to supervise or conduct a business issue R26; If possible, apply the concept and methodology to evaluate a certain business policy

briefs.name: 商業決策測量與分析
briefs.nameEn: Measurement and Analysis for Business Decision Making
briefs.tags: Business Decision Making, Management Accounting
briefs.desc: This course provides students with a comprehensive overview of financial reporting, analysis and measurement issues in the context of business decision making. Student will gain an understanding of financial statements and their underlying measurements. They will then use this understanding to conduct analyses using financial ratios. Students will then explore the role of cost measurements, allocations, etc. in determining the performance measures of parts of the organization and their inter-relationship with both choosing and evaluating strategies in various business contexts. They will cover issues such as matching strategies to performance measures, choosing and evaluating key performance indicators and balanced scorecards, etc.

briefs.name: 專案管理
briefs.tags: project selection, project planning, resource allocation
briefs.desc: Topics include project selection, project planning, negotiation, budgeting, scheduling, resource allocation, project control, project auditing, and project termination. Topics are viewed from a managerial perspective.

briefs.name: 策略與決策
briefs.tags: Decisions, Strategy
briefs.desc: Understanding markets and industries: shifts in demand; shifts in supply; predicting and explaining shifts in demand and/or supply Market structures and structural changes: perfect competition; monopolistic competition and product differentiation; bundles of attributes; oligopoly; protected and entrepreneurial monopolies

briefs.name: 策略性人力資源管理
briefs.tags: human resource management, Strategic
briefs.desc: This is an applied course that examines how modern corporations use human resource management (HRM) to enhance organizational capabilities and achieve strategic objectives. Through the assigned readings, case discussion and various class exercises we will examine how the acquisition, deployment, assessment and retention of an organization’s workforce impacts productivity and firm performance in various contexts. Readings will cover the theory and research on strategic HRM as well as the various parts of a typical HR system. Some of the topics we will discuss include HR planning, recruitment, methods of selection, job design, and implementation of performance management processes. Cases will then be used to focus on specific strategic issues faced by companies including talent management, selecting for cultural fit, incentive pay, and organizational culture. No prior knowledge of HR is assumed and there are no prerequisites for this course. The approach of th

briefs.name: 大數據與決策分析
briefs.tags: big data, decision analysis, operations research, management science, mathematical programming
briefs.desc: 學習有系統地分析策略決策問題、架構目標、評估方案的預期結果和可能的風險、探討決策方案的執行，並應用數位決策與大數 據分析技術並結合模擬分析，從巨量資訊找出問題，並提出解決方案，透過大數據輔助決策，從問題架構、資料收集、資訊整 理、決策分析乃至決策輔助的完整思維過程，提供系統化、數位化之決策依據與實行策略。除介紹大數據、作業研究與決策分析 方法和工具外，並利用演講、個案討論、上機實做和實證案例研究，培養策略性決策思維及應用資料挖礦解決相關問題，進而提 升大數據分析和數位決策能力。

briefs.name: 工業統計與資料科學
briefs.tags: 實驗設計(Design of Experiments), 田口方法(Taguchi Methods), 信號雜音比(Signal-to-Noise Ratio), 直交表(Orthogonal Arrays), 資料科學(Data Science), 多變量分析(Multivariable Analysis)
briefs.desc: 本課程簡介工業資料分析常用的統計方法，第一部分的課程介紹實驗設計方法，能有效率地收集資訊，進一步改善品質。第二部 分的課程著重於資料分析，包含重要變數選取與特徵萃取、主成分分析、迴歸分析與分類等。透過這些分析手法，能解析資料的 特性與變數間的關聯性，以進行預測與分類。

briefs.name: AI技術實務應用
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to AI Technologies in Industrial Applications
briefs.teacher: 林嘉文,胡敏君,陳宜欣,林裕訓
briefs.tags: 人工智慧，機器學習，工業應用
briefs.desc: 本課程簡介AI及機器學習技術在不同領域技術之應用實例，包含電腦視覺，多媒體，資料探勘，人機互 動及虛擬實境，資安，智慧醫療及人文、倫理相關議題。

briefs.name: 大數據技術實務應用
briefs.tags: 大數據技術, Big Data Analytics
briefs.desc: 以專題的方式探討人工智慧與大數據在不同領域應用的技術研析與問體探討。

briefs.name: 跨領域研究方法
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 跨領域合作, 研究設計, 研究溝通, 研究成果展示, Research Methods, Cross-disciplinary Collaboration, Research Design, Research Communication, Research Presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導學生掌握進行跨領域研究所需的核心方法與學術寫作能力，涵蓋從研究設計、資料蒐集到成果撰寫的完整研究流程，並透過 實作經驗逐步深化理解與應用。學生將學習如何依據具體問題與情境背景，選擇與整合適切的研究策略，提出具備實證基礎的創新解方。課 程前半段聚焦於研究設計與方法論建構，內容涵蓋研究問題的界定、資料蒐集與分析策略、跨領域合作的實務挑戰，以及研究倫理與學術責 任。透過案例分析與小組討論，學生將培養實務敏感度，並強化與異質專業背景研究者協作的能力。後半段則專注於科技論文撰寫技巧，依 序涵蓋文獻綜述撰寫、研究方法與結果呈現、討論與結論發展，進一步延伸至標題設計與摘要撰寫。課程將寫作視為研究思維發展與深化的 關鍵歷程，透過書寫的過程，學生將學習如何釐清問題意識、反思研究決策、修正論述方向，進而強化其跨領域整合與溝通能力。學生將透 過漸進式的寫作演練與回饋修正，有系統地提升論文的結構邏輯、語言表達與學術溝通力，最終能完整表達其研究成果，並與相關領域進行 有效交流。

briefs.name: 智慧型製造系統
briefs.tags: 製造系統 Manufacturing system, 排程系統scheduling system, 萬用啟發式演算法metaheuristic algorithm, 庫存管理 Inventory Management, 供應鏈管理 Supply Chain Management
briefs.desc: 本課程將使學生了解如何應用人工智慧與數據科學的技術，改善製造系統的作業效率。包含工廠產能規劃、存貨與供應鏈管理、排 程系統、啟發式演算法、賽局理論、決策分析、系統模擬、人工智慧模型如關聯規則、決策樹、集群分析、集成方法等，透過閱讀 研究文獻深入瞭解方法與實際問題解決的落差與連結，課程結合資訊與工程領域的相關知識，並藉由演算法的設計及統計的方法有 系統地建模以解決實務問題。

briefs.name: 大數據與商業決策分析
briefs.nameEn: Big Data Analytics and Business Decision Making
briefs.tags: big data, business analytics, AI; 大數據, 商業決策, AI
briefs.desc: In the era of digital transformation, data is not just an asset -- it is a strategic imperative. This course equips EMBA students with the analytical mindset, frameworks, and tools necessary to harness big data for effective business decision making. Designed for experienced professionals, the course bridges the gap between data science and executive leadership, focusing on how to interpret data- driven insights and translate them into strategic actions. Through hands-on exercises, real-world case studies, and interactive lectures, students will learn to apply core concepts of big data analytics -- including data visualization, predictive modeling, machine learning, and business intelligence -- to solve complex challenges in areas such as marketing, operations, finance, and human resources. Students will also explore ethical and governance issues in data use, and gain practical exposure to widely-used analytical tools such as STATA (no prior coding experie

briefs.name: 人力資源管理
briefs.tags: 招募，甄選，績效管理，培訓，留任
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹人力資源管理相關的基本原理和應用。希望學員們通過本課程的學習與課堂實踐，能夠： R26; 理解人力資源管理在組織中的作用及其對提升組織工作效能的意義。 R26; 掌握制定企業人力資源管理策略和管理制度的常用方法。 R26; 懂得現代人力資源管理原理和實踐中意義及操作實施方法。 R26; 探討組織中人力資源管理的現實問題。 R26; 闡述人力資源實踐在企業變革和發展中的作用。 R26; 結合課堂學習，工作單位的具體情況和個人的工作及管理實踐經驗，每個參與學員都能學習，理解，並且一定程度上 運用相關人力資源管理的知識和技能。

briefs.name: 營銷管理
briefs.tags: 行銷管理,營銷管理,戰略行銷
briefs.desc: 市場的變化一向是詭譎莫測的。2000 年以前，沒人會認為摩托羅拉也會沒落；2005 年，也沒人相信諾基亞會產生這麼大的衰退。對企業來說，行銷的重點，在於洞察顧客 需求、並替企業替客戶創造價值之後，更要能為自己帶來利潤，進而持續成長。本課程 主要針對企業負責人或高管，針對戰略行銷的相關內容加以探討，並搭配行業的實務案 例來進行講授，協助企業獲得更高利潤、達到成長目的。

briefs.name: 公司金融
briefs.tags: 公司金融 ,財務政策,財務管理,金融市場
briefs.desc: 1、公司金融課程涵蓋了現代財務管理的基礎知識，幷會對企業一些基本財務政策的影響進行分析。通過學習現代公司金融基 本原理及其在實踐中的運用，使學生瞭解企業財務策過程及影響財務策各因素相互之間的關係，爲將來的管理實踐和進 一步研究打下基礎。 2、本課程的教學手段是課堂講授與案例教學相結合，通過講課形式傳授公司財務方面的基本知識，通過案例討論加深對公司 金融理論知識的理解和實際分析能力本課程將通過（1）外請講座（2）案例研究和（3）對現代公司金融理論和公共觀點的討 論，使學生系統掌握公司金融和財務管理的基本理論、基本方法、基本技能；熟練運用理財技術進行投資、融資和收益分配 策。 3、本課程包括以下幾個主題: (1) 財務管理的目標爲導向，以金融市場爲背景，系統介紹了證券估價模型、風險與收益權衡 模型；投資策模型。(2) 資本成本的計量與分析；長短期融資方式的特點及運作方式；證券投資；資本結構和股利政策 等。(3)企業引進風險投資、上市、幷購、重組等。

briefs.name: 戰略管理
briefs.tags: 能力、定位、簡則、整合、開放以及賦名
briefs.desc: 本課程教授「戰略」（或稱「戰略管理」）。戰略被認為是所有管理學科之王（the king of management disciplines）， 其所講究的是經營者或是管理者為達到公司目標所採用的行動方向與具體作為。戰略當中尤以「創新」與「變革」為兩個熱門議 題，因此，本課程將特別著重在科技創新與變革戰略的介紹與討論，並分成六大主題進行說明：能力、定位、簡則、整合、開放 以及賦名。

briefs.name: 價值投資-公司併購與重組
briefs.nameEn: Value Investment-Equity Investment and Corporate Restructuring
briefs.tags: 價值投資,公司併購,重組,資產估值
briefs.desc: 課程將包括併購動機，盡職調查，併購交易結構的設計，資產估值，控制權設計與爭奪，交易後整合，其他的企業重組方式以及 數位經濟轉型下的公司併購重組與產業發展新趨勢8個模組。課程通過8個模組打造了完整的併購重組價值投資的知識體系。課程 不僅包括併購重組相關的基本理論知識，還將帶領你瞭解中國民營企業吉利汽車如何規避資本市場風險成功並購國際大公司賓士 汽車母公司戴姆勒；中國上市公司西王食品如何蛇吞象併購全球最大保健品公司加拿大公司KERR；國際知名高科技公司思科如何 通過與紅杉資本多年的“上市公司+PE”的協同並購保持30年全球技術領先等鮮活經典商業案例。

briefs.name: 公司治理與企業社會責任
briefs.tags: 公司治理, 企業社會責任, 可持續發展, Corporate Governance, Corporate Social Responsibility
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導學生分析、討論公司治理和企業社會責任相關議題與全球發展趨勢，以及與前述議題有關之法律及公共政策對於企業運作的影 響。通過本課程的學習，同學們能夠: 1). 明確理解公司治理、企業社會責任和可持續發展的內涵與影響。 2). 培養學生對相關商業倫理議題的敏銳度與分析判斷能力。 3). 深入了解公司治理與企業社會責任的概念，內涵與發展趨勢，並能夠運用於實際商業場域。 4). 了解公司治理和企業社會責任與商業行為的關聯，以及在不同行業的操作和影響。
