briefs.name: 固態物理一
briefs.tags: solid state physics; crystal structure; phonons; electrons; band structure
briefs.desc: Description: Introduction to crystal structures and electronic properties of crystals, suitable for beginning graduate students of engineering. Preliminary requirement: modern physics. Textbook: C. Kittel, "Introduction to solid state physics", 8th ed. Reference: Ashcroft and Mermim, "Solid state physics". Syllabus: 1. crystal structures 2. reciprocal lattices 3. crystal vibrations from atomic viewpoint 4. elastics 5. free electron model 6. energy band structures 7. semiconductor crystals Evaluation: 1. homework 2. midterm test 3. final test Teaching method: mainly by in-person lectures.

briefs.name: 微電子工程
briefs.tags: Solid-state devices (固態元件), Silicon processing technology (矽製程技術), VLSI (超大型積體電路), Etching (蝕刻), Thin film deposition (薄膜沉積), Lithography (微影)
briefs.desc: This course aims to introduce the advancement and detailed investigations of the fundamental principles used in the design and fabrication processes of silicon-based electronics for solid-state devices, integrated circuits, and beyond. The audience will gain a solid understanding of vital techniques such as lithography, film deposition, wet etching, anisotropic dry etching, crystal growth, ion implantation, and chemical vapor deposition of metals and insulators. In addition, this course offers valuable insights into modern electronics and provides comprehensive training in FinFET design and CMOS logic layout leveraging TCAD/EDA tools, equipping you with the knowledge to take this semiconductor journey moving forward.

briefs.name: 積體電路元件
briefs.tags: Semiconductor Device, Electron, Hole, PN, BJT, MOSFET
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide entry level graduate students with basic knowledge and training in the field of semiconductor devices that are mostly used in integrated circuits. The course content covers basic semiconductor physics, PN junctions, bipolar junction transistors, metal-oxide- semiconductor field effect transistors, and some advanced devices. The students will learn physics, design principles, and circuit models of these devices.

briefs.name: 微機電系統設計
briefs.tags: 微機電系統、微感測器、微致動器、感測電路、MEMS, microsensors, microactuators, sensing circuits.
briefs.desc: The promise of better performance, lower cost, and miniaturization of sensor and actuator systems has motivated growth in the field of MicroElectroMechanical Systems (MEMS). MEMS technology has found broad applications in inertial sensing, data storage, micromanipulation, optical communication, biochemical analysis, and microfluidic systems. This course will initially focus on fundamental MEMS topics, including microfabrication, micromechanical/bio/chemical sensors, and actuators. Additionally, I will introduce concepts in mechanics of materials, structural dynamics, and noise, all of which are crucial for understanding and implementing micromechanical sensors. More advanced subjects, such as MEMS system-level design methodology and MEMS control, may be introduced towards the end of the semester.

briefs.name: 太陽電池
briefs.tags: 太陽電池solar cells, 光電轉換photovoltaics, 能量轉換energy harvesting, 半導體元件semiconductor devices, 材料分析material characterization
briefs.desc: 本課程的目的在提供學生了解太陽電池的基本原理、設計太陽電池最佳化之半定量評估，並對目前新穎太陽電池之發展最 一簡介。本課程之先修科目為固態電子元件或者相關半導體元件課程。修過本課程可對於目前太陽電池的現狀、與新穎太 陽電池之發展有一清楚的了解。本課程預達成三個目標:1.了解各物理參數對於太陽電池元件特性的影響；2.了解如何由 所量測的電池特性，特別是J-V特性，來評估/分析影響太陽電池特性的主要參數，及如何改進；3.各種太陽電池的基本了 解與未來發展趨勢。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar
briefs.desc: This course is carried out in the form of seminar, and aims at introducing the students to various advanced or practical subjects which belong in the area of electronics, in a strict or more general sense. Approximately nine seminars in total will be given by different speakers, one per week, from industry or academia, based on their work experience or research achievement. The evaluation will be based on the attendance rate of each student, and how they try to understand and respond to the speaker. Students are particularly encouraged to ask questions in the seminar.

briefs.name: 半導體微波元件
briefs.tags: MMIC, Microwave, S Parameters, Devices, Active Devices
briefs.desc: This course introduces the properties of the semiconductor devices used in microwave circuits. Both active devices and passive devices are addressed. The concept and language used in microwave circuit analysis will be introduced. The equivalent circuit models of the devices for circuit design will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 半導體記憶體
briefs.tags: semiconductor memory, integrated circuit, device physics, memory array, technology
briefs.desc: This course gives a general introduction to memory types, operation principles, basic cell structure, process and fabrication issues, basic sense amplifiers, array architecture, etc. The course is designed for beginning graduate students who have basic understanding of semiconductor device physics and IC technologies.

briefs.name: 半導體雷射
briefs.tags: Laser Diode, Light-Emitting Diode, Semiconductor Device Processing
briefs.desc: 本課程授課內容從半導體物理到發光機制，發光二極體到半導體雷射，都將有極為詳細的介紹。前三者約需8週的上課時間，半 導體雷射也需可以8週的上課時間。本課程將有一次期中及一次期末考，期間也會有作業。半導體雷射則含括基本的寬面積、氧 化層條狀、脊狀型的增益型雷射，以及掩埋型、橫接面、表面發光雷射，我們將從原理機制、製作技術、介紹到雷射的特性及應 用。

briefs.name: 普通化學
briefs.tags: 化學，原子科學，分子科學，系統工程，能源科技，奈米科技; Chemistry, Atomic Science, Molecular Science, System Engineering, Energy Technology, Nanotechnology
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹關鍵化學原理，以利學生奠定未來在工程系統領域中深入修習與整合材料、熱流、物理及電子系統科技所需之跨領域 化學知識。

briefs.name: 工程圖學
briefs.desc: 學期末學生將發表一專題，以審視學生於學期中所習得的專業素養。 課程中主要以引發學生 繪製專題動畫為主。 當學生對於製作專題產生興趣，定會自發性的學習 圖學理論、繪圖軟體操作與技巧、包裝行銷等...結合成為一體，以迎 接新世代的電腦輔助設計與繪圖。 當然於課程中，亦會介紹傳統的基礎製圖規範、圖學理論、平面視圖、立體視圖等理論解說及繪製。

briefs.name: 核工原理
briefs.tags: Atomic and Nuclear Physics, Interaction of Radiation with Matter, Nuclear Reactors and Nuclear Power, Neutron Diffusion and Moderation, Nuclear Reactor Theory, The Time-Dependent Reactor
briefs.desc: With this class you start a systematic sequence of courses that are going to present subjects which distinguish a nuclear engineer from other engineering fields. On a simple minded level, the differences between the various engineering disciplines can be readily described. Thus, as you know, chemical engineers deal with chemical process, electrical engineers with electricity, civil engineers with structures and so on. In this simple classification scheme, the domain of nuclear engineers encompasses neutrons, nuclear reactors and radiation processes. However, reality is in fact quite a bit more complicated. You will find that a nuclear engineer you will have to learn not just about neutron interactions with matter, but also about hear transfer, fluid flow, chemical processes and even a little about metrologhy. In practice, the differences between the engineering disciplines turn out to be differences of emphasis rather than substance.

briefs.name: 程式語言
briefs.tags: 電腦(Computer)、程式(Programming)、計算(Computation)、邏輯(Logic)、解題方案(Algorithm)
briefs.desc: 學習「程式語言」的主要目的在於如何利用這個功能強大且具有彈性的工具來協助你解決問題，特別是一些重複性高或牽涉複雜 計算的工作。我們可以利用程式語言來控制電腦的運作，達到自動化的處理以大幅增加工作效率，這也是本課程的目標。了解電 腦工作的原理與如何建立有效的演算法/解題方案(Algorithm)是程式設計最重要的核心，打好基礎以利未來持續自我學習相關 的新技術。

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: ODE, Power Series, Laplace transform
briefs.desc: This is a mandatory mathematics course for students of the second year of study in the ESS department.The topics of this course include: (1) Ordinary differential equations: 1st order ODEs, 2nd order ODEs, higher order ODEs, and systems of ODEs. (2) Special functions and power series method. (3) Laplace transform.

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: Engineering, Mathematics, Ordinary Differential Equations, the Laplace transform, 工程, 數學, 常微分方程
briefs.desc: Engineering Mathematics I covers computations and applications of ODEs and the Laplace transform.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: 電路分析, 一階電路, 二階電路, 穩態分析, 頻率響應, circuit analysis, 1st order circuit, 2nd order circuit, steady-state analysis, frequency response
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course in circuit analysis for undergraduate students. The purpose is to give the students an understanding of various analytical techniques for describing the behaviors of circuits.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to develop in the students the ability to analyze and design electronic circuits, both analog and digital, discrete and integrated.

briefs.name: 電子學實驗一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: In this course, you will learn about the basic principles of circuit operation in a practical, real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational amplifiers. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester. Each class will be proceeded by 1-hour principle introduction (at 13:30 in R304) followed by practical experiment.

briefs.name: 電子學實驗一
briefs.tags: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs
briefs.desc: In this course, you will learn about the basic principles of circuit operation in a practical, real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational amplifiers. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester. Each class will be proceeded by 1-hour principle introduction (at 13:30 in R304) followed by practical experiment.

briefs.name: 熱力學
briefs.tags: Energy system, efficiency, heat, work, cycles
briefs.desc: The objectives of this course are to (1) provide fundamental background of mass conservation , the first and second laws of thermodynamics, and the engineering approach to problem solving, and (2) to develop analytic ability in real-world engineering applications using work and heat transfer.

briefs.name: 熱力學
briefs.tags: thermodynamics, 熱力學
briefs.desc: 熱力學為探討能量的入門科目，探討熱與功之間的轉換. 本科目的重點在於介紹能量的觀念, 說明熱力學第零,第一,第二,第三定律與其應 用; 如何決定物質的狀態(state) 以及所具有的能量, 用於熱力學第一與第二定律的分析; 以及推導Thermodynamic Relations,以 及如何利用 Thermodynamic Relation 決定物質的 Property.並會介紹如何應用熱力學定理分析常見循環。

briefs.name: 材料科學導論二
briefs.tags: 陶瓷材料, 高分子材料, 光電磁熱性質
briefs.desc: 工程材料性質簡介、本課程著重於基礎材料科學觀念之建立與工程材料原理之定性描述、陶瓷材料、高分子材料、光電磁熱性質

briefs.name: 偏微與複變
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Analysis
briefs.tags: Partial Differential Equations, Separation of Variables, Eigenfunction Expansion, Complex Variables, Cauchy’s Integral Theorem, Residue Theorem.
briefs.desc: This course is structured into two primary sections. Part A focuses on Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), emphasizing methods for solving equations frequently encountered in engineering and physics, including the wave equation, diffusion equation, and Laplace equation. Part B delves into Complex Analysis, offering a comprehensive understanding of analytic functions, differentiation, contour integrals, and other critical topics essential for various applications in engineering and physics.

briefs.name: 數值分析一
briefs.tags: Solutions of Equations of One Variable, Interpolation and Polynomial Approximation, Numerical Integration and Differentiation, Numerical Solution of Initial-Value Problems; Numerical Solution of Boundary-Value Problems, Direct Methods for Solving Linear Systems, Indirect Methods for Solving Linear Systems, Approximation Theory
briefs.desc: 該課程的設計，乃旨於訓練學生利用數值方法來解決工程問題的能力，以助益於其在進入職場或繼續深造時，更上層樓的使用與 發揮。特別的是，該課程係源於學生本身擁有的微積分、工程數學、以及程式語言等基礎上，再進階而成。深具按部就班、平穩 學習、步步高升的特色。是工程專業的學生，不可或缺的基本課程。本課程無涉及AI使用。

briefs.name: 數值分析一
briefs.tags: 單變數方程解Solutions of Equations of One Variable, 內差與多項式近似Interpolation and Polynomial Approximation, 數值積分與微分Numerical Integration and Differentiation, 初值問題的數值解Numerical Solution of Initial-Value Problems; 邊值問題的數值解Numerical Solution of Boundary-Value Problems, 線性系統求解的直接方法Direct Methods for Solving Linear Systems, 線性系統求解的間接方法Indirect Method
briefs.desc: 本課授課內容針對具工程背景與具有微積分、工程數學以及基本程式語言基礎的大學部高年學生。學生可經由本課程學習 利用數值方法解決工程問題之能力同時認識本系多領域整合應用的獨特性，對於未來從事進階研究或是進入職場頗有裨 益，是值得工程專業的學生深入學習的基礎課程。

briefs.name: 電子學三
briefs.tags: 數位，記憶體，訊號產生器，波形整形，濾波器，輸出級電路
briefs.desc: 本課程宗旨為學習基本數位與記憶體電路, 瞭解訊號產生器及波形整形電路, 並介紹濾波器及輸出級電路之概念 。內容包括CMOS digital circuits, Advanced MOS and bipolar digital circuit, Memory Circuits, Filters and tuned amplifiers, Signal generator and waveform-shaping circuit, Output stages and power amplifiers等。

briefs.name: 儀器與量測
briefs.tags: 儀器動態系統, 統計誤差, 誤差傳遞累加, 訊雜比提升, 感測器原理, 報告撰寫
briefs.desc: 本課程前八週將由李志浩老師介紹以下內容 Chap. 1: Introduction Chap. 2: Basic Concepts Chap. 3: Analysis of Experimental Data Chap. 4: Sensing Devices Chap. 12: Radiation Measurement Chap. 14: Signal process Chap. 15: Report writing 本課程後八週將由蘇育全老師介紹以下內容 Chap. 5: Displacement and Area Measurements Chap. 6: Pressure Measurement Chap. 7: Flow Measurement Chap. 8: Temperature Measurement Chap. 10: Strain Measurement

briefs.name: 儀器與量測
briefs.tags: 儀器動態系統, 統計誤差, 誤差傳遞累加, 訊雜比提升, 感測器原理, 報告撰寫
briefs.desc: 本課程前八週將由李志浩老師介紹以下內容 Chap. 1: Introduction Chap. 2: Basic Concepts Chap. 3: Analysis of Experimental Data Chap. 4: Sensing Devices Chap. 12: Radiation Measurement Chap. 14: Signal process Chap. 15: Report writing 本課程後八週將由蘇育全老師介紹以下內容 Chap. 5: Displacement and Area Measurements Chap. 6: Pressure Measurement Chap. 7: Flow Measurement Chap. 8: Temperature Measurement Chap. 10: Strain Measurement

briefs.name: 訊號與系統
briefs.tags: 線性非時變系統, 傅立葉轉換, 取樣, 拉氏轉換, Z轉換 (Linear Time-Invariant Systems, Fourier Transform, Sampling, The Laplace Transform and The Z-transform)
briefs.desc: This course introduces basic concepts in signals and systems and their associated mathematical and computational tools. Its purpose is to provide a common background for subsequent courses in electrical engineering: communications, control, electronic circuits, filter design, and digital signal processing.

briefs.name: 熱流學實驗
briefs.tags: Experiment; measurement; fluid mechanics; heat transfer; thermodynamics
briefs.desc: Laboratory experiments related to the areas of heat transfer, fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

briefs.name: 流體力學一
briefs.tags: fluid dynmics, viscosity, N-S equation, Bernoulli Equation, control volume
briefs.desc: Basic Properties of Fluids Fluids in motion - The Bernoulli Equation Kinematics of Fluid Motion Flow Analysis using Control Volumes Flow Analysis Using Differential Methods Dimensional Analysis, Modeling, and Similitude Pipe Flow External Flow Past Bodies

briefs.name: 物理冶金一
briefs.tags: 晶體結構, 晶體缺陷, 擴散, 相圖, 塑性變形, Crystal Structure, Crystal Defects, Diffusion, Phase Diagram, Plastic Deformation
briefs.desc: This is the first course of a two-semester sequence treating metallurgical phenomena and their utilization in engineering materials and processes. The contents in the first semester are mainly focused on the fundamentals of materials science including (1) crystal structure, (2) defects in crystals, (3) diffusion in solid solutions, (4) phase diagrams, and (5) plastic deformation.

briefs.name: 書報討論一
briefs.tags: seminar, oral presentation
briefs.desc: 學生整理學術論文並口能報告

briefs.name: 輻射安全
briefs.tags: 輻射(Radiation)、核反應(Nuclear Reaction)、輻射劑量(Radiation Dose)、防護與屏蔽(Protection and Shielding)
briefs.desc: 游離輻射在現代社會有各式各樣不可或缺的應用，使我們不知不覺間享受多種輻射應用所帶來的好處，包括核能發電、醫學診斷與放射治 療、機場安全檢查、工業非破壞性檢測、農產品照射滅菌、考古與探礦的應用等等。另外，輻射更是現代科學探測不可或缺的利器。輻射與 今日人類社會的運作息息相關且不可避免，我們生活環境中亦存在著各種天然輻射於空氣、土壤、建築物、水與食物中，因此值得正確地認 識輻射的特性，了解輻射與物質的作用，以利充分發揮輻射的應用、防止輻射可能引發的傷害、並減少社會大眾對於輻射的誤解。

briefs.name: 核能系統
briefs.tags: Nuclear Power System, Rankine Cycle, Reactor Engineering, Reactor Safety, Boiling Water Reactors, Pressurized Water Reactors
briefs.desc: Tentative outline 1. Introduction 2. Thermodynamics and Rankine Cycle 3. Basic Reactor Engineering Core Physics Thermal-Hydraulic Nuclear Fuel Cycles Safety Concerns and Design of Nuclear Power Plant 4. Introduction to Boiling Water Reactors Midterm Exam 5. Introduction to Pressurized Water Reactors 6. Operation of Nuclear Power Plants Three Mile Island Incident Chernobyl Accident Fukushmia Accident Tokaimura nuclear accident 7. Advanced Design of Nuclear Power Reactors 8. Generation IV, AP-1000, ESBWR, SMR…… 9. Public issues 10. Final Project Presentations Final Exam

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: IC Design, Digital Circuit, Analog Circuit, Circuit Simulation, Circuit Layout 積體電路設計、數位電路、類比電路、電路模擬、電路布局。
briefs.desc: 本課程為積體電路設計之入門課，學習積體電路設計之基本概念及如何使用電腦輔助設計軟體，包括簡單的數位與類比積體電 路設計，由製程、元件、模擬、佈局、至一個完整電路與系統之設計，每位學生必須完成一個完整電路之設計、模擬與佈局。

briefs.name: 量子力學導論
briefs.tags: 半導體，薛丁格方程式，量子力學應用，波粒二象性，原子模型
briefs.desc: 自半導體元件發明，量子力學之應用充斥在我們的生活。近幾年來，由於奈米科技快速發展，物質奈米微小 化，更顯出量子力學常識之重要。藉由此門課,了解量子物理如何成功闡述古典物理無法解釋之現象，如：普朗克常 數、光電效應、電磁輻射之粒子性、物質的粒子性、物質之波性、海森堡測不準原理、薛丁格方程式、原子結構等。

briefs.name: 太陽能電池原理
briefs.tags: 太陽能電池；能源工程；再生能源；綠色能源；光電科學；Solar Cell; Energy Engineering; Renewable Energy; Green Energy; Photoelectronic Science
briefs.desc: 適合大學部三四年級學生與碩士班了解太陽能電池領域的基礎理論課程 授課內容 1. 緒論 2. 光電與半導體物理 3. 太陽能 轉換發電原理 4. 太陽能電池的基本結構 5. 太陽能電池的轉換效率 6. 提昇太陽能電池效率的方法 7. 前瞻太陽能電池簡介 教學進度

briefs.name: 腐蝕工程
briefs.tags: 電化學, 電極, 鈍化, 陰極防蝕, 被覆, Electrochemistry, Electrode, Passivity, Cathodic Protection, Coating
briefs.desc: 本課程涵蓋腐蝕工程中有關腐蝕的類型、基本電化學原理與電極電位、腐蝕動力學、鈍化現象、腐蝕量測技術、陰極防 蝕、被覆與抑制劑防蝕、環境與防蝕、材料選擇與設計等主題，自淺而深提供學生腐與腐蝕防制工程技術的基礎知識、進 階理論與應用領域，使學生具備完整的腐蝕工程知識，並能於未來的進修或工作中加以應用。

briefs.name: 薄膜工程導論
briefs.tags: 真空技術(vacuum technology),表面動力學(surface kinetics),物理氣相沉積(physical vapor deposition),化學氣相沉積(chemical vapor deposition),薄膜成長機制與結構分析(thin film formation mechanism and structure characterization)
briefs.desc: This course firstly introduces vacuum technology and kinetics of surface processes. The major content includes the vapor deposition processes, PVD and CVD, and film formation and structure. The methods of characterization of thin film will be briefly introduced. To take this course, students are required to have some background on Materials Science (ESS2500 Introduction to Materials Science or ESS 3510 and 3520 Physical metallurgy I,II) and on Thermodynamics of Materials (ESS2510 or equivalent).

briefs.name: 電化學原理
briefs.tags: 電化學理論、熱力學、動力學、電解質行為、電極反應、綠能、半導體應用
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹電化學的基礎理論、熱力學、動力學、電解質行為、電極反應等，並進一步結合能源與半導體應用案例，讓學生能將 電化學原理應用於能源與先進製程。

briefs.name: 太陽光電創意專題實作
briefs.nameEn: Solar Cell Laboratory and Project Study
briefs.tags: 太陽能獨立發電系統 太陽能並網發電系統 太陽能電池混和式發電系統
briefs.desc: 太陽光電創意系統實作。講授太陽光電發電系統實作、、效能評估等經驗分享與探討，助學生提升太陽光電系統的實做 能 力。 授課內容 1. 太陽能電池基本操作原理 2. 太陽能實驗模組1: 太陽能電池發電系統介紹 3. 太陽能實驗模組2: 獨立型太陽能發電系統 4. 太陽能實驗模組2: 並網型太陽能發電系統 5. 太陽能實驗模組4: 混合型太陽能發電系統 6. 太陽能實驗模組5: 太陽能發電系統無線 WIFI 系統 7. 太陽能實驗模組6: 太陽能發電系統模擬軟體

briefs.name: 真空技術
briefs.tags: 真空,真空計,幫浦,測漏,真空封合,濺鍍,蒸鍍
briefs.desc: 真空技術是現代科技的基石，本課程主要探討真空技術的理論及真空元組件等，內容包括真空技術的基礎理論、各式真空 幫浦的介紹、各類真空元件及材料、真空系統的設計組裝、真空測漏，以及真空度量與檢校。從民生相關的食品包裝、眼 鏡鍍膜、電視映像管，到高科技產業中的光電元件與半導體製程、尖端的材料分析儀器，甚至龐大的同步輻射加速器，真 空技術都扮演著重要的核心角色。沒有真空技術就無法享受高品質的現代生活，也不足以從事高科技的研究。真空技術的 進步，不僅可精進儀器設備的性能，並能提升各種產業製程效能及產率，進而實現許多技術的創新。

briefs.name: 奈微機電系統整合與實作專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic on Nano and Micro Systems Integration and Implementation
briefs.tags: 奈米科技(nanotechnology), 微系統(micro systems), 系統整合(system integration), 機電系統(electromechanical systems), 工程實作(engineering implementation)
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹奈微米機電系統整合的基本原理與關鍵技術，並以工程應用為例說明跨領域整合與未來發展趨勢，同時透 過實作專題培養學生的專業實務能力。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究一
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science I
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究二
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science II
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 學術演講,經驗分享,Seminar Talks, Experience Sharing
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請電子、材料、機械、物理、能源工程、生物醫學、核子工程等相關領域的專家學者，於每周進行專題演講，並與參 與課程之碩博士研究生座談。 This course will invite experts from different fields, including but not limited to electrical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, physics, energy engineering, biomedical, nuclear engineering, to give seminar talks and experience sharing with enrolled graduate students on a weekly basis.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋，溝通技巧，專題報告，公開討論，專業互動；Literature Search, Communication Skill, Topical Presentation, Open Discussion, Professional Interaction
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide students with opportunity to practice their professional presentation skill, particularly in the scientific and technical areas. The students are expected to give a presentation on the topic related to their research.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: BioMEMS, Microfluidics, Biosensors, Fuel Cells, Hydrogen Energy
briefs.desc: 由奈微米系統工程組參與學生輪流選擇2-3篇與奈微米系統工程相關之國際期刊或會議論文做口頭報告。原則上一學期輪到一 次。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Thesis writing, Oral presentation, Critical thinking, 論文撰寫, 口頭報告, 邏輯分析
briefs.desc: 培養學生閱讀英文期刊論文能力以及統整與分析數據能力。課堂中亦會讓學生有充足機會練習論文撰寫與口頭報告。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻回顧, 英文科技論文簡報, Literature Review, English Presentation Skills
briefs.desc: 本課程為研究所必修課程，藉由學生報告文獻與修課同學共同討論研究議題以培養其具備科技論文之閱讀與簡報能力。 This course is mandatory for graduate students and aims to develop their ability to read and present scientific papers by having reports on literature and engaging in discussions with classmates on research topics.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 科技論文，閱讀，寫作，簡報能力，學位論文
briefs.desc: 本課程之宗旨是訓練學生具備科技論文之閱讀寫作與簡報能力。After taking this course, the students should be able to read and write technical papers and give technical presentations. 修此書報討論之研究生必須 先經指導教授同意，課程之進行先由各教授實驗室分別實施, 再定期集中報告，報告之題目應與學生學位論文相關之內 容。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 系統分析, 元件製程, 電路設計, system analysis, device fabrication, circuit design
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程。與本組研究相關的各類文獻閱讀、整理與討論。研究進度報告。

briefs.name: 微電子工程
briefs.tags: Semiconductor process, ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI), CMOS devices, nanoelectronic, FinFET, GAAFET
briefs.desc: The advances in ultra-large-scale-integration (ULSI) technology course based on aggressive scaling of CMOS devices provide enormous opportunities for high-performance communication, and computing Systems. This course is designed to provide the current status of advanced ULSI technology process and CMOS integration projecting a road map for nanoelectronic devices for the current and next generation.

briefs.name: 混合訊號積體電路設計
briefs.tags: 類比電路，邏輯電路，數據轉換器，放大器，差分放大器。Analog Circuit, Logic Circuit, Data converter, Amplifier, Differential Amplifier
briefs.desc: This course deals with the analysis and design of analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits. The objective is to help students developing a solid foundation of analyzing and designing analog/mixed- signal integrated circuits. The students are asked to do homework to analyze circuits. Final project will be assigned to the students so that they can design a whole system circuit by using the analyzing skills. The lecture covers the following topics: fundamental CMOS device physics, device model, amplifier circuits, operational amplifiers, frequency response, stability, and data converter circuits.

briefs.name: 電漿工程應用
briefs.tags: plasma discharge, plasma source, plasma applications
briefs.desc: This course provides fundamental knowledge about the basics of plasma engineering. The topics include gases, gas phase collision processes, plasma, DC glow discharge, RF discharge, sputtering, plasma etching, particle and energy balance in discharges, inductively coupled plasma source, electron cyclotron resonance plasma source, etc.

briefs.name: 電漿實驗與實驗設計方法
briefs.nameEn: Plasma Laboratory and Experiment Design Methods
briefs.tags: plasma source, plasma diagnotics
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to introduce students the fundamentals of plasma laboratory techniques including plasma sources and plasma diagnostic techniques, as well as general experimental design methods.

briefs.name: 材料分析與檢測
briefs.tags: 材料分析背景知識, X光相關技術, 電子相關技術, 其他光源技術, 產業鏈結
briefs.desc: 介紹常見材料檢測與分析技術(包含一般材料與半導體材料)。藉由介紹量測方法的基本原理與儀器，使同學廣泛了解未來 面對不同材料如何找尋適當的檢測工具。本課程不只表面介紹儀器使用，同時也介紹技術本身深層的數學物理背景，進而認識 到儀器的量測限制，除了提供未來可能的研究相關檢測知識，除了邀請三大檢測廠商介紹業界的實際案件之外，會增加邀請工 研院量測中心與儀器商介紹量測與儀器發展趨勢。

briefs.name: 材料動力學
briefs.tags: 擴散, 離子擴散, 化學反應, 氧化, 吸附與蒸發, Diffusion, Ionic Diffusion, Chemical Reactions, Oxidation, Adsorption and Evaporation
briefs.desc: This course covers the fundamental knowledge of kinetics in materials science and engineering, focusing on the diffusion and chemical reaction parts.

briefs.name: 同調光及電子繞射顯微術
briefs.nameEn: Coherent X-ray and Electron Diffraction Microscopy
briefs.tags: coherent diffraction imaging/microscopy
briefs.desc: 本課程為本實驗室專業研究課程將著重於光源與繞射現象的了解，並推展到多種光源與其應用。請留意學期成績評量的方式 為：以Matlab撰寫相位回復演算法，將提供之繞射影像進行回復，學期成績之計算公式以回復影像之正確性來決定。

briefs.name: 電子薄膜科技
briefs.tags: 薄膜,擴散,薄膜應力,可靠度,先進封裝
briefs.desc: It is well known that thin films are widely used in the electronic industry. Due to the trend on miniaturization of electronic devices, nanoscale electronic devices are needed and the technology and reliability of thin films have recently attracted increasing attention. This course will focus on the science and process of thin films, and reliability science for thin film application in the electronic industry. The topics will cover: - Fundamental topic in the thin-film process: deposition, surface energy and atomic diffusion - Theoretical and practical understanding of electronic thin-film reliability

briefs.name: 第一原理材料計算
briefs.tags: Ab initio calculations, DFT, electronic structure, quantum mechanics, modelling
briefs.desc: 奈米科技之快速發展促成新材料尺度不斷在縮減，故實驗未必能觀察到所有的微觀現象也未必能詳細了解其反應機制， 故理論計算能幫助解釋實驗數據甚至預測新材料特性，鑒於此，理論計算和實驗結合，是現今研究發展之趨勢，也說明了 理論計算的重要性與必要性。再者7-80%之理論計算採用第一原理（如，密度泛函理論），其應用也相當廣泛，從催化反應 （二氧化碳還原、一氧化碳氧化、水分解、儲氫等）、儲能材料、高熵材料、半導體材料設計等，故此課程為以 第一原理計算為主，重點在密度泛函基本理論與應用，希望學生對基礎相關理論能有概括的認識及了解DFT（VASP）軟體的基 本操作。 In this course, I will introduce the Density Functional Theory (DFT) and how to do first-principles simulations for materials by DFT tool（VASP）. I hope all students can apply DFT tools in their projects after attending this class.

briefs.name: 小角度中子散射
briefs.tags: Small-angle neutron scattering, quantum scattering, scattering length density distribution, microstructural analysis, intra-particle correlation, inter-particle interaction
briefs.desc: This course aim to give students fundamental understanding of small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) based on the applications of wave mechanics, quantum mechanics, and statistical mechanics as well as the microstructural analysis of materials using SANS techniques.

briefs.name: 同步加速器X光吸收光譜分析應用
briefs.nameEn: Applications of Synchrotron X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy
briefs.tags: X光, 原子結構, 奈米材料
briefs.desc: This lecture aims at establishing the student's analytic and practical experiment capabilities for materials science, physical chemistry, environment science, and surface science via the X-ray absorption spectroscopy techniques in advanced level. By learning this lecture, the students are expected to be able to conduct independent research in all kinds of materials sciences especially the structure analysis of nanoscaled energy materials and surface molecular sorption behaviors in ambient environments. 建立學生以X光吸收光譜分析技術對材料科學、物理化學、表面科學等各方面科學領域中的結構分析理論、分析能力與實務 操作。並以此基礎發展其在奈米科學與材料科學領域之獨立研究能力。

briefs.name: 高分子物理
briefs.tags: polymer physics, conformation, phase diagram, dynamics, scaling theory
briefs.desc: 本課程的教學目的，在使研究生瞭解高分子的基本物理性質及熱統計學行為，如高分子的形變、大小、分佈、相變、機 械性質、動力學行為等等。我們也將介紹高分子在不同領域的應用，如高分子刷、高分子電解質、高分子轉位通過奈米 孔洞、侷限於奈米微流道的高分子行為等。 奈米生醫科技及綠色能源科技近年來已成為學術界及產業界重點發展的兩大方向，亦是現行國家著重的研究重點之一。 研究人員從事相關研究及發展應用的過程裡，常需使用到大量的高分子物理化學的知識，舉凡對蛋白質、DNA等生物高 分子的操控及檢測、生醫微流體晶片的設計、奈米高分子複合材料的發展、導電高分子及新世代光電材料的設計應用、 表面改質及介面活化之分析處理、鋰電池、燃料電池及高分子太陽能電池效能的提升及發展等等，皆可看見高分子科學 在學術研究及產業科技所扮演的重要角色。於此鼓勵同學來修課。

briefs.name: 高等微系統製造與實驗
briefs.nameEn: Advanced Micro System Fabrication and Lab
briefs.tags: Microfabrication, MEMS, Semiconductor manufacturing, MEMS lab
briefs.desc: Using micro fabrication technology to fabricate micro sensors, micro structures, and micro actuators. This course teaches 12 fundamental and advance MEMS fabrication techniques, including cleaning procedure, lithography, thermal oxidation, lift off process, e-beam evaporation, reactive ion etching, wet chemical etching, micro electroplating, thick PR lithography, anodic bonding, wafer dicing, wire bonding, and standard process parameter testing techniques. The final goal will use those techniques to fabricate 12 different micro structures, sensors, and actuators, including accelerometer, humidity sensor, temperature sensor, micro mirror, micro cantilever, thermal actuator, flow sensor, micro channel, micro mixer, micro filter, and bulk etching testing structures, etc. Students will be broken into 4 groups, and each group (~5 students) must finish the the fabrication process of 3 wafers. This course is offered in English.

briefs.name: 分子動力學模擬
briefs.tags: molecular dynamics simulations, classical mechanics, statistical mechanics, numerical analysis, programming
briefs.desc: In this course, the concepts of molecular dynamics (MD) simulations will be taught. Proficiency in programming and running programs is a prerequisite for this course. Knowledge of numerical analysis, classical mechanics, and statistical mechanics is very helpful in understanding the techniques and methods of MD simulations.

briefs.name: 生化分析與實驗
briefs.nameEn: Bioanalytical Chemistry：Basic Principles and Lab Projects
briefs.tags: Biochemical analysis, Organic Materials, Molecular Engineering, Biochips, Bioconjugate Chemistry, 生化分析，有機材料，分子工程，生物晶片，生物偶合化學
briefs.desc: This course is offered for junior/senior undergraduate students and graduate students with physical science or engineering backgrounds who previously have no extensive exposure to biochemistry. This course consists of lecture series and hands-on experiments. The topics covered in this course. include: (1) Basic Organic Chemistry (2) Biomolecules (3) Modern Bioanalytical Techniques

briefs.name: 微系統設計
briefs.tags: Micro Electrical Mechanical Systems, MEMS Design, Microfabrication, IC Designs, Semiconductor devices
briefs.desc: Scope of the Micro System Design, the current status of Micro System Technology (9/11, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology I - Scaling law (hw#1)(9/18, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology III- lithography and IC process (9/25, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology II- Bulk micromachining (hw#2) (10/2, Tseng) Brief Review of MEMS technology IV- Surface micromachining, and others. (10/16, Yao) Introduction and hand-on practice of MEMS design software-LEIDT (hw#3) (10/23, Wei, final project team formation)

briefs.tags: two-phase flow, boiling heat transfer, boiling curve, CHF, nucleate boiling
briefs.desc: 教授同學雙相流與沸騰熱傳基本知識、流譜特 性、基礎物理模式以及能源方面的應用

briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 博士班專題研究一
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 於本所規劃之「分析化學」、「生態與健康」及「綠色科技」等三大發展領域中，在指導教授的指導下擬定研究題目，並針對 研究主題培養資料收集、實驗規劃、專業實驗技術及相關知識的能力，同時訓練系統性思考組織能力與實驗技術，提昇學生解 決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 環境科學與工程特論
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Environmental Science and Technology
briefs.tags: Environmental science; environmental technology; fate and transport; contaminants; treatment.
briefs.desc: This course is designed for Ph.D. students to learn advanced and comprehensive knowledge in Environmental Science and Technology. This course is also a required course for UST EST program. Students will receive a multidisciplinary training in the areas of environment, chemistry and biology.

briefs.name: 語言學概論
briefs.tags: morphology, syntax, phonetics, phonology
briefs.desc: Linguistics is the systematic and scientific inquiry into human language—into its structures and uses. Unlike language courses you have taken before, we will not concentrate on any specific language, but rather examine the general principles that underlie human languages, e.g., how sounds are combined into words; how words are formed and how they are combined into sentences, etc.

briefs.name: 西洋文學概論一
briefs.tags: Greek mythology, Homer
briefs.desc: This course introduces the first-year student of literature to some of the major concepts, themes, as well as some of the most famous narratives, characters, and literary forms of the western literary tradition. The aim of such a course is to provide students the basic tools, concepts, and reading knowledge for more advanced study of western literature in upper-level courses beyond their first year at the university. While such a course does not offer a comprehensive coverage of all the major texts of western literature, it conceptualizes the western literary tradition as a series of debates and issues for discussion. We will analyze the literary texts in their historical, cultural, and political contexts, and we will examine the significance of these texts for the western literary tradition.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: English Reading, Speaking, listening skills, impromptu speaking skills
briefs.desc: The aim of this course is to enhance students' critical English reading abilities and develop more formal discussion skills focusing on critical reading of and reference to source materials. In this class, students will read a variety of texts with enhanced fluency following coherent and effective use of reading strategies. Students will also build-up impromptu speaking skills to actively engage in leading a discussion with a critical perspective (e.g., distinguishing between fact and opinion, evaluating sources, and identifying points of view). Discussion skills will be practiced in a variety of formats including whole-class analysis of topical issues, problem-solving group work, or short individual oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers.
briefs.desc: Course Goals / Description: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers. Students will learn how to understand and analyze texts through asking questions, making predictions, drawing inferences, and identifying the main idea. Further, students are expected to read extensively outside of class time.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: discussion, critical thinking, work analysis, skill implementation, life reflection
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide a toolkit to develop fundamental skills and mindsets for 21st century success. The purpose of the compiled contents is to equip young adults to transit from the academic setting into the 21st century work field hoping to aim for a smoother transition in the near future. The course seeks to inspire, develop, guide and provide support for life-related issues. Students are required to read articles from major news agencies and professional development websites then come to class for topical discussion and skill-building tasks.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: English, reading, academic Englsih, technology, literature
briefs.desc: This course is to help students get familiar with different genres of reading material, and then get involved with in-depth processing of such reading material by rephrasing, reflecting, responding, and resonating with designated these material. The overall goal is to guide students through integrating language skills, i.e., reading, writing, listening and speaking, to develop their own English proficiency and to promote students' interaction and communication with peers via language competency.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies.
briefs.desc: Course Goals / Description: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies. Students will further develop listening skills (e.g. identifying main ideas and details, making inferences, and analyzing what you have heard) through listening to authentic materials related to culture, news, and current events. Students will also develop discussion skills through a variety of interactive activities. By the end of the course, students will learn to: 1. comprehend listening materials which cover more specialized or sophisticated topics, 2. identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening material, 3. lead and participate in effective group discussions and deliver oral presentations.

The course seeks to inspire, develop, guide and provide support for life-related issues. briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講

briefs.desc: This course aims to advance students’ listening and speaking skills Students will further develop listening skills (e.g., identifying main ideas, details, making inferences, and note-taking) through less simplified and authentic listening materials. Students wi through a variety of listening genres and systematic guidelines that help students through strategies and critical-thinking skills that help students for academic achievement.ll also develop discussion skills through a variety of interactive activities. By the end of the course, students will learn to: 1. comprehend listening materials which cover more specialized or sophisticated topics, 2. identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening material , 3. lead and participate in effective group discussions and deliver oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: English proficiency in academic speaking and listening, textbook course plan, up-to-date and real-world English, students of critical thinking in English
briefs.desc: The course is designed to cultivate students’ English proficiency in academic speaking and listening by providing speaking and listening trainings and practices on academic/formal presentations, lectures and talks. To achieve the goal, students will be instructed on key listening skills by the textbook, along with vocabulary and reading skills as needed, and assigned topic-oriented tasks on listening and speaking to step by step develop English academic proficiency in both targeted learning areas. In addition to textbook course plan, up-to-date and real-world English is also introduced and incorporated into the syllabus to help students overcome English challenges in their majors and undergraduate education. Above all, students are encouraged and motivated to generate ideas and formulate their own opinions of topics assigned and discussed in the classes through each given learning task. briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: 密集輕鬆英語會話, 演講, 討論, 英語求職 . English conversation, public speaking, discussion, job hunting, role play
briefs.desc: This course is similar to the idea of "Teaching English without Teaching English" (TED talk by Dr.Roberto Guzman) with emphasis on critical thinking as well as hands on language development skills. AI usage is allowed only for revision of your homework and needs to be specified. This course will focus on: 1.Enhancing students' speaking competence and confidence through intensive communicative activities. 2.Enabling students to use English for job hunting, public presentation and multi- role play through the modified International Toastmaster Program. 3.Broadening students' horizons and establishing students'critical thinking through international news report. Teaching material: handouts and video clips.

briefs.name: 文學作品讀法一
briefs.tags: literature, analysis, cultural studies, reading comprehension, writing skills
briefs.desc: This course aims to prepare students' ability of comprehension, appreciation and critical thinking on literature works. Students will achieve the goal through study of canonical works, presentation of historical and cultural backgrounds, and most likely their preparation for exams.

briefs.name: 英語聽講一
briefs.tags: English Speaking, English Listening, Language Skills, Oral Communication, Advanced English Learners
briefs.desc: This course is designed for first-year students majoring in Foreign Languages and Literature. The primary goal is to strengthen students’ oral-aural skills, enabling them to effectively comprehend and communicate ideas in an English-speaking context. Through active participation in class, students are expected to improve their accuracy, fluency, and overall communication skills. The course utilizes diverse listening materials such as sitcoms and TED talks, and incorporates various speaking activities including pair work, oral presentations, and class discussions. Formative assessments such as exercises, quizzes, and assignments will be conducted throughout the semester to ensure continuous improvement and practical application of skills. At the end of the class, students are required to deliver a prepared talk and complete a final exam to demonstrate the progress they have made in listening and speaking English.

briefs.name: 英語聽講一
briefs.tags: English listening/speaking, 英語聽講
briefs.desc: This course aims to improve students’ listening and speaking abilities through participation in class discussion and class activities. The students will get to practice English listening and speaking under different contexts, and they will learn to use English comfortably to communicate their ideas with others.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: English Essay Writing, Expository Essay, Nonfiction Book Review
briefs.desc: This is the first semester of a year-long course designed for second-year college students majoring in Foreign Languages and Literature (FLL). The first goal of this course is to train students to write expository essays in English. Students will learn to generate organized ideas to support a clear thesis statement and work through several drafts of their essays with the help of peer review. The second goal of the course is to train students to read self-improvement books written for the English-speaking community. Students will observe writing styles employed by professional writers. Through reading these books, students will improve their English ability, grammar and vocabulary, and expand their worldview.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: reading, writing
briefs.desc: This 16-week course is designed to develop students’ writing skills through the study of narrative craft, rhetorical techniques, and reflective writing. Students will read and analyze three texts—"The Strength in Our Scars" by Bianca Sparacino, "A Man Called Ove" by Fredrik Backman, and "The Cat Who Went to Heaven" by Elizabeth Coatsworth—to explore storytelling, emotional resonance, and persuasive techniques. The course emphasizes the writing process, as outlined by Purdue OWL’s Writing Process resources, with a focus on prewriting, drafting, revising, and editing. Through discussions, writing assignments, workshops, and a culminating term paper, students will refine their ability to craft compelling narratives and arguments.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作一(上)
briefs.tags: essay, expository writing, academic writing, reading, thesis statement
briefs.desc: This is the first part of a year-long course designed to improve your English reading and writing skills. You will develop your ability to critically engage with assigned texts, participate in class discussions, and produce clear, coherent expository writing. Through a series of assignments, you will learn to explain ideas logically, organize information effectively, and support your points with relevant evidence. This semester, you will: R26; Respond to a variety of reading sources, connecting ideas from texts to your own experiences and knowledge. R26; Write multi-paragraph expository essays using strategies such as exemplification, extended definition, and classification. R26; Provide constructive, supportive feedback on your classmates’ writing. R26; Revise your own work based on feedback from your teacher, peers, and digital tools. briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養日語零基礎的學生具備日語基礎溝通與表達能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通簡單的日語表達能力。提升至日 語 JLPT N5實力。 2. 指定教科書：上}39;下學期《大家的日本語 初級I 改訂版》 3. 教學進度：上學期為日語基礎發音、假名習字與《大家的日本語初級 I 改訂版》第1-5課。下學期為同一本課本的第6-12課。 4. 課程說明：本課程主要以日語零基礎學生為學習對象。 (1) 上學期是學習日語發音與日語平假名}39;片假名的書寫方式，並學習簡單日語會話與名詞、動詞基礎句型等。以期運用在自我介紹、購物點餐、 介紹時間地點事物等簡單溝通能力（五十音教學進度較快，建議在課外勤加練習）。下學期是著重在動詞、形容詞等詞尾變化與相關句型，以期 運用在表達個人情感、動作授受表現、數量唸法等，達到適時適所的日語溝通能力並且了解日本文化。 (2) 利用書籍或網路視聽教材，輔以平時作業來培養寫作與閱讀能力。課程中適時加入相關句型的日語會話、日語歌曲或新聞日文以期有效應用本 學期的學習內容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（40%）、期末考（30%）、作業（10%）、小考（10%）、出席（10%） 備註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、?日語 Japanese, 聽力 Listening, 會話 Conversation, 閱讀Reading, 寫作Writing

briefs.name: 初級日語一
briefs.tags: 初級日語l
briefs.desc: 本課程從五十音至各課單字，以圖文並茂方式導入教學，並重複演練以助加深記憶。每課文法解說完畢後，指導同學短文創 作、會話、發音(配合指定教材CD) 聽力、閱讀等練習，並且每課小考&不定期隨堂考，以培養基礎日語之聽、說、讀、寫能 力。調和課程氣氛，提升學習樂趣，課程間隔時間開放同學點歌及影片欣賞，課程中安排日語遊戲/競賽/桌遊/日本國情與文化 相關介紹等活動，以認識與學習他國文化並導入商業、科技與觀光日語會話教學，擴展學習領域，將本課程之所學適宜地應用 於生活、職場，並透過日本語教育多元思考與溝通合作之影響致力於終身學習。

briefs.name: 初級日語一
briefs.tags: 日語 Japanese, 聽力 Listening, 會話 Conversation, 閱讀Reading, 寫作Writing
briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養日語零基礎的學生具備日語基礎溝通與表達能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通簡單的日語表達能力。提升至日 語 JLPT N5實力。 2. 指定教科書：上}39;下學期《大家的日本語 初級I 改訂版》 3. 教學進度：上學期為日語基礎發音、假名習字與《大家的日本語初級 I 改訂版》第1-5課。下學期為同一本課本的第6-12課。 4. 課程說明：本課程主要以日語零基礎學生為學習對象。 (1) 上學期是學習日語發音與日語平假名}39;片假名的書寫方式，並學習簡單日語會話與名詞、動詞基礎句型等。以期運用在自我介紹、購物點 餐、 介紹時間地點事物等簡單溝通能力（五十音教學進度較快，建議在課外勤加練習）。下學期是著重在動詞、形容詞等詞尾變化與相關句型，以期 運用在表達個人情感、動作授受表現、數量唸法等，達到適時適所的日語溝通能力並且了解日本文化。 (2) 利用書籍或網路視聽教材，輔以平時作業來培養寫作與閱讀能力。課程中適時加入相關句型的日語會話、日語歌曲或新聞日文以期有效應用本 學期的學習內容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（40%）、期末考（30%）、作業（10%）、小考（10%）、出席（10%） 備註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、A533

briefs.tags: 初級日文一:本課程90%之內容為基礎語學訓練(包括發音技巧,文法解說與聽力應用……等) 餘10%之部份則為穿插於語學課程間的文化導引(包含日劇放映,日文情歌教唱,日本情勢民俗介紹…….等 )
briefs.desc: 課程目標: 1期讓學員在習得基礎語學之同時,能拓寬國際視野,培養包容異文化之胸襟。 2幫助學員日後赴日洽商修習或與日人共事時,能因掌握日語之措辭技巧與日人之行動邏輯,而知己知彼,創造全勝. 3從五十音起教授基礎日語之文法、語彙、句型、聽力等語學課程。課程內容主要著重於訓練學員之口說發展與聽解能 力。課中並以文化面穿插切入， 依教材內容穿插講授日本之氣候風土、文化民俗、語彙源流、史地國情…等，期讓學員能深刻感受，擁有外語才能，即如 握擁開啟世界視窗之鑰。 範圍: 150音(平假名與片假名教寫) 2大家的日本語(初級一)之L1~L5(P1~P79) 3補充教材如日語重音符號判讀.姓氏讀法.字源由來.以及相關實物圖片錄影帶……等 4數首現代經典日文情歌

briefs.desc: 初級法語課程著重發音及生活會話的運用，因此每堂課皆有同學間分組對話，並與老師互動會話演練機會。以清楚整理的投影片講述文法規則， 並佐以法國文化短片，增加口語靈活度並強化聽力。配合課程適時增添法國文化的講述，法國生活經驗分享並介紹法語歌曲，電影及相關活 動，增進學生對法國語言文化的興趣。

briefs.name: 英語口語訓練一
briefs.tags: oral, presentation, prepared speech, impromptu speech, reading ability
briefs.desc: This course is designed to improve students’ spoken English and their communication skills. In part, by redefining their roles as non- native speakers, students will be discouraged from identifying themselves as deficient pursuers of “authentic” language proficiency. Instead, they will be encouraged, through practices, to elevate themselves from language learners to language users. Textbooks and other supplemental reading materials will be used to equip students with competence for expressing themselves in diverse social settings. Through class discussions and various class activities, including but not limited to impromptu speeches, dramatic (theatrical) presentations, hosting discussions, etc., students will be expected to master the arts of communication in contexts ranging from small talk to group discussion and formal public speaking.

briefs.name: 英語口語訓練一
briefs.tags: discussion, critical thinking, work analysis, skill implementation, life reflection
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide a toolkit to develop fundamental skills and mindsets for 21st century success. The purpose of the compiled contents is to equip young adults to transit from the academic setting into the 21st century work field hoping to aim for a smoother transition in the near future. The course seeks to inspire, develop, guide and provide support for life-related issues. Students are required to read articles from distinguished platforms and professional development websites then come to class for topical discussion and skill-building tasks.

briefs.name: 英語口語訓練一
briefs.tags: 密集輕鬆英語會話, 演講, 討論, 英語求職 . English conversation, public speaking, discussion, job hunting, role play
briefs.desc: This course is similar to the idea of "Teaching English without Teaching English" (TED talk by Dr.Roberto Guzman) with emphasis on critical thinking as well as hands on language development skills. AI usage is allowed only for revision of your homework and needs to be specified. This course will focus on: 1.Enhancing students' speaking competence and confidence through intensive communicative activities. 2.Enabling students to use English for job hunting, public presentation and multi- role play through the modified International Toastmaster Program. 3.Broadening students' horizons and establishing students'critical thinking through international news report. Teaching material: handouts and video clips.

briefs.name: 語音學
briefs.tags: 構音器官,聽覺感知,聲學
briefs.desc: 這課程擬介紹世界語言中的聲音的描述與分析。旨在提供： a. 構音器官的生理特性, b. 聲音的基本屬性， c. 世界語言常見語音類型的感知、構音和如何轉寫（特別是美國、英語）， d. 使用praat軟體來分析和解釋世界常見的語音在聲學上的相似與不同。

briefs.name: 語用學
briefs.tags: 語言學, Linguistics, 語用學, Pragmatics, 溝通, Communication, 意義, Meaning
briefs.desc: When do you use “that” instead of “this”? Why do we know “can you pass the salt” is not really a question and “I pronounce you man and wife” not just a statement? Does adding “please” to your utterance always make it sound more polite? Why shouldn’t you express agreement when your boy/girlfriend says they look fat? Why do we sometimes have problems communicating with people from a different culture even when we’re speaking the same language? We will try to address those questions and many others in this course. This course, primarily conducted in English, introduces the basic theories and approaches in the field of pragmatics and explores pragmatic phenomena in various forms of language and realms of life. We will learn about important theoretical constructs of pragmatics, such as implicature, speech acts and politeness, and find out how these concepts are realized in different linguistic and cultural contexts.

briefs.name: 語言與R統計
briefs.tags: statistics,R,quantitative linguistics,parametric tests,regression
briefs.desc: Life is full of quantifiable questions that can be answered by statistics, and so is language. For example, if vowels before a voiceless consonant is shorter than those before a voiced consonant by 20 milliseconds on average, is this just a coincidence that happens by chance, or is it really because a different articulatory mechanism that does the trick? Or, when bilingual children learn 10 fewer words in their dominant language compared to monolingual children of the same age, is there really some significant delay in word learning driven by multilingual language input? When English speakers respond to spring faster by 50 milliseconds after hearing bring than after hearing duck, can we say spring and bring are linked in their lexicon? In this course, students learn fundamental concepts in statistics and its extension in the field of language science and practice doing statistical analyses using R programming. briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.desc: This course is designed to improve students’ writing ability through process writing and the learning of effective writing strategies. Emphasis will be placed on pre-writing activities, self-reflection, reader/audience expectations, topic development, text analysis, organization, argumentation, critical thinking, research, peer review, and revision. Students in this course will explore differences between personal and academic writing, develop written fluency, and improve command over textual, rhetorical, and discursive conventions common in academic writing.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.tags: Writing, paragraph, coherency, word choice, research
briefs.desc: This is an advanced writing course that is devoted to training students to write better research papers. Therefore, students are expected to choose a research topic, conduct an elementary level of independent study, and write up their findings and arguments in the style of a formal research paper.

briefs.name: 閱讀與寫作二(上)
briefs.tags: 溝通,目的導向, 媒體寫作, 新聞,公關, communication, purpose-driven, media writing, news, public relations
briefs.desc: 以溝通傳播為導向的「媒體寫作」，培養學生對新聞與公關工作所需的寫作技巧，了解媒體與公關產業的運作與工作倫理，並學 習從「用戶」的角度來看待寫作。

briefs.name: 中級日語一
briefs.tags: 單字解說，重音，句型導入，文法解說，口頭練習，自然對話（natural speed），聽力練習
briefs.desc: 該科目原則上實體教學，不過，看疫情情形教育部有特別的需求時，用視訊方式上課。疫情如果影響到考試，大家討論 之後，有可能更改方式。 加強詞彙及句型。重視自己積極學習的態度，鼓勵學生積極參與學習語。增加培養自學日語之基礎（聽說讀寫）。 另外學日語歌，看DVD，介紹日本文化，習俗等，接觸日本文化。

briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：培養學生具有初中級程度以上的日語進階溝通與表達能力。透過討論、聽力練習與會話演練來培養溝通表達能力。提升至日語 JLPT N4-N5實力。 2. 指定教科書：上下學期《大家的日本語 初級II 改訂版》 3. 教學進度：視學習狀況與學校行事曆適時調整進度。上學期進度為《大家的日本語初級 II 改訂版》第13-18課。下學期進度第19-25課。 4. 課程說明：學習動詞活用變化以及動詞活用變化所連用的相關句型 (如 「V-形、V-形、Ⅴ-形、V-形、Ⅴ-形、Ⅴ-形」等)。 以其運用在「請求、動作進行貌、動作持續貌、動作樣貌、(請求)允許、否定、能力、興趣、事件、經驗、列舉、變化、口語表現、想法、說 法、動詞修飾名詞、條件句、授受表現、逆接表現」等各種日語溝通表達能力。透過教科書、老師的自製授課講義與各種網路教學平台等，鼓勵 學生模擬真實會話情境，熟練相關句型的口語表達與聽力內容。課程中適時加入相關日語句型的日語歌曲、日語新聞或日劇動漫台詞，以期有效 應用所學內容。 5. 成績考核：期中考（40%）、期末考（30%）、作業（10%）、小考（10%）、出席（10%） 註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、教學網頁、AI使用規則等請參考課

briefs.name: 浪漫主義文學
briefs.tags: Romanticism, English Literature, Individuality, Sublime, Divinity
briefs.desc: In this course, we will survey important British literary works from the late eighteenth century to the early nineteenth century to explore what it means to be “romantic”. We will begin by tracing the root of the Romanticism in the cult of sensibility and the Gothic to form a greater understanding of the unbounded romantic feeling. At the same time, we will also study the lingering impacts of the contemporary revolutions to see how the Romantic poets respond to the questions of freedom, humanity, and divinity.

briefs.name: 莎士比亞
briefs.tags: Shakespeare, English literature, Renaissance England, Elizabethan England, Jacobean England
briefs.desc: In this course, we will study a series of major plays of Shakespeare that cover the dramatic genres of the Shakespearean corpus. We will begin our course with the study of romance in The Tempest, move on to a further probing of love, family, identity, and power in a problem play, The Merchant of Venice, to As You Like It, a major comedy, and then on to the tragedies, Julius Caesar, Hamlet, and Macbeth. The course ends with a discussion of major history plays that represent Shakespeare’s own interpretation of English history: Richard II, 1 Henry IV, and Henry V. The approach we take to the study of Shakespeare in this course emphasizes literary form and historical contexts. Reading and analyzing these plays in terms of generic development and the playwright’s engagement with the events and major issues and debates of his time, we will examine these plays in terms of their connection to contemporary situations and historical developments. briefs.name: 中英翻譯習作
briefs.tags: translation, news translation
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide students with a practical foundation in English-Chinese translation. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and translation exercises, students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively convey meaning and style between the two languages. As an introductory course in translation, the focus will be on translating from English to Chinese. The course will cover a range of topics related to translation, including syntax, semantics, cultural references, and idiomatic expressions. The course content will encompass an overview of fundamental translation concepts, a comparative analysis of Chinese and English, and a methodology section that addresses linguistic and cultural factors involved in language transfer.

briefs.name: 心理語言學導論
briefs.tags: speech perception, word recognition, sentence comprehension, language production, language and thought
briefs.desc: This course is a general introduction to psycholinguistics. It covers areas such as speech perception, word recognition, lexical ambiguity, sentence comprehension, sentence production, language and thought, and neurolinguistics. We'll look at how language behavior illuminates our understanding of the mind and the brain, and how properties of the mind and brain influence human language. You will learn something about the nature of language, how it is used, and how it can be impaired.

briefs.name: 語言與大腦
briefs.tags: language, brain, aphasia
briefs.desc: Aim of class: To introduce students to the important concepts of cognitive neuroscience, to be familiar with and to be able to practice contemporary analytical methods for studying neuroplasticity and brain changes. Course requirement: Students have to preview assigned materials in the textbook before coming to classes. Students will be randomly called to answer questions in class. Each student has to turn in assignments on time.

briefs.desc: 課程概述 依照課本的進度，以口語方式說明韓文的文法與句型，並盡量與同學以互動之方式進行。 此外，介紹韓國文化及韓國生活。在練習聽力時，並輔以當代流行歌曲等來補充，提升同學的學習興趣。 為了介紹韓國文化與練習聽力課堂上將介紹韓國電影1-2片,如果在課堂上不想欣賞韓國電影來了解韓國歷史與文化

briefs.name: 中級韓語一
briefs.tags: korean, korea 韓文, 韓文中級, 韓國
briefs.desc: 課程概述 依照課本的進度，以口語方式說明韓文的文法與句型，並盡量與同學以互動之方式進行。 此外，介紹韓國文化及韓國生活。在練習聽力時，並輔以當代流行歌曲等來補充，提升同學的學習興趣。 為了介紹韓國文化與練習聽力課堂上將介紹韓國電影1-2片,如果在課堂上不想欣賞韓國電影來了解韓國歷史與文化

briefs.name: 中級韓語一
briefs.tags: 韓語、中級韓語、句型解說、實用語彙、韓國文化
briefs.desc: 本課程通過充分運用中級詞彙及所學的文法，進一步提升學生聽、講、讀、寫的能力。本課程同時著重加強口語訓練，讓學生能 使用韓語進行簡短發表。主要課題包括打電話約時間、說明計畫、介紹烹飪方式、聚會邀請和詢問交通工具及問路等。

briefs.name: 中級法語聽力一
briefs.tags: 法語聽力, 中級法語, 進階法語聽力練習, 法語鑑定考試A2/B1
briefs.desc: 以法文教材 DELF A1/A2, A2/B1聽力練習為主軸。上學期針對生活主題，廣播、休閒活動與個人資訊相關各類生活情境對話的理解及簡單口語應 答練習。下學期著重DELF A2/B1程度的進階聽力練習，如廣播節目與談論意見，故事與新聞等等。本課程可幫助有意參加法語鑑定考試的學生加 強聽力的練習。

briefs.name: 中級德語會話一
briefs.tags: 現在完成式, 副句的應用, 表達能力的增進, 腦力激盪, 文章詮釋
briefs.desc: 中級德語會話是銜接初級德語的課程, 相當於A1至B1的程度。共兩學期的學程安排,其目的是讓有基礎德語能力的同學一方面可 以更熟習、流利的說德語; 另一方面學習利用更多的字彙、較多樣的表達方式、較為複雜一些的句型來充實自身德語會話方面 的 能力。

briefs.name: 日語聽解三
briefs.tags: 中級日語聽解
briefs.desc: 本課程適合學完動詞基本活用課程之同學.課程中除了學習中級後半文型.亦藉由聽取整篇會話內容.確認同學對日語的理解 力. 另外透過測驗,讓同學習慣聽力測驗題型.

briefs.name: 商用英語會話
briefs.tags: Business English 商用英文, Negotiation 談判, Meetings 會議, Diplomatic language 委婉用語, Communication 溝通
briefs.desc: The course aims to sharpen students’ verbal communication skills and is designed to arm students with the language they need to speak professionally and express themselves confidently in a business environment. Through business simulations and scenarios, students are trained to use the language functions presented to resolve conflicts, give advice, solve problems, deal with business dilemmas, participate in meetings, negotiate, make decisions, promote products, and pitch ideas.

briefs.name: 日語會話三
briefs.tags: 單字解說，重音，句型導入，文法解說，口頭練習，自然對話（natural speed），聽力練習
briefs.desc: 該科目原則上實體教學，不過，看疫情情形教育部有特別的需求時，用視訊方式上課。 疫情如果影響到考試的話，大家討論之後，有可能更改報告方式。 用教材培養閱讀，朗讀，寫作及日語會話能力。重視學生積極用日語討論。儘量給學生朗讀和討論日語的機 會。另外 ，聽CD看DVD等，邊加強聽力，會話力，邊給學生接觸日本之文化生活習慣等。 大概N2Level的同學為主。

briefs.name: 從《哈利波特》學英文
briefs.nameEn: English Language Skills with Harry Potter
briefs.tags: English vocabulary, listening, speaking, writing, Harry Potter
briefs.desc: objectives are to advance students abilities in Reading, Writing, Speaking, and Listening; to expand students’ vocabulary in English; and to increase students’ knowledge of British and English-speaking cultures.To this end, the Harry Potter books and supplemental films are used for motivation and because of their rich and clever use of English vocabulary and historical and mythological references.

briefs.name: 高級韓語一
briefs.tags: korean, korea 韓文, 韓文高級, 韓國
briefs.desc: 課目名稱 : 高級韓文1 1,課程目標 (1). 培養韓文讀寫能力。。 (2). 加強韓文生活會話與閱讀能力。 (3). 提升韓文習作能力 (4) 了解現代韓國文化生活 2.課程要求 (1).在課堂上要積極參與。 (2).上課請盡量勿遲到 (3) 每位同學應每周都要發表1分種韓文 3.指定教材 : 《首爾大學韓國語4A》，日月文化出版公司 4.評量方式 (1).期中考 30% (2).期末考40% (3).平時表現 30%(包含小考作業、上課參與情形等等) 5.課程概述 依照課本的進度，以口語方式說明韓文的文法與句型，並盡量與同學以互動之方式進行。此外，簡單 介紹韓國文化及韓國生活。在練習聽力時，並輔以民謠及當代流行歌曲等來補充，提升同學的學習興趣。 七參考網址 : 1.www.topik.go.kr 2.http://stdweb2.korean.go.kr/main.jsp 3.www.yskli.com

briefs.name: 新聞英文
briefs.tags: 時事 current affairs, 修辭 rhetorical devices, 經濟學人 The Economist, 政治 Politics, 商業 Business
briefs.desc: The course is designed to introduce students to the characteristics and conventions of journalistic writing. Great emphasis is placed on honing reading and language skills that students need most in comprehending news reports and articles in English. Training in key vocabulary skills and knowledge includes connotations, loanwords, metaphors, allusions, and idioms. Training in reading is aimed at inferring word meaning from context, identifying contextual clues, and grasping main ideas. A selection of texts will be used to sharpen students’ abilities to detect hidden bias and to raise students’ awareness of cohesive and discourse features that tie a text together.

briefs.name: 高級法語一
briefs.tags: 法文文法與文化

briefs.name: 高級日語一
briefs.tags: Advanced Japanese,高級日語一,習得進階句型,奠定進階會話技巧,觀察日語表達的習慣與特色，體察日本文化
briefs.desc: <完整內容詳見PDF檔「114-1.Advanced Japanese I(Tue 234=ChunchuChang)」> 一、學習目標： (1)認知：習得進階句型；玩味日本文化。 (2)技能：奠定進階會話技巧；培養進階讀寫能力。 (3)情意：以日語與他人溝通，獲得成就感、增添學習興趣； 觀察日語表達的習慣與特色，體察日本文化。 二、用書：『大家的日本語 進階Ⅰ 改訂版』大新書局 三、參考資料： (1)『大家的日本語 進階Ⅰ 文法解說書』大新書局 (2)日語歌曲、其他與課程相關之資料等。 ◎ 根據本校公布之「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本課程「AI使用規則」為 「鼓勵課餘時間自主複習時擴充語彙量及話題深度、廣度，但禁止使用於（短文寫作類型等）測驗及回家作業各題型」， 以下為相關的監管機制： ●修讀本課程之學生應注意本門課不得繳交使用生成式人工智慧所產出的作業、報告或個人心得。 若經查核發現，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。 ●修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。 <2025.5.27, 2025.6.3 update>

briefs.name: 日語閱讀一
briefs.tags: 中級日語閱讀
briefs.desc: 學至中級程度,再來需要以解讀大量的文章來了解日文的文章構造.日文解讀與中文不同.以中文模式解讀日文將處處是障 礙. 本學期在閱讀文章中學得中級後半文型.另外透過同學之課前預習.讓同學們學得自行研讀日文的能力.進而往N2中上級程度 邁進.

briefs.name: 日語寫作一

briefs.tags: 西班牙語, 西班牙語文法, 西班牙語會話, 西班牙文化, 西班牙旅遊 Spanish, Spanish grammar, Spanish conversation, Spanish culture, Spanish tourism
briefs.desc: 本課程以西班牙語檢定DELE A2-B1程度為學習範疇及目標，承接初級西班牙 (DELE A1)的基礎，增進西班牙語聽、說能力。每 周課程以不同主題為基礎，並講解相關文法內容及補充字彙。每節課會有不同課堂活動(抽任務卡、角色扮演、室外拍攝影片、 九宮格口說練習、比手畫腳猜謎、討論西班牙podcast節目內容...等等)，營造沉浸式教學環境。

briefs.name: 高級德語一
briefs.tags: 進階德語，歐盟語言分級A2，生活會話，Lesen, Tiere, Musikfestival, Alltagsleben, Gobal und regional

briefs.name: 商用日語

briefs.desc: 1. 教學目標：教授日語商務禮儀、慣用表現等相關會話。透過討論與演練來培養溝通表達能力。提升日語 JLPT N3~N1實力。 2. 指定教科書：《30小時快速學習職場日本語》台北：大新書局。 3. 教學進度：以指定教科書為主，輔以自編商務日語教材與網路教學影片等。 4. 課程說明：內容涵蓋日本職場中常用的尊敬語}39;謙讓語等敬語、自我介紹、社外}39;社內商用文書、撥打電話、接聽電話與相關會話、訪問禮 儀、接待禮儀、面試技巧、服裝儀容等相關商務內容。透過上台發表與會話演練，來培養升學或就業時候所需的面試技巧與商務技能。教學方式 將由教師引導專業術語、慣用句或商務背景知識的學習。透過相互會話練習以及上台發表，讓學生加強商用日語的熟練度。 5. 成績考核：期中考（35%）、期末考（35%）、上台報告（10%）、作業（10%）、出席（10%） 註：教學方法、評量方式、參考書目、教學網頁、AI使用規則等請參考課綱附檔。第一週將詳細說明。

briefs.name: 蒙古帝國迷思(磨課師)
briefs.tags: Mongol Empire, Myths, Representation, Perception, History
briefs.desc: In this course we will be learning about the Mongol empire by looking at common myths of the Mongol empire and investigating how and why there is a gap between the representation and the historical reality of the Mongol empire. Even today accounts and representations of the Mongol empire in social media contain myths or misconceptions of the Mongols and their historical rise as a world empire. Most of the writers in history who wrote about the Mongols were not from the steppes of Inner Asia and had little sympathy for them. Nor did non-Mongol writers understand the nomads’ way of life. The popular images of the Mongols in social media often can be traced back to myths of the Mongols in written sources from earlier centuries. The aim of this course is to critique and analyze the myths of the Mongols, and to learn about the historical realities of the nomads and their empire beyond the myths. briefs.name: 書目學與研究方法
briefs.tags: Research, MLA, Literary studies, revision, Bibliography
briefs.desc: This course involves drafting, revising, and editing research papers derived from reading and analyzing literary and cultural texts. It aims at introducing the challenges and potential ethical problems that young literary researchers might face in the various stages of their academic career. To this end, we will familiarize ourselves with the MLA format, the key research skills in the field of literary studies, and the professional guidelines that help us engage with our peers and researchers in the field. Students will be asked to do close reading on novellas and short stories that each deal with a specific period and eventually produce a research paper that they revise and polish for a mock conference.

briefs.name: 反烏托邦文學
briefs.tags: Utopia, Dystopia, Scientific Rhetoric, Humanism, Economics
briefs.desc: In this course, we will begin with a discussion of the idea of Utopia and consider its im/possibilities. Treating it as a mode of socio- political-economic criticism, we will examine the good intentions behind drive for utopian ideal, alongside the underlying forces – biological, psychological, social, or structural – that continually sabotage such an ideal. To that end, we will study our primary texts and consider them through the lens of political-economic critique, engaging with the works of Fredric Jameson, David Harvey, among others. We will explore its generic features in relation to fantasy and science fiction, analyze its popularity within historical context, and interrogate how late 19th-century fears of degeneration activates the modernist movement and its utopian drive. Towards the end, in this twenty-first century, we would further bring in a reflection on AI.

briefs.name: 文學理論
briefs.tags: ecology, technology, critique, cybernetics
briefs.desc: This course will introduce students to major theoretical approaches as well as key contemporary issues. The overall aim is to help student develop critical strategies for engaging with literary and cultural texts, paying to both literary and extra-literary dimensions of these texts. This course is organized around specific ideas and concepts that have shaped literary studies in the 21st century. That is to say, instead of organizing the course either chronologically or into different “-isms,” this course engages with a set of related theoretical issues concerning the individual and the collective, the particular and the universal, power and resistance, difference and relationality, human and nonhuman, subject and object, etc. In general, we will work through these topics and see how they shatter the received knowledge and open up different ways of interpreting the world and the text. Rather than attempting to settle the debate among different theoretical

briefs.name: 英文散文敘述：早期清教文學觀點
briefs.nameEn: Prose Fiction: Perspectives on Early Puritan Literature
briefs.tags: eighteen century England, transatlantic study, English prose fiction, narratology, Puritan writers
briefs.desc: The topic of the seminar focuses on the institution of prose fiction in terms of religious practice, the change of mode of production, and the transformation of socio-cultural milieu in the eighteen century England. Thus, this is a reading course designed basically for a transatlantic study of some writers and their rapport with the rise of English prose fiction. By reading our way through selected oeuvres of these writers, we will work towards a definition of prose fiction and its multi- faceted forms of narratology. To become acquainted with a wide spectrum of the works of the long eighteenth century, we will study several Puritan writers, including Thomas Morton (1579-1646), New English Canaan (1637); William Bradford (1588-1657), History of Plymouth Plantation, 1620-1647 (1651); John Bunyan (1628-1688), The Pilgrim’s Progress (1678); Daniel Defoe (1660?-1731), Robinson Crusoe (1719); Benjamin Franklin (1706-1790), Autobiography (1771-1789). Thus, this is a study

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.tags: Research methods, 研究方法
briefs.desc: Language learning is a part of human behaviors. The goal of this course is to give students an overall picture of how to conduct a meaningful scientific research on human language behaviors. Relevant research methods will be introduced and the students will be guided step by step to work on their own research project. Towards the end of the course, the students are expected to acquire the ability to carry out a research study in their interested areas related to language learning behaviors.

briefs.name: 論文寫作
briefs.tags: Thesis, literature review, methodology, abstract, findings, discussion, genre, academic writing, APA,
briefs.desc: The course prepares you to write your master’s thesis. Through analyzing model texts, class discussions, peer teaching, writing and peer-reviewing each other’s works, you will be familiarized with the core language skills, grammatical awareness, and genre knowledge necessary for successful thesis writing. At the end of the course, you will submit a mock (practice) thesis proposal on a research topic of your interest.

briefs.name: 學科內容和語言的整合學習和全英語授課
briefs.nameEn: Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) and English-Medium Instruction (EMI)
briefs.tags: English Medium Instruction, Content and Language Integrated Learning, Bilingual Education, Bilingual Nation Policy
briefs.desc: Under the Bilingual Nation 2030 Policy, institutions within the Taiwanese education system has increasingly adopted Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) and English-Medium Instruction (EMI). Certainly, it has become a controversial issue in Taiwan. To make sense of all sides of the arguments and find their own position towards this issue, all teachers in Taiwan must have some knowledge of CLIL and EMI. The aim of this course is to familiarize students with the fundamental knowledge involved in CLIL and EMI. Students will learn about the theoretical backgrounds and pedagogical approaches that are involved with CLIL and EMI through reading the textbooks, watching videos, discussing in class, and doing a teaching demonstration. From the writing assignments and a small research project, students will explore research issues involved with CLIL and EMI. It is expected that the students who have taken this course will become a well-informed consumer of the CLIL

briefs.name: 語言學習動機
briefs.desc: This course offers an introduction to theories of motivation which has been applied to understand how motivation functions in second and foreign language settings. A major focus will be on discovering ways in which motivation interacts with language pedagogy. The course first defines motivation from a variety of theoretical backgrounds, examines the evolution of motivation theories and then moves into topics related to the application of motivation theories in the second language classroom. We will end with discussions related to research methods commonly employed in second language (L2) motivation research.

briefs.name: 網路語言教學工具設計
briefs.tags: language learning,language teaching,Meteor,NodeJS,CSS,HTML,javascript
briefs.desc: As the internet has become faster and more accessible in recent years, language teaching and learning are now frequently done online. In many cases, however, language educators have to collaborate with computer engineers to develop Web-based language tools, which naturally requires lots of effort in communication and trial and error. It is thus essential for language educators to be equipped with the knowledge and skills in Web-based application development to create the tools tailored to their specific needs. In this course, students will start from scratch and learn basic Web-based programming on both front and back ends to begin their own Web-based language teaching/learning project. Prior training in computer programming is a plus but NOT required for this course. Novices are very welcome.

briefs.name: 工業4.0與發展趨勢概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to the development trend of the Industry 4.0
briefs.tags: 人工智慧,深度學習,物聯網,可程式化邏輯控制器,工業4.0,Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Internet of Things, Programmable Logic Controller, Industry 4.0
briefs.desc: 在大洪流的環境中許多發燒的議題都隨時間消逝，工業4.0是少數仍受到重視與討論的議題，近兩年ChatGPT更是火熱，使用 與否都受到放大鏡的審視，但這背後代表的意義為何?科技領域討論實體虛擬、經濟領域討論產業戰略、文化領域討論人類和 諧共榮等，無論是哪個論述，或許都離不開機器與人或是人與人彼此的融合。這場全世界都爭相競爭追逐的科技夢，現在已經 改變人類的生活方式(通訊溝通)，未來勢將帶來更大的改變。 本課程旨在結合工業4.0理論與情境應用，以期讓各科系學生能1.了解何謂工業4.0；2.工業4.0對製造業的影響；3.以實務 案例說明工業4.0；4.實作展示自走車設計、基礎DNN/CNN以及PLC自動控制，修習本門課將對工業4.0整體領域建立初步的了 解，並一同探討在科技、經濟與人文在4.0中的衝擊與領悟。

briefs.name: 永續發展
briefs.tags: 永續發展, 永續發展目標, 氣候變遷, 公司社會責任, sustainable development, sdg, climate change, CSR
briefs.desc: 面對不可逆的全球暖化與能源短缺，當地球溫度快速上升，全球多數人口將成為環境的災民，無家可歸。各國應重視二氧 化碳排放的問題，藉由提高綠色能源的使用並節能減碳才能緩和暖化造成的災難。為了現在與未來後代的環境著想，所有 人都該保護環境追求永續發展。 聯合國大會於103年採納「永續發展目標(SDGs)」決議，並後續制定「聯合國後2015 年發展議程」。永續發展目標包含 17 項目標(Goals)及 169 項細項目標(Targets)。其中較為耳熟能詳者，為首要目標（目標 1. 消除各地一切形式的 貧窮），另外，也包括實現性別平等，並賦予婦女權力（目標 5.）及因應氣候變遷之目標（目標 13. 採取緊急措施以 因應氣候變遷及其影響）。 永續發展目標提出後，帶起一股國內產官學研各界對應的風潮，舉例言之，國內企業致力於讓其公司社會責任 （Corporate Social Responsibility）能夠對應永續發展目標而發展出所謂企業永續報告（Corporate Sustainability Reports，CSR）之概念。另外，於2019年美國時代(Times)首度頒佈大學影響力排名（University Impact Rankings）希望透過大學教育可順利培養出可對應永續發展對應能力的大學高等人才。 本課程之目的，希望讓大學生

briefs.name: 音樂賞析四
briefs.tags: ＃音樂賞析四 ＃Music Appreciation and Analysis
briefs.desc: 音樂欣賞與參與能力為文明與文化高度發展之國民所應具有的基本素養。音樂不若其他科學領域，不易立竿見影，但對於整體人民的素質提升，在潛移默化中卻是最重要的一環。 希望透過此課程，幫助非音樂科系學生欣賞音樂、瞭解音樂及接觸音樂。 進而主動蒐集資料並參與音樂活動。日後成為藝術欣賞的中堅人口，並支持 整體藝術品質的提升。 本課程以音樂史方式進行，概分為四學期，每一學期的上課內容依時代而不同，自巴洛克至近代音樂。學生可視興趣及需要選擇修習的學期數，數字代表內容的不同，非關難易，學生不需連續選修。 本課程分為若干組，由學生自由選擇加入。分組報告之前必須利用課餘時間開會討論、蒐集資料作成定案，再與教師作充分溝通方可上台。各組需共同完成分組報告手冊，並經教師批改之後分發全班同學。期望透過此方式增加主動參與及與教師互動的機會，並使學生就所選專題學習蒐集資料，以更深入瞭解作品及其特色。

briefs.name: 設計繪畫
briefs.tags: 設計,design,繪畫,drawing,描繪
briefs.desc: 非全然強調描寫眼睛所看到的事物， 而是藉由一種策略性的、有計畫性的， 把眼睛所見事物，設計重新描寫、分析組構… 描寫所看到與感受到之事物，轉化為視覺作品。 畫面最終的呈現不在表現繪畫的技巧， 而是藉由美術設計原理之建構與運用， 讓來自不同專業領域背景的學生， 能運用繪製能力來表達自己的概念與想法 培養學生具觀點的解析，激發個人創意思考， 在創作中展現自信與個性，探討自我與環境的關係， 進而延伸不同領域之間的關懷省思。

briefs.name: 中藥與近代科技
briefs.nameEn: Chinese Herbology and Modern Sciences & Technologies
briefs.tags: 中藥藥物、中藥藥理、中藥炮製、中藥方劑，及分形連續體渾沌波動論
briefs.desc: 課程將系統性介紹中藥藥物、中藥藥理、中藥炮製、及方劑等，並探討其與近代科學及生物科技的關係。其中涉及理論分析及 具體實踐。在修畢此一通識課程後，立足於系統及複雜性科學意義之上，學生將可訓練如何由實驗到理論建立其對中藥學、方 劑學、近代科學、及生物科技的獨立思考能力。

briefs.name: 智慧財產權
briefs.tags: 著作權法、商標法、專利法、學術倫理、網路侵權、生成式AI
briefs.desc: 1.希望同學了解智慧財產權法的基本概念。除了講解我國智慧財產權內容外，讓同學具備基礎的智慧財產權法與相關法律知識。 2.許多智慧財產權的問題，可以透過案例討論，讓同學更瞭解實際運作上以及各方的利益。故本課程會以爭議案例，帶領同學討 論及思考，掌握具體的智慧財產權法爭議問題。 3.智慧財產權在科技發展、網路應用、學術倫理，不斷出現各種新的問題。因此，本課程也會隨時補充這些新的問題，讓同學思 考在網路科技發展、生成式AI、網路應用上，對智慧財產權的衝擊與因應；以及在同學將來可能邁入學術生涯上，需要注意的學 術倫與智財權問題。

briefs.name: 繪畫創作
briefs.tags: 繪畫,painting,創作,creation,藝術
briefs.desc: 本課程透過繪畫創作的基本材料認識與表現技法演練，讓修習本課程學生能於學期內對繪畫創作有所基礎認知，引導啟發學生 自主性、獨創性之基本繪畫表達力與創作技能，讓學生有效提昇學生感官視覺之審美意念與實踐繪畫創造能力。

briefs.name: 基礎素描
briefs.tags: 藝術，繪畫，素描，Art，Painting，Sketch，Drawing
briefs.desc: 素描是進入繪畫世界的基礎入門之一，透過理性和感性交互使用，讓學生得以學習從對物象外觀精準掌握，到循序漸進地將 情感自然流露於作品中，除了學習精準的繪畫也能欣賞名家的作品；素描能培養學生專注力、觀察力的一種訓練方式，素描的 作畫過程是一種客觀、主觀，理性和感性交互運用的訓練，一種人生規畫和實踐的縮影。

briefs.name: 陶藝製作
briefs.tags: 藝術,設計
briefs.desc: 陶藝製作為藝術類別立體創作課程，結合雕塑與傳統陶藝製作。本課程注重陶瓷藝術賞析，與實務操作，使學生能學習到如何 欣賞陶瓷之美，與體會做陶當中的樂趣!

briefs.name: 陶藝製作
briefs.tags: 藝術,設計
briefs.desc: 陶藝製作為藝術類別立體創作課程，結合雕塑與傳統陶藝製作。本課程注重陶瓷藝術賞析，與實務操作，使學生能學習到如何 欣賞陶瓷之美，與體會做陶當中的樂趣!

briefs.name: 百年來的中華民國對外關係
briefs.nameEn: Foreign Relations of Republic of China, 1912-now
briefs.tags: 中華民國, 中華民國外交, 國際關係, 兩岸關係, 外交政策, 國際關係理論,
briefs.desc: 本課程將從一個新國家－中華民國，也就是學生及教師所共同歸屬的國家－於1912年的誕生開始，探討前一代政權所留下的遺緒和深刻影 響，以及新國家誕生後參與決策或實際的領導者如何運籌帷幄，再加上伴隨而來的內部社會在思想、觀念、體制上的連串變化並從而影響對 外決策；更重要的，外在國際環境的強大衝擊，特別是強權彼此間的對抗與弱肉強食所導致的一連串事件更進一步影響－－甚至是決定－－ 了這個國家在二十世紀大半的命運。藉由快速、客觀地檢視歷史，翻轉過去悲情式的思考，改以國際關係的核心分析架構，帶領學生以嶄新 的思維回顧與學習中華民國的對外關係史，將有助選課學生以更客觀的角度、更多面向的思維來看待當前中華民國的外交政策以及整體對外 關係。

briefs.name: 世界古文明
briefs.tags: 世界,古文明,world,ancient,civilization
briefs.desc: 隨著科技進步、交通便利，國與國、民族與民族之間，逐漸形成「地球村」的社會，已非過往的冷戰對立或是壁壘分明。而臺 灣位處東北亞，亞洲交通要衝樞紐，成為世界地球村的一份子，更是當務之急。據史界前輩高亞偉所述︰「所謂『文明』乃指 高等文化而言，起碼的條件要有文字」；因此，了解世界文明的歷史發展，不僅是加入世界文化的第一步，同時也能拓展同學 們的視野。 本課程的編排方式，共分成三大單元，包括人類文明遺產、世界宗教衝突、東亞文化融合等。從橫向面而言，內容包含四大古 文明區，即西亞、埃及、印度、中國，縱向面從上古時代至近代，以兩河流域為起點，依序介紹埃及、希臘、羅馬文明，緊接 而來便是西方精神文明堡壘—基督教，再接續論述與伊斯蘭教的關係。第三單元則以東亞為主軸，略述中國與印度文明區，以 及東亞文化的交流。

briefs.name: 媒體影響與社會問題
briefs.tags: 詳載於本課程授課大綱。
briefs.desc: 詳載於本課程授課大綱。

briefs.name: 現代藝術創作專題
briefs.tags: 創作思考 系列表現 美感 藝術創作
briefs.desc: 這門課程以創作現代藝術為主旨，本學期以自我探索為創作起始,藝術教育最重要的,是利用創作材料使學生體驗【創作】本 身.讓手作和心靈活動藉著這樣的課程,得陶養自身。當學生享受一堂自己盡情表現的課程後作品絕對有深刻動人之處。這和 藝術本身的寬闊與自由度相和。 清華大學的通識教育開了許多和藝術創作課程。現代藝術專題中有許多的原創與藝術表現手法都是作者們藉著觀察深思而表 達出來，本學期希望以繪畫與馬賽克等技法馬賽將自己的作品安置在清華大學的環境中.希望藉此讓各種藝術創作多樣的面 貌，能呈現在這多元而豐富的場域之中。 學期成績 作品三件.(繪畫/馬賽克) 每件作品同步 需要自述500字 *原始創意30% 創作技巧30% 完成度30% 課堂參與與表現(含出缺席)10%

briefs.name: 認識真菌
briefs.tags: 真菌, 黏菌, 黴菌, 菇菌, 地衣, 酵母菌, 生物多樣性 fungi, mould, mushroom, lichen, yeast, biodiversity
briefs.desc: 「認識真菌」介紹真菌的多樣性，形態及生態等。目的是有系統的認識多種真菌，明白真菌在生態系中的角色，與環 境、 文化 及與其他物種（動植物、人類）的關聯。 雖然中小學的生物課程中，對真菌學著墨不多，但其實真菌比想像中影響我們更多：各種傳統發酵食品、發酵機能性食 品、可食與不可食的菌菇、牆角的黴菌、皮膚的癬病、蔬果的病害與防治、食品的毒素等等，皆有真菌參與。課程中我 們將提及這些生物的多樣性、分類形態、生態角色、對人類及日常生活的影響，對於媒體上與真菌學相關的報導，課堂 上將提供查找完整資訊的方法，並討論如何判斷資訊是否正確。 同學可透過本課程知道多種真菌的知識及其與生活的連結，例如雨後出現在草地的各種菇類是否有毒，是否可以食用？ 毒菇應該消滅以免有人誤食嗎？爬山時常常看到各種顏色形狀怪怪的東西，是菌類嗎？為什麼要保護森林和森林裡面的 菌類，可以賺錢嗎？為什麼酵母菌可以製作發酵食品又好像會造成「酵母菌感染」？

briefs.name: 台灣當代戲曲
briefs.tags: 當代戲曲、京劇、歌仔戲、布袋戲、台灣
briefs.desc: 本課程以「台灣當代戲曲」為主題，藉近年在台灣的京劇與歌仔戲演出為素材，通過課堂講解、分組報告與影像觀賞（若情況允許，亦會安 排觀看現場演出或後台參訪）讓學生理解「戲曲」在台灣的演出內容、轉型、生態與生存狀況，藉此提升美學與文化涵養，同時也更能認識 台灣的傳統藝術與藝文發展，並能夠在世界傳統藝術的發展脈絡裡，替台灣戲曲創作與文化找到定位的可能。

briefs.name: 中亞國際關係
briefs.nameEn: Central Asia: Politics and Society and Contested Powers
briefs.tags: Central Asia, power politics, the Great Game, US, Russia, China
briefs.desc: 課程介紹中亞政治與社會，以及檢討中亞在國際權力結構中的位置。中亞從地域上來定義，泛指蘇聯解體後的五國；包括哈 薩克斯坦、烏茲別克斯坦、吉爾吉斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、土庫曼斯坦，還加上所謂的內亞地區，也就是新疆、西藏、相關周邊 區域。課程內容含括當代中亞政治議題，像是民主化與再威權化的爭辯、政治伊斯蘭與恐怖主義、公民社會、貧窮與經改、 民族認同。 中亞天然資源豐富，又有尚待開發的市場，特殊的地緣政治，也因此成為國際政治的焦點，引起全球強權(像是美國、俄羅 斯、中國、歐盟)，以及區域強權(像是土耳其、伊朗、巴基斯坦、印度)的關注，互相爭奪。這個課程不僅嘗試介紹中亞歷史 背景與相關政經社議題，同時檢討中亞在當前國際政治扮演的角色。 課程分為三個部分:歷史背景、蘇聯解體後的發展狀況、當前中亞國際關係。 第一部分、介紹十九世紀強權競逐大戲局(the Great Game)以凸顯出中亞區域的重要性，以及後續如何影響蘇聯與中國統治 下的中亞區域。第二部分、討論蘇聯解體後的中亞發展狀況，以及其他相關的政治與社會議題。第三部分、集中討論中亞的 地緣政治，以及與其他全球或區域強權的來往。其中包括各種發展中亞的建議，像是如何加強中亞&

briefs.name: 中東地區研究
briefs.nameEn: The Research of Middle East Region
briefs.tags: 中東,北非,伊斯蘭,石油產業的政治經濟學,清真產業, Middle East, North Africa, Islam, Political Economy of Oil Industry, Halal Industry
briefs.desc: 本課程教學主要宗旨與目標有三：一、增進同學對中東地區政治情勢概況了解；二、協助同學了解中東地區主要經濟與產業 發展情況；三、增進同學對中東人文社會與市場發展趨勢的關注與了解。本課程強調培養同學跨領域的觀察、資料蒐集與分 析能力，希望透過教師提供與引導同學自主掌握關鍵資訊的過程，提升同學在短時間內從總體面到微觀面，理解區域重大事 件、當地人文社會及市場發展趨勢的能力。在課程規劃方面，本課程將從政治、經濟、人文社會與市場發展等範疇切入，依 據從總體面到微觀面的途徑，聚焦在政治、經濟、人文社會及市場領域重疊的主要核心議題與趨勢的介紹，以逐步加深同學 對中東北非區域主要政治情勢、經濟產業、人文社會及市場發展趨勢的了解，並藉此開拓同學跨領域與跨區域發展的視野及 國際觀。同時透過期中、期末分組報告及討論，培養同學掌握中東北非市場趨勢，並就當地需要且臺灣本身具優勢之產業， 提出觀察與拓展市場建議的能力。

briefs.name: 版畫實驗
briefs.tags: 蝕刻版畫， 銅版畫， 創作 ，繪圖，版畫
briefs.desc: 課程說明 版畫實驗Print Making將由金屬板（銅板)入門, 蝕刻版畫 筆尖的藝術 藉著蝕刻的輕巧 將圖像描寫至作品之中 由於此堂 課以銅版為主，期望學生在此課堂學習銅板的蝕刻技法完成構圖、雕刻、及拓印等創作法。並非在訓練技法的純熟的作者或 著專業的藝術家。有別於一般藝術學院的教學時數。通識課程中的藝術教育最重要的,是利用材料使學生體驗【創作】本身, 讓手工和心靈活動藉著這樣的課程,得陶養其自身。 腐蝕版 (Etching) 腐蝕技法與其他凹版方法最根本的不同處在於：符號的痕跡，不是由刻或刮金屬版面所致。圖像是透過用酸腐蝕版面逐漸發 展得來，並以防腐蝕劑保護不要腐蝕的部分。腐蝕版的凹陷區域可以很深，在一些情況下是又深又窄，因此印刷時需要施加 很重的壓力。因為紙張是被強制擠壓入凹陷的區域，會造成某種程度的浮凸，好黏取油墨。防腐蝕劑必須均勻的塗抹以形成 有效的抗酸層，但又允許使用尖筆在上面描畫時，可以輕易又俐落的將防腐蝕劑刮除。它的基本成分是瀝青、蠟及松脂。一 旦防腐蝕劑經過煙燻並冷卻後，就可以開始描畫版面。進行腐蝕之前，版面所有不想要被腐蝕之處，都必須用抗酸物完全覆 蓋保護。
