briefs.name: 近代物理實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗物理; 近代物理; 量子物理; 光學實驗; 電性量測
briefs.desc: 配合近代物理或量子力學導論課程，操作物理史上的重要實驗，以幫助學生了解實驗背後的重要物理定律與其意義，並培養物理 實驗的知識及操作能力

briefs.name: 近代物理實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗物理; 近代物理; 量子物理; 光學實驗; 電性量測
briefs.desc: 配合近代物理或量子力學導論課程，操作物理史上的重要實驗，以幫助學生了解實驗背後的重要物理定律與其意義，並培養物理 實驗的知識及操作能力

briefs.name: 應用電子學實驗
briefs.tags: 電子（electronic）、電路（circuits）、雙極性接面電晶體(BJT)、場效電晶體(MOSFET)、運算放大器(OP)
briefs.desc: 著重電子電路實作訓練，驗證電子學課本之知識。實驗內容涵蓋雙極性接面電晶體（BJT）之特性，BJT 偏壓電路，BJT 放大器，場效電晶體特 性、運算放大器（OP）的特性，OP 之頻率響應，OP 之應用（加法、積分、微分、低通濾波與高通濾波），精密溫控器，精密電流供應器，雙 向電流放大器。

briefs.name: 應用電子學二
briefs.tags: 雙極性接面電晶體（BJT），接面場效電晶體 （JFET）， 場效電晶體特性（MOSFET）， 運算放大器（OP）， 數位IC及系統 (Digital ICs and system)
briefs.desc: 電子學基本知識。內容涵蓋雙極性接面電晶體（BJT），接面場效電晶體 （JFET）， 場效電晶體特性（MOSFET）、運算放大器（OP），電晶 體與放大器之應用，數位IC及系統。

briefs.name: 數值分析
briefs.tags: 數值方法, numerical methods, computer, software, python
briefs.desc: 這是清華大學物理系大學部的選修課程，本課程的目的是為學生提供常用於解決物理問題的數值方法的基本知識和技能，Python是本課程主要使 用的程式語言，本課程適合具備Python基本程式能力的學生。數值方法和程式語言最佳的學習方式就是實作，因此課堂上將結合數值方法的概念 講解和課堂中的實作練習，另外也透過作業與期末報告來增加實作與應用的練習。

briefs.name: 熱統計物理一
briefs.tags: Statistical Physics, Thermodynamics, Entropy, Thermal Equilibrium, Transport Properties, Phase Transition
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide you with a robust understanding of the fundamental principles for systems with a large number of degrees of freedom. Two historically different aspects of this subject, namely thermodynamics and statistical physics, will be covered. We will bridge the microscopic (statistical mechanics) and macroscopic (thermodynamics) descriptions of thermal systems at equilibrium, so that the laws of thermodynamics, along with their physical interpretations, will be clearer.

briefs.name: 光學一
briefs.tags: 光的波動性質，光的粒子特性，光波的傳遞，幾何光學，偏振光學，干涉。
briefs.desc: 光學的基礎原理及知識。授課內容含光的波動性質與粒子特性，光波的傳遞，幾何光學，偏振光學，干涉。

briefs.name: 量子物理一
briefs.tags: 量子力學 (quantum mechanics), 波函數 (wave function), 薛丁格方程式 (Schrodinger equation), 全同粒子 (identical particles), 對稱性 (symmetries)
briefs.desc: This course (conducted in Chinese) is to teach you how to "do" quantum mechanics. The basic theory will be covered mainly in the first semester, while a collection of approximation schemes will be covered in the second semester. Applications of quantum mechanics in quantum cryptography and quantum computing will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 數位智慧科技實作與程式控制
briefs.nameEn: Implementation and Program Coding of Digital Smart Technology
briefs.tags: 數位科技(digital technology), 自動控制(automatic control), Arduino, C語言(C language), 程式編撰(prohramming)
briefs.desc: 邁入21世紀數位科技的紀元，師生們在科學實驗教學上有更多數位科技的教學媒介與技術可以選用，近日AI與ChatGPT快速 竄紅讓科學傳遞與教育推廣工作有了全新的平台與詮釋方法。但傳統科學實驗中，每一實驗步驟、每一環節的講究，都須建立 在學生對科學的基本原理、定律和概念有相當程度的理解，並透過實務操作實驗培養學生具備實驗技能和邏輯判斷、測量技術 和數據分析的能力。然而，這些技能的養成是無法被AI和ChatGPT全然取代的。 若邏輯推理的養成與實驗技能的實務操作也都交給AI代勞，則在不久的未來恐對人腦與手巧的退化產生一定的風險，也勢必 對未來人類科學的發展產生不確定性的影響。 如何結合現代科技帶來的便利與精確性，減少實驗上不必要的錯誤，提升學生的學習興趣與科學素養的養成，但卻依舊能保持 最重要的實驗探究精神?本課程透過機電整合、數位科技與程式設計的相輔相成，與老師們分享如何在數位時代中仍能保有傳 統的實驗精隨。

briefs.name: 基礎天文觀測
briefs.tags: 天文, Astronomy, 天文觀測, Astronomical Observations, 天文物理, Astrophysics
briefs.desc: This is an introduction course to fundamental observational techniques of astronomy.

briefs.name: 計算物理
briefs.tags: 電腦模擬，物理系統，統計力學模型，量子力學模型。
briefs.desc: 學習如何使用電腦模擬各種物理系統，尤其是統計力學模型及量子力學模型。

briefs.name: 相對論導論一
briefs.tags: special and general relativity
briefs.desc: 一、課程說明(Course Description) 相對論導論(一)(二)為介紹廣義相對論的一門課程. 適合大三（含) 以上及研究所同學. 第一學期著重廣義相對論理論之建立. 雖然從 狹義相對論開始, 但以為廣義相對論做準備為目的. 第二學期著重廣義相對論之應用. 如: 重力波,黑洞,宇宙論. Reading Guideline Before Lectures: This course is on General Relativity. Although the course begins with a review on Special Relativity, it adopts the geometric approach for the preparation for General Relativity. It assumes that you are familiar with: 1. Special Relativity, especially in the four-dimensional form, 2. Electromagnetism in the four-dimensional form, 3. Electromagnetism in Gaussian units. If you are not familiar with the above subjects, you need to review or study them before the class begins.

briefs.name: 基本粒子物理導論一
briefs.tags: Particle Physics, Standard Model, Particle Phenomenology, Dark Matter, Collider physics
briefs.desc: Teach the basic knowledge of elementary particle physics. Introduce the historical developments and current research status, for example, the structure of Standard Model, various dark matter candidates, how to search new particles at collider, and other particle phenomenology. The students can learn the fundamental computations of particle processes, like Feynman diagrams, decay rate, scattering cross section, preparing for advance research skill. On top of that, help students develop interests in particle physics. Furthermore, we will perform computer programing to demonstrate the numerical calculations during class.

briefs.name: 固態物理導論一
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Solid State Physics I
briefs.tags: Condensed Matter Physics, Experimental Methods, Prinicipal Properties, Advanced Course, Introduction
briefs.desc: Introduction to Solid State Physics I gives a deeper insight into the physical properties of ordered matter structures with a special emphasize on experimental methods. The course is designed to be complementary to the MSc Course Condensed Matter Physics (CMP) with a stronger focus on principal aspects. In comparison to CMP, the required mathematical background is oriented to BSc students and replaced by a deeper coverage of experimental aspects. The course is explicitly suitable and designed to prepare students for a coming MSc thesis in experimental or theoretical condensed matter physics.

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 專題研究--物理教學一
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Teaching Physics I
briefs.tags: special topic on teaching physics
briefs.desc: 為培育學生具備物理教學能力，增進溝通、協調與整合之技巧，提供學生經由擔任課程助教接受授課教師指導，獲得教學實習之 經驗，厚植教學實力，並於該相關專業科目中汲取研究能量，發揮所長。

briefs.name: 專題研究--物理教學三
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Teaching Physics III
briefs.tags: special topic on teaching physics,物理教學與演示
briefs.desc: 為培育學生具備物理教學能力，增進溝通、協調與整合之技巧，提供學生經由擔任課程助教接受授課教師指導，獲得教學實習之 經驗，厚植教學實力，並於該相關專業科目中汲取研究能量，發揮所長。

briefs.name: 光電實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗(experiment), 雷射(laser), 高斯光束(Gaussian beam), 鎖相放大器(lock-in amplifier), 光子統計(photon statistics), 飽和光譜(saturation spectroscopy), 拉曼光譜(Raman spectroscopy)
briefs.desc: 光電實驗是物理系碩士班光電物理組必修的實驗課程，內容以雷射特性及光譜為主。學生將學習雷射和光學儀器基本原 理、使用和操作。此外將教導學生如何做實驗紀錄。 English syllabus will be prepared for foreign students at first class meeting.

briefs.name: 量子科技實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗課程 lab course, 量子科技 quantum science and technology, 量子光學 quantum optics, 量子位元 NV-center qubit
briefs.desc: There are two main tracks of this lab course: (1) quantum foundation, and (2) quantum control. We will explore various topics in quantum foundation by performing some classic single-photon experiments (quantum optics lab), while sophisticated quantum control protocols will be implemented with Nitrogen-vacancy centers and microwave sequences (quantum spin lab). *本課程為英語授課 (EMI計劃)

briefs.name: 古典力學
briefs.tags: Theoretical mechanics, Newtonian mechanics, Hamiltonian mechanics, Lagrangian mechanics, Statistical mechanics, black hole,
briefs.desc: Modern classical mechanics: a tour of theoretical physics The subjects and scope of classical mechanics is often defined by the classic exposition of Goldstein. However standard applications such as oscillations, rigid bodies are not really appealing or sufficiently relevant to real life. Boardly speaking, mechanics is the study of cause and effects, formulated in terms of concepts about space, time and matter (with properties such as mass, charge, energy and force etc). This way of thinking, originally invented by Newton, have become the primary language physicsist use to describe the Nature. In this course, we take a modern and novel approach to classical mechanics. Instead of focusing on properties of mechanical system (such as oscillations, eigenmodes, rigid bodies, canonical transformations) as often exposited in classical textbook of the subject, e.g. Goldstein, we will try to take an interdiscipilinary approach and help students to appreciate how alm

briefs.name: 統計力學二
briefs.tags: Renormalization group, Ginzburg-Landau theory, topological phases, quantum statistical mechanics, quantum many-body scars
briefs.desc: This course explores the collective behavior of interacting many-body systems, extending beyond the topics covered in Statistical Mechanics I. We begin with the classification of phases of matter using the Ginzburg–Landau theory and introduce the conceptual framework and physical meaning of the renormalization group. Equipped with these tools, we revisit phase transitions in bosonic and fermionic systems and examine exotic phases of matter that lie beyond the conventional Ginzburg–Landau paradigm, including topological phases and symmetry-protected topological order. In the second part of the course, we delve into modern developments in quantum statistical mechanics. We will discuss the dynamics of isolated quantum systems, the emergence of thermalization through the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH), and mechanisms of ergodicity breaking. Special attention will be given to quantum many-body scars, a novel class of atypical eigenstates that evade ther

briefs.name: 流體力學
briefs.tags: Fluid Mechanics for Physics Students
briefs.desc: A. This course is designed for physics students, and is very different from usual fluid mechanics courses for engineering students. B. It emphasizes physics concepts in fluid mechanics and related topics, and uses a lot of order-of-magnitude estimates to explain the physics concepts. It is a good place for physics students to learn order-of-magnitude estimates. C. The lectures will be in Chinese.

briefs.name: 電動力學一
briefs.tags: Electrostatics, Boundary-Value Problems, Magnetostatics, Maxwell Equations, Electromagnetism
briefs.desc: We have studied electromagnetism in two courses before: General Physics II (freshman) and Electromagnetism (sophomore). What is new in this course? Electrodynamics will deal with the “same” Maxwell equations but from a more in-depth perspective. We are going to introduce a powerful tool, the Green function, to solve the electrostatic, magnetostatic, and even electromagnetic problems. To do that, we unavoidably have to learn the mathematics in spherical and cylindrical coordinates.

briefs.name: 微波物理與應用一
briefs.tags: Microwave, Networks, Transmission Line, Impedance Matching, Resonators
briefs.desc: The contents of this course are designed for senior and graduate level students. Only passive devices are addressed. This book shows that microwave circuits and devices can be explained through the use of circuit theory, Maxwell’s equations, and related concepts. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to raise your hand. Any comments on improving the pedagogy are more than welcome and highly appreciated.

briefs.name: 量子力學一
briefs.tags: quantum mechanics, Hilbert space, operators, symmetries, angular momentum, path integral
briefs.desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to quantum mechanics, following the structure and pedagogical approach of Principles of Quantum Mechanics by R. Shankar. Beginning with a review of the necessary mathematical tools, such as linear algebra and operator theory, the course progresses to foundational postulates, the Schodinger equation, and the formalism of Hilbert spaces. In the first semester, we would cover Chapter 1-13 with key topics including wave functions, observables, commutation relations, path integral, symmetries and angular momentum.

briefs.name: 凝態物理一
briefs.tags: condensed matter physics
briefs.desc: Condensed matter physics is a broad subject that is closely related to experiments. This course is an elmentary course particularly designed for physics graduates. Its purpose is to develop students' understanding of common principles involved in condensed matter so that students can further grasp and understand phenomena involved in condensed matter experiments. (凝態物理是一個範圍極廣並且與實驗關連性強的領域，本課程為物理所的基礎課程，主要的目標是在使 學生能掌握凝體物理共通之基本原理，因而能進一步掌握與了解凝體相關的實驗現象。)

briefs.name: 半導體物理
briefs.tags: 晶體結構(crystal structure), 電子能帶結構(electronic band structure), 載子濃度(carrier concentration), 費米能階(Fermi energy level), 平衡/非平衡載子傳輸(equilibrium/non-equilibrium carrier transport), p-n接面/二極體(p-n junction/diode), 異質接面(heterojunction)
briefs.desc: 本課程之目標設定在傳授近代半導體材料與元件之基本原理、半導體元件之設計概念以及半導體應用實例介紹。 This course will introduce the fundamental principles of modern semiconductor materials and devices, the design concepts of semiconductor devices, and the application examples of semiconductor devices.

briefs.name: 專題討論一
briefs.tags: 週三 1:30PM, 物理館 019,邀請校內外講員,嚴格實施點名,須全程聆 聽所有演講, Wed 1:30PM, Physics Building Rm 019, Attendance required for all colloquiums.
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請校內外講員介紹其所從事 相關領域之概況與最新發展，以利修課 同學增廣見聞並進而了解自己的志趣與 未來發展 方向。本課程嚴格實施點名，修課同學 除不可抗力因素外(不包含運動比賽或 其他科目之活動)，須全程聆聽所有演 講。每次上 課將宣布下次上課演講資訊。

briefs.name: 書報討論--凝態一
briefs.tags: Condensed Matter Seminar
briefs.desc: 本課程將會邀請國內外凝聚態物理領域的專家學者，介紹各子領域之最新研究與發展。

briefs.name: 書報討論--粒子一
briefs.tags: high energy, seminar, theory, cosmology, particle physics, quantum field theory
briefs.desc: This is a seminar course. Active researchers will be invited to talk about their recent research results. Topics include particle physics, strings and cosmology.

briefs.name: 書報討論--原子分子光學一
briefs.tags: atomic, molecular, and optical physics
briefs.desc: This course covers various research topics in atomic, molecular, and optical physics. We invite researchers from domestic and international institutes to present their current research progresses or review specific topics.

briefs.name: 物理專題--半導體自旋量子位元與應用
briefs.nameEn: Special topic - Semiconductor spin qubits and their applications
briefs.tags: Semiconductor半導體, quantum dots量子點, spin qubit自旋量子位元, quantum simulation量子模擬, 矽鍺SiGe
briefs.desc: In this course we will cover the fundamental of semiconductor quantum dot spin qubits and their latest development. The teaching materials will be based on spin qubit review articles and research papers. We will also use QuTip python package for numerical simulations of spin qubit physics.

briefs.name: 黑洞與全息論之量子理論一
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Quantum Theory of Black Holes and Holography (I)
briefs.tags: Black Holes, Quantum Mechanics, Hawking, AdS/CFT, String theory
briefs.desc: This is the first part of a year-long course designed to introduce advanced students to the (still developing) quantum theory of gravity through an understanding of the quantum theory of black holes. Students *must know* at least the basics of quantum mechanics and Einstein's equation to take this class. Students will learn the derivation of black hole solutions in general D-dimensions, Penrose diagrams, black hole thermodynamics, black hole evaporation, Page curves, and the firewall paradox, followed by an introduction to holography concepts. Students will learn a lot of new modern physics through these lectures. Not only are grad students welcome, but so are advanced undergrads, postdocs, and young faculty.

briefs.name: 量子場論一
briefs.tags: Quantum, Field Theory, Gauge Theories, Renormalization, Scattering theory
briefs.desc: This is the first part of a two semester course on quantum field theory. In the first part of this course we want to focus on introducing the path integral, its relation to scattering theory, the quantisation of Abelian and non-Abelian gauge theories and some simple examples for loop calculations and renormalization. This builds a foundation for the more advanced topics discussed in the next term.

briefs.name: 基本粒子物理一
briefs.tags: Standard Model, lepton, quark, QED, QCD, High-energy physics
briefs.desc: This one-semester course in Elementary Particle Physics provides a comprehensive introduction to the dynamics of the Standard Model (SM) of elementary particles, covering Quantum Electrodynamics, the weak interaction, and Quantum Chromodynamics. Students will become familiar with the fundamental techniques of quantum field theorycalculations and gain a solid understanding of the structure and implications of the SM. The course serves as a bridge between graduate-level coursework and active research, offering students a glimpse into the profound beauty and universal principles underlying modern elementary particle physics.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 工程圖學一
briefs.tags: 工程圖學(Engineering Drawing), 電腦輔助設計(Computer Aided Design, CAD), 電腦輔助立體製圖(Computer Aided Three-Dimensional Drawing), 國際標準組織(International Organization for Standardization, ISO), 中華民國國家標準(National Standards of the Republic of China, CNS)
briefs.desc: 教學旨在培養學生掌握工程圖學的核心概念，並透過PTC Creo Parametric進行2D基礎繪圖、3D建模與工程製圖，提升學生在 機械設計與製造領域的應用能力。課程內容涵蓋軟體介紹、基本繪圖工具、3D建模工具、三視圖繪製、剖視圖與局部視圖、尺寸 與公差標註、工程圖標準，並結合軟體實作，讓學生能夠從草圖繪製到完整零件建模，再到組合件設計與2D工程圖產出，建立完 整的設計流程概念。在課程中會透過專題實作來讓學生透過案例依據設計需求製作符合主題標準的零件、產品以及符合標準的工 程圖。最終，學員將具備完整的機械製圖與設計能力，為未來的專業發展奠定堅實基礎。

briefs.name: 工程圖學
briefs.tags: Engineering drawing, CAD, 電腦輔助製圖
briefs.desc: 本課程將由淺至深帶領新鮮人跨入機械設計的領域，工程圖學是設計的前哨，也是最重要的課程之一，圖面的溝通更是全球性 的語言，一張好的圖面，相當於是一張全球通用的文章。因此，本課程從製圖的歷史、工具、手法、概念與理論出發，導入實 際設計製圖的過程與實作，讓同學能夠全面性地在理論與實務之間游刃有餘，並以最新的軟體為工具，讓同學能夠接觸到最先 進的工具，在畢業時仍然能夠走在時代的尖端。

briefs.name: 工程圖學
briefs.tags: 工程圖學 (Engineering Drawing)、電腦輔助設計(Computer Aided Design, CAD)、幾何標註 (Geometric Dimensioning)、投影視圖 (Orthographic View )、公差(Tolerance)
briefs.desc: 本課程目標在協助學生了解工程圖學之基礎理論，重點在於講授投影幾何原理、繪製方法與應用， 並讓學生熟悉電腦輔助繪圖軟體的基本功能操作。

briefs.name: 工場實習一
briefs.tags: 車床（Lathe）, 銑床（Milling Machine）, 智慧製造（Smart Manufacturing）, 物聯網（Internet of Things, IoT）, 機械手臂（Robotic Arm）
briefs.desc: 本課程結合理論及實務，讓學生在科儀中心以工廠實習的方式學習工場環境與加工技術。課程中將介紹：工廠安全與環境衛生、 實習規則及自我保護，尺寸量測， 實作車床/銑床/鑽床/鉗工/CNC加工中心機/電銲/氣銲，以及了解目前用於特殊材料產品之 製作加工的先進製造技術方法。

briefs.name: 程式設計
briefs.tags: Procedural Programming, Memory Management, Data Representation, Modular Programming, File I/O
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental concepts of general-purpose programming. No prior experience is required. We will focus on procedural programming, using a widely adopted high-level language. While the exact language may vary, it will serve as a tool to help students understand core programming principles that apply across many languages. The goal is not only to write correct code, but also to write good code—efficient, readable, and maintainable. More advanced topics, such as object- oriented programming, will be covered in future courses. This course emphasizes learning how to think like a programmer, so students can confidently learn other languages on their own.

briefs.name: 程式設計
briefs.tags: c語言,程式設計
briefs.desc: 本課程的對象是程式設計初學者。 我們將以C語言來介紹程式設計的基本概念、基本技巧以及熟練C語言的使用。目標使學生能將腦中的演算法轉換成為電腦程 式， 利用電腦來解決問題。 本課程將著重在C語言程式的實際編寫能力，請務必要有花費心力及時間寫程式的準備。修課學生必須要通過線上的程式驗證 考 試及完成期末程式專題作業。期末程式專題作業需由同學親自向授課老師展示繳交，繳交時會就程式原始碼做1對1的討論及 問 答。

briefs.name: 機器人技術與實作
briefs.tags: 機器人控制(Robot Control)、機構設計(Mechanical Design)、程式設計(Programming)、機電整合(Mechatronics)、專題式學習(Project based Learning)
briefs.desc: 以PBL概念設計教學，透過實作，學習ESP32微控器的使用。除配合常見的周邊套件，學習控制應用外，期末以專題的形式，由 學生在所提供的雙軸手臂教具上，展現創意，完成沙畫繪製。專題導向的成果評量，讓學生能實際應用整個學期於課堂所學的技 術。

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: Ordinary Differential Equations, Laplace Transforms, Power Series & Special Functions, Linear Algebra, 常微分方程式, 拉式轉換, 級數法及特殊函數, 線性代數
briefs.desc: Engineering mathematics is a branch of applied mathematics concerning mathematical methods and techniques that are typically used in engineering and industry. This interdisciplinary subject is motivated by engineers’ needs for practical and theoretical considerations.

briefs.name: 工程數學一
briefs.tags: ordinary differential equations, series solution and special functions, Laplace transform, linear algebra
briefs.desc: Mathematical tools are essential in analysis and prediction for a wide range of engineering problems. Engineering mathematics is a post-calculus course for undergraduate students. It extends the discussion to various types of differential equations and advanced topics. Through class lectures, homework assignments and exams, you will acquire the knowledge on some but not all the equations with engineering interest, and be ready for utilizing it in engineering problems such as fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, control theory etc. Furthermore, you should have a good grasp of the physical meaning behind the math and be able to interpret the solution. This is a two-semester series. In the first semester we will cover ordinary differential equations, series solution and special functions, Laplace transform, linear algebra.

briefs.name: 工場實習二
briefs.tags: 加工技巧, Machining Skills, 實習操作, Hands-on Practice, 銑削, Milling, 車削,Turning, 放電加工, EDM
briefs.desc: This course is an extended course of mechanical shop practice for students who are interested in advanced machine operation technologies. The topics cover CNC Lathe, CNC milling machine, CNC laser cutting, CNC EDM and CNC turn-mill machine. The students have to match the total hours to pass the grading requirement to fulfill the course credits. If there is any special interests with some specific skills or machining technology, please consult t with the instructor before you take the course.

briefs.name: 基礎熱流學一
briefs.tags: Thermal-Fluid Science, Thermodynamics, First Law of Thermodynamics, Second Law of Thermodynamics, Steam Power Cycles, Gas Power Cycles
briefs.desc: Thermal and Fluid Science I & II introduce the fundamental aspects of thermal science. In Part I, the first semester, the content is focused on Thermodynamics, while in Part II the focus will be on Fluid Mechanics. The textbook is YA Cengel, JM Cimbala, AJ Ghajar, Fundamentals of Thermal-Fluid Sciences, 6th Ed, 2022. Reference book: Turns, S.R., "Thermal-Fluid Sciences, An Integrated Approach" Cambridge University Press, 2006. The content of this course includes: Chapter 1 Introduction and Overview Chapter 2 Basic Concept of Thermodynamics Chapter 3 Energy, Energy Transfer, and General Energy Analysis Chapter 4 Properties of Pure Substances Chapter 5 Energy Analysis of Closed Systems Chapter 6 Mass and Energy Analysis of Control Volumes Chapter 7 The Second Law of Thermodynamics Chapter 8 Entropy Chapter 9 Power and Refrigeration Cycles Experiment I 冷凍空調系統 時間：2025/12 本課程無涉及AI使用

briefs.name: 基礎熱流學一
briefs.tags: Energy, Heat Transfer, Thermodynamics, Entropy, Power and Refrigeration Cycles
briefs.desc: Thermal and Fluid Science I & II introduce the fundamental aspects of thermal science. In Part I, the first semester, the content is focused on Thermodynamics, while in Part II the focus will be on Fluid Mechanics.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: 電路設計, circuit design, 電路分析, circuit analysis, 頻率響應, frequency response, 濾波電路, filter circuit
briefs.desc: 本課程在教授修課學生電路方面之基礎知識與分析方法.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: 電路設計, circuit design, 電路分析, circuit analysis, 頻率響應, frequency response, 運算放大器, operational amplifier
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to teach students the basic knowledge and analysis methods of circuits. 本課程之目標，在教授修課學生電路方面之基礎知識與分析方法。

briefs.name: 材料力學
briefs.tags: Deformation, Stress, Strain, Yield, Strength, Bending, Tensile, Compression, Shear, Torsion
briefs.desc: This "Mechanics of Materials" lecture addresses the question, “How much does an object of finite size deform when a force is applied to it?” This practical study is always used in the design of micromachines, robots, buildings, bridges, automobiles, and more. The lecture covers the deformation of objects in the elastic region caused by bending, shear, tension, compression, and torsion. However, it does not address “Plastic Mechanics" such as plastic deformation and fracture. It also does not include "Dislocation theory" which attempts to understand the atomic structure in deformation.

briefs.name: 材料力學
briefs.tags: mechanics of materials, structural analysis, applied mechanics, 材料力學, 結構分析, 應用力學
briefs.desc: Mechanics of Materials is a branch of engineering that studies how solid objects deform and fail under various types of loading, such as tension, compression, torsion, and bending. It builds on the principles of statics and extends them to analyze stresses, strains, and material behavior in deformable bodies. This subject is essential for designing safe and efficient structures and mechanical components. It serves as a foundation for advanced topics in structural analysis, machine design, and materials engineering.

briefs.name: 機械製造
briefs.tags: manufacturing, processes, production, materials, systems
briefs.desc: 機械製造是將設計概念轉化為實體產品的關鍵環節，對產品性能與製造效率有決定性影響。本課程旨在使學生了解與機械工 程相關的主要產品及其零組件的生產方式，包括可採用的各類加工方法、其基本原理與特性、所需設備、以及提升生產力的 各種工程方法。 Manufacturing is the critical stage in transforming design concepts into physical products, playing a decisive role in both product performance and production efficiency. This course aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the production methods for major products and components related to mechanical engineering, including various applicable manufacturing processes, their fundamental principles and characteristics, required equipment, and engineering methods for improving productivity.

briefs.name: 機械製造
briefs.tags: manufacturing, processes, production, materials, systems
briefs.desc: 機械製造(製造程序)課程的目的在了解與機械工程相關的各種主要工業與商業的產品及其零組件的生產方法、可採用之各種加工 法、各種加工法的基本原理、特性與所須之設備、以及生產加工過程中要精進生產力所涉及的工程方法。

briefs.name: 系統動態分析
briefs.tags: System, Dynamic, Transfer function, Feedback control, Electromechanical system
briefs.desc: This course deals with mathematical modeling and analysis of devices and process for the purpose of understanding their time-dependent behavior. In this course, we will paricularly emphasize on methods for handling applications containing multiple types of components and processes such as electromechanical devices, electrohydraulic devices, and fluid-thermal processes. Since control systems are required to interconnect elements, preliminary controller design is also a major focus in this course.

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 線性方程式 Linear Equation, 矩陣 Matrix, 行列式 Determinant, 向量空間 Vector Space, 線性轉換 Linear Transformation
briefs.desc: 線性代數為分析問題的基礎數學課程，除工程科系學生外，理學院及商管等科系大學部學生也需具備相關知識，以作為未 來專業應用之基礎。此課程主要探討線性方程式系統、行列式、向量空間、線性轉換、內積及特徵向量等的相關理論。

briefs.name: 進階流體力學
briefs.tags: Navier Stokes equation, Viscous flow, compressible flow, potential flow, fluid dynamics, tensor
briefs.desc: This course will derive governing equations in fluid dynamics in differential forms. Viscous flow in pipes (internal flow) and over immersed bodies (external flow) will be then covered. Finally, two other important flow theories including compressible flow and potential flow will be briefly covered.

briefs.name: 能源工程
briefs.tags: Energy conversion, Thermal system design, Energy efficiency analysis, Renewable energy, Thermal-fluid sciences
briefs.desc: The primary goal of this course is to provide students with an understanding of the Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, and Heat and Mass Transfer principles that govern energy conversion processes of different types, with an emphasis on renewable and sustainable energy systems. The lecture integrates the topics of storage, transfer, and conversion of energy. This course will also introduce basic and practical computational methods for modeling the performance of energy conversion processes, devices and systems. This course is a capstone for upper level engineering students, synthesizing thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer and computational analysis tools to facilitate energy engineering analysis, design and optimization.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: MOSFET, BJT, Single-stage Amplifier, Differnetial Amplifier, Multi-stage Amplifier, Biasing, Frequency Response, Operational Amplifier
briefs.desc: 複習基礎的電子元件與MOS元件運作原理、講授BJT元件的運作原理、講授放大器電路的頻率響應與分析方法、講授單級放 大器電路的運作原理與分析方法、講授差動式放大器電路與多級放大器電路的運作原理與分析方法、介紹OP放大器電路與 基礎數位電路的原理、MOS電路設計與分析。學期末會有電路設計與分析專題。學期中會包含電路實驗。

briefs.name: 控制系統一
briefs.tags: Feedback Control, Automatic Control, Root Locus, Bode Plots, Frequency Analysis
briefs.desc: The Goal of the course is to provide Undergraduate with basic concepts, principles and applications of feedback control in order to work on design of feedback control systems using classical control methods. Course content will include dynamic modeling, dynamic response, stability, classical methods of analysis and control: PID, Root Locus, Nyquist, Bode.

briefs.name: 控制系統一
briefs.tags: 回饋控制、系統動態反應、穩定度、PID控制器、跟軌跡法、柏德圖，feedback control, system dynamic response, stability, PID, Root Locus, Nyquist plots, Bode diagram.
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide undergraduate students with basic concepts, principles and applications of feedback control in order to work on design of feedback control systems using classical control methods. Course contents will include dynamic modeling, dynamic response, stability, classical methods of analysis and control such as PID, Root Locus, Nyquist plots, Bode diagram, etc. 本課程為大學部課程，主要的目標為提供回饋控制的基本概念、原則和應用，以便學生能使用古典控制理論來設計回授控制系 統 方法。課程內容包括動態建模、動態反應、穩定性、PID、根軌跡、奈奎斯特圖、伯德圖等分析與控制，訓練學生達成系 統動態的分析與系統控制的專業能力。

briefs.name: 電磁學
briefs.tags: Electromagnetics: Vector Analysis, Electrostatics, Magnetostatics, Applications on Engineering and Life
briefs.desc: Course Content: (1) Introduction to Electromagnetics (2) The Electromagnetic Model (3) Vector Analysis (4) Static Electric Fields (5) Steady Electric Current (6) Static Magnetic Fields (7) Time-Varying Fields and Maxwell's Equations (8) Applications of Static Fields (9) Simulation Tool Lecture using ANSYS/ANSOFT

briefs.name: 高等材料力學
briefs.tags: Problems in elasticity, Failure criteria, Bending of beams, Torsion of prismatic bars, Applications of energy methods, Stability of columns
briefs.desc: 高等材料力學延續材料力學之理論與方法，材料力學為固體力學之基礎課程，也是修習機械設計與製造、微機電系統等課程必 須先有之訓練，為成為好的工程師不可或缺的課程。修過材料力學之後，高等材料力學進一步探討機械結構承受各種不同負載之 情況，修習之後可在固體力學領域有較完整之訓練。

briefs.name: 有限單元法導論
briefs.tags: 有限單元法(Finite Element Method),固體力學(Solid Mechanics),數值方法(Numerical Method),ANSYS,工程分析(Engineering Simulation)
briefs.desc: 實際的工程與科學問題往往相當複雜，不易用理論方法來處理；另一方面，因為電腦的進步，數值方法成為計算分析工程與 科學問題最經濟而有效的方法。在相關數值方法中，有限單元法是最被廣泛使用的方法，尤其在固體力學領域。相關的軟體功 能也日益完備，已成為有效而方便的工具。學生可透過基礎理論的介紹與實際的操作練習，熟悉一個有用的工具(以ANSYS為 例)，提升往後解決工程與科學問題的能力。

briefs.name: 機械設計
briefs.tags: 機械設計，機械元件，機械系統設計概念，故障分析與預防，軸元件; Mechanical design, mechanical components, mechanical system design concepts, fault analysis and prevention, shaft components
briefs.desc: 介紹機械元件的基本構造和原理、選用機械元件的方法，以及設計機械系統時機械強度設計的理論基礎。 （1）The basic structure and principle of mechanical components. （2）The method of selecting mechanical components. （3）The theory of mechanical strength design when designing mechanical systems.

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.desc: 每位學生在指導教授指定之題目與指導下，進行實驗依據實驗結果完成研究報告。

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.desc: 「專題研究」課程透過實際設計與實驗操作，讓學生對入學以來所習知識與技能得進一步實踐及體驗。透過組成二至四人團隊， 落實培養學生團隊合作之精神。

briefs.name: 賽車實務專題
briefs.nameEn: Formula Student Racing Car Design and Manufacture Project
briefs.tags: 方程式賽車, 零組件設計, 機械加工製造, 團隊合作設計, 量測經驗技術, Formula Race Car, Component Design, Manufacture and Machining, Team Workmanship, Inspection and Measurement
briefs.desc: based on FSAE Formula Race Car rules and regulations, analysis tools and software are adopted for specifics works with hands-on practice and training schedules for cultivation of group cooperation, team discussion, international views of college graduates. 根據FSAE方程式賽車之車輛規格及安全設計規範,規劃主要零組件設計流程,使用各種工程設計軟件進行分析,規劃並使用 學校之各式傳統及非傳統加工機器,完成規鑑定組裝測試,為每一道製程從材料加工方式,熱處理方式,刀具選用及量測精度 之需求,由學生親身參與動手,強調機器使用性能及安全操作,並訓練團隊合作及群組討論技巧,使畢業學生具有專業素養及 工程師團隊合作之經驗,達成大學養成具國際觀之工程專業學生目標.

briefs.name: 數值分析
briefs.tags: Error, Interpolation, Numerical analysis, Numerical differentiation and integrating, 誤差, 差補, 數值分析, 數值積分與微分
briefs.desc: Error analysis (Chap. 1), solutions of equations in one variable (Chap. 2), interpolation and polynomial approximation (Chap. 3), numerical differentiation and integrating (Chap. 4), initial- value problems for ordinary differential equations (Chap. 5), direct methods for solving linear systems (Chap. 6), iterative technique in matrix algebra (Chap. 7), and approximation theory (Chap. 8). Note: Chapters 9 - 12 are surely not covered. Several MATLAB tutoring courses will be also provided. For AI usage: (1)完全開放使用且無須註明 Unrestricted use with no disclosure required

briefs.name: 熱流與動力系統實驗
briefs.tags: 質傳/熱傳實驗, 燃料電池, 氣體動力與噴嘴, 水洞實驗, 馬達/發電機, 風力發電, 風動實驗, 蒸汽渦輪機, 太陽電池
briefs.desc: 本門課程為實驗課程，學生將學會操作基本的熱流學動力系統及相關的數據分析，內容包含八項實驗：質傳/熱傳實驗、燃料電池、氣體動 力 與噴嘴性能測試、水洞速度場量測與邊界層分析、馬達/發電機測試與風力發電系統量測、視流與風洞實驗、蒸汽渦輪動力實驗、太陽電池 測 試。

briefs.name: 熱流與動力系統實驗
briefs.tags: 質傳/熱傳實驗, 燃料電池, 氣體動力與噴嘴, 水洞實驗, 馬達/發電機, 風力發電, 風動實驗, 蒸汽渦輪機, 太陽電池
briefs.desc: 本門課程為實驗課程，學生將學會操作基本的熱流學動力系統及相關的數據分析，內容包含八項實驗：質傳/熱傳實驗、燃料電池、氣體動 力 與噴嘴性能測試、水洞速度場量測與邊界層分析、馬達/發電機測試與風力發電系統量測、視流與風洞實驗、蒸汽渦輪動力實驗、太陽電池 測 試。

briefs.name: 熱流與動力系統實驗
briefs.tags: 質傳/熱傳實驗, 燃料電池, 氣體動力與噴嘴, 水洞實驗, 馬達/發電機, 風力發電, 風動實驗, 蒸汽渦輪機, 太陽電池
briefs.desc: 本門課程為實驗課程，學生將學會操作基本的熱流學動力系統及相關的數據分析，內容包含八項實驗：質傳/熱傳實驗、燃料電池、氣體動 力 與噴嘴性能測試、水洞速度場量測與邊界層分析、馬達/發電機測試與風力發電系統量測、視流與風洞實驗、蒸汽渦輪動力實驗、太陽電池 測 試。

briefs.name: 近代物理導論
briefs.tags: 近代物理,波粒二相性,測不準原理,薛丁格方程,雷射,半導體,Modern physics,wave-particle duality,uncertainty principle,Schrodinger equation,Laser,semiconductor
briefs.desc: 使同學明瞭近代物理的演進，以及相關的重要理論及革命性的實驗發現，並帶領學生探討現代科技的最新進展，以擴大學生的 視野，期許同學能將其應用在未來的研究與工作領域上。

briefs.name: 飛行力學
briefs.tags: 飛行力學 Flight Mechanics
briefs.desc: 課程概述與目標：教學飛行力學之基本數學工具，機翼設計，飛行理論探討、靜態穩定度與控制，並介紹航天學，包括以下重要 章節: Brief review of aerodynamics, Elements of airplane performance, Static stability and control, Astronautics，期望此數學工具與相關實際情境探討能為基礎研究及其應用打下根基。

briefs.name: 人體再生能源收集技術概述
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to human renewable energy harvesting technologies
briefs.tags: 人體發電,壓電材料,熱電效應,摩擦起電,穿戴式元件
briefs.desc: 在微電子和材料技術高速發展的今日，大量新型多功能和高度集成化的微型電子器件不斷推陳出新，在日常生活的各個 方面展現出前所未有的應用前景，感測器便是其中一種新興的研究項目。然而，一般感測器皆需外接電源來驅動其運 作，而且主要以充電或一次性電池作為主要電力來源，這些電源的體積較大、能源耗用量高，致使感測器的應用範圍受 到嚴重限制；此外，廢棄電池也會對環境造成汙染，種種因素驅使著科學家努力尋找更為環保的動力來源。綜觀動力發 電研究的歷程，從風力、水力、火力發電等等技術不斷演進，建造出許多設計複雜精密的發電設施，但如果將研究回歸 到最基礎且本質的「人類」自身，我們每天的活動及體溫即會不斷產生各種機械能和熱能，如何將這些微小但卻最易取 用的能量轉變為日常所需的驅動力來源，正是科學家持續研究的課題之一。在本課程中，將會介紹同學有關用來收集人 體所產生機械能及熱能的技術；配合奈米材料的優點，這些所製成元件將不再笨重，高度提升其應用潛力。另外，也會 利用讓同學實作的機會，鼓勵同學將課堂上所學的知識，學以致用。

briefs.name: 微算機導論
briefs.tags: 微算機, 嵌入式系統, ARM, Java程式設計, 感測器
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹微算機架構與作業程序, 並經由此架構深入瞭解微算機功能, 將以目前熱門的ARM核心之嵌入式系統為主, 來探討演練其程式設計與操控方式, 並瞭解嵌入式系統未來在居家照護之生醫電子感測系統、高階儀器控制、智慧型手機上之應用潛力。

briefs.name: 電腦輔助設計與製造
briefs.tags: 電腦輔助設計,電腦輔助製造,電腦化數值控制,CAD, CAM, CNC
briefs.desc: 介紹常見之機械加工機設備，利用CAD軟體作幾何工件設計後，在CAM軟體中學習刀具路徑規劃與模擬，最後選配最適切之 機械加工。課程會使用AutoCAD、Creo及MasterCam等軟體進行操作並利用CNC機台進行專題加工。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 碩博士班必修科目，專題演講，專業內容，出席率，心得報告
briefs.desc: 本課程為動力機械工程學系研究所同學的必修課程，每週舉行一次，每次約 2 小時，邀請國內外各相關領域的專家或產業不 同領域的實踐者至本系演講。

briefs.name: 層流理論
briefs.tags: fluid dynamics, viscous flows, Navier-Stokes equations, lubrication theory, boundary layer
briefs.desc: This is a graduate-level course aiming to offer students the knowledge on fluid dynamics. We will go over fundamental concepts of fluid motions and dynamics, followed by a derivation of the (in)famous Navier-Stokes equations. Then we will obtain some analytic solutions where viscosity is balanced by some other forces such as inertia, pressure, and body force that determine the flow dynamic. The Stokes flow and lubrication theory in which viscosity dominates will also be discussed. Finally, we wrap up in laminar boundary layer theory, where self-similar solution and an integral approach will be covered. Stability of fluid flows is optional and will be introduced based on the availability of time.

briefs.name: 計算流體力學
briefs.tags: computational fluid dynamics, numerical method, heat conduction, convection diffusion equation, lid-driven cavity flow
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to enable students with the capability to compute flow field with numerical techniques.

briefs.name: 流體不穩定性控制理論
briefs.tags: Flow Instability, Floquet Theory, Galerkin Method, Boussinesq Approximation, Rayleigh-Taylor Instability, Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability, Orr-Sommerfeld Equation, Rayleigh-Bénard Convection, Rotating flow and Centrifugal Instabilities, Finite Amplitude, Thermal Convection, Taylor Vortex Flow, Modulated Fluid Motions, MOCVD Flow
briefs.desc: 流體穩定性與不穩定性是流體動力學中最核心且廣泛被探討和研究的課題，尤其在電子冷與半導體製程中更顯關鍵。流場 從穩定層流(Laminar Flow)發展成不穩定紊流（Turbulence）的物理現象廣泛存在於各種應用科學領域。近年來，隨著高 耗能晶片對高效能浸沒式液體冷卻技術需求的迅速攀升，以及半導體製程設備因應高階運算與人工智慧（AI）晶片爆炸性需 求而快速成長，晶片製程中的熱流效應已成為影響薄膜磊晶層品質與晶片效能的關鍵挑戰。因此，在有機金屬化學氣相沉積 （MOCVD）磊晶過程中，如何有效控制反應氣體的均勻性與穩定性，已成為半導體產業亟待克服的重要議題。本課程將結合熱 流擾動特性與流場穩定之主動控制機制 (Kelly-Hu Mechanism)，提出創新且高效的解決方案，主動調控MOCVD製程中的流 場穩定度，同時應對高耗能晶片的散熱挑戰。課程內容設計涵蓋流體穩定與不穩定流場現象與其基本原理，並深入探討觸發 流體擾動的關鍵物理機制和控制方法，課程將探討應用主動式控制機制來調節流場的穩定性。

briefs.name: 熱傳導
briefs.tags: 熱傳導,Heat Conduction,能量守恆,energy conservation,物性,physical property
briefs.desc: 熱傳導為機械系基礎課程，主要探討能量守恆、物性。

briefs.name: 燃燒學概論
briefs.tags: 燃燒熱流場統治方程式(Governing Equations for Reacting Thermal Fluid Flow)，預混火焰(Premixed Flame)，擴散火焰(Diffusion Flame)，噴流火焰(Jet Flames)，油滴蒸發與燃燒(Droplet Evaporation and Combustion)
briefs.desc: 燃燒學在機械、化工以及航太工程問題上存在著很多有趣的應用，其所牽涉到的基礎學科很廣，包括：流體力學、熱 力學、熱傳學、質傳學、化學動力學、多相流以及工程數學等等。燃燒學概論的課程，一開始先以專章介紹關於一個 反應系統之反應流體的保守方程式和其之簡化，接著分章介紹基礎火焰反應行為：第二章層流預混火焰結構與應用； 第三章預混火焰於爆燃現象之應用；第四、第五章為層流非預混火焰（或稱擴散火焰）結構及其於噴流火焰與油滴燃 燒的應用。在上述主要內容的介紹中隨時輔以質傳學、流體力學、熱傳學、化學動力學、多相流以及氣體動力學等基 礎學科之補充教材。

briefs.name: 噴射推進
briefs.tags: gas turbine, propulsion, jet engine, turbomachinery, rocket
briefs.desc: 介紹噴射推進系統之理論、熱力學與流體力學之相關理論、航空器噴射引擎、進氣道、燃燒室與噴嘴。本課程之教學目標在建立 噴 射推進系統之基本解晰能力及解決實際問題之素養，即經由基本原理之了解，建立吸氣式推進系統之分析能力，以創造工程之價 值。教學內容包括噴射推進基本原理，採用理想氣體穩態一維流體理論探討流體之動力與熱力循環分析, 進氣道,壓縮機,燃燒 室, 渦輪機,噴嘴之基本原理及噴射推進基本裝置原理等。

briefs.name: 線性系統理論
briefs.tags: Dynamical systems; Input-output description; State-variable description; Eigen analysis; Controllability; Observability; State Feedback; State Estimation
briefs.desc: The aim of this course is to develop familiarity with the fundamental concepts of linear system theory and to build proficiency in the mathematical techniques and tools used to evaluate the intrinsic dynamic properties of linear lumped parameter dynamic systems, and to predict the system's response to specified inputs.

briefs.name: 數位控制系統
briefs.tags: Discrete Systems, Sampling, Z-transform, Control Design, System Identification
briefs.desc: This course provides the students with basic knowledge in discrete-time control systems. It covers the introduction of discrete-time systems, z-transform, sampling and reconstruction, open- loop/closed-loop discrete-time systems, time-response characteristics, stability analysis techniques, and digital controller design. Students will also learn how to apply control theory to real engineering problems via Matlab simulations and Lab assignments.

briefs.name: 聲學理論與應用
briefs.tags: acoustic wave equation, radiation, transmission, enclosure, electroacoustic transducer
briefs.desc: As the title suggests, this course covers the underlying theory of acoustics and its associated applications.

briefs.name: 強化學習與最佳控制
briefs.tags: Dynamic Programming, Monte Carlo Method, Temporal-Difference Method, Approximation Solution Method, Reinforcement Learning, 動態規劃, 蒙地卡羅法, 時間差分法, 近似解法, 強化學習
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to give the basic concepts and professional techniques in reinforcement learning, which can be applied to the optimal control and other engineering design. This course can help train students’ expertise in the field of power mechanical engineering, ability to perform projects, and ability to solve problems independently. In the future, the students can do academic research and physical projects. 本課程的目的是提供強化學習的基本概念和專業技術，其可被應用於最佳控制和其他工程設計。本課程有助於培養學生動力機 械工程領域的專業知識、專案實施能力和獨立解決問題的能力。未來，學生可以進行學術研究和實際專題。

briefs.name: 深度學習與應用
briefs.tags: Deep Learning, Deep Neural Network, Backpropagation, Convolutional Neural Networks, Deep Reinforcement Learning
briefs.desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to deep learning, covering both the theoretical foundations and practical applications. Beginning with fundamental concepts in machine learning and probability, the course builds up to modern deep learning architectures, including deep neural networks (DNNs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), sequence models, and reinforcement learning. A strong emphasis is placed on understanding the underlying theory. To reinforce theoretical knowledge, students will engage in programming-based lab sessions and assignments. The course culminates in a final project that encourages students to apply their skills creatively to real-world problems.

briefs.name: 微奈米系統之感測與致動
briefs.nameEn: Sensing and Actuation in Miniaturized Systems
briefs.tags: Transducers, MEMS, Microsystem, Lab on Chip, Micromachining
briefs.desc: The Goal of the course is to provide senior and graduate students with the basic concepts and principles of sensing and actuation in miniaturized systems, which mostly use integrated circuit fabrication for their realization. Categories of sensors and actuators include biological transducers, mechanical transducers, etc. Basic mechanism of transduction, micro/nanofabrication techniques, and relative merits of the different technologies will be addressed. This course will be research oriented and focuses on paper survey. (Lectures will be given in English and your oral presentation will be requested in English)

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理
briefs.tags: discrete-time signal and systems, sampling, Fourier analysis, z transform, filter design
briefs.desc: This course covers the fundamental theory of discrete-time signal processing, including signal and system, sampling, filter design,Fourier analysis, and so forth.

briefs.name: 高等振動學
briefs.tags: Vibrations, Hamilton’s principle, Variational method, Eigenvalue Problem, Galerkin's metho, Modal analysis, Rayleigh quotient
briefs.desc: The subject area for this course is mechanical vibration, at a level appropriate for master and doctoral graduate students. Classical techniques in mechanical vibration are developed for the modeling and analysis of discrete and continuous linear dynamic systems. Continuous systems are described within the broader context of operator theory to emphasize the physical and mathematical analogies with discrete systems. Specific topics include: Discrete systems: Equations of motion for multiple degree of freedom systems through Lagrange’s method; linearization about equilibrium; symmetry and definiteness properties; free vibration; matrix eigenvalue problems; orthogonality; Rayleigh quotient; generalized coordinates; transient and forced response through modal analysis. Continuous systems: Classical rod, shaft, string, beam, membrane and plate models; Hamilton’s principle; equations of motion and boundary conditions through variational methods; essentials of funct

briefs.name: 有限單元法
briefs.tags: 有限單元法, 固體力學, 網格, 數值分析, 單元與節點
briefs.desc: 本課程為固體與奈微米力學之碩士班課程之一，有限單元法為一數值方法，可解固體變形之邊界值問題，探討固體結構之變形行 為及相關工程問題。課程中將介紹有限單元法之發展、基本理論、技術及應用等。

briefs.name: 彈性力學
briefs.tags: Deformation, Stress, Material Behavior, Constitutive Equations, Boundary Value Problems,
briefs.desc: In this course, deformation, stress,constitutive equations and boundary value problems of elastic bodies will be investigated.

briefs.name: 奈米結構力學
briefs.tags: Atomic Structure, Nano-Mechanics, potential function, Finite element method, Molecular Dynamics
briefs.desc: This course will focus on atomic structure, potential functions, and coupling atomic mechanics with classical mechanics.

briefs.name: 彈性波元件與應用
briefs.tags: Elastic wave, Christoffel equation, Lamb wave, Piezoelectricity, MEMS
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to discuss the fundamentals of elastic waves in solids and their engineering applications. This is a theoretical course focused on the development of equivalent circuit models for various elastic wave devices. The course begins with the theoretical background of ultrasonic wave propagation in solids and crystals. This is followed by an exploration of the design methodologies of RF microdevices (such as FBAR and Lamb wave resonators), as well as various micromachined ultrasonic transducers (CMUT and PMUT). The final part of the course covers circuit and subsystem design based on these devices. Students are expected to gain general knowledge of integrated ultrasonic microsystems. Commercial software tools (COMSOL Multiphysics, MATLAB, and Keysight ADS) will be used for homework assignments.

briefs.name: 精密機械設計一
briefs.tags: precision machine, design, metrology, bearings, actuators, transmissions
briefs.desc: 精密機械設計一 Precision Machine Design I 11410PME 543500 課程說明 (Course Description) This course intends to provide students with knowledge and experience in designing precision machines through lectures, case studies, hand-on labs and design projects.

briefs.name: 人工智慧
briefs.tags: 人工智慧 artificial intelligence, 機器學習 machine learning, 深度學習 deep learning、卷積神經網絡 convolution neural network、遞歸神經網絡 recurrent NN、機器學習理論 ML theory、軟體工程 software engineering、程式設計 programming 、自主駕駛 autonomous driving
briefs.desc: This course introduces a basic knowledge of supervised machine learning (an important part of Artificial Intelligence) from the perspective of Algorithm, Big data, Coding, and Deployment to autonomous vehicles. The course topics include deep learning, convolution neural network, recurrent and attention neural network, machine learning theory, software engineering, and computer programming. Project assignments provide students hands-on experience on software design of machine learning models and real-world tests on autonomous (not fully yet, a research in progress) driving of a Toyota car and a mobile robot.

briefs.name: 飛秒雷射微加工導論
briefs.tags: 飛秒雷射 Femtosecond laser, 微製造 Microfabrication, 雷射物質交互作用 Laser-matter interaction, 材料改性 Material modification, 微細加工 Micromachining, 積層製造 Additive manufacturing, 微系統應用 Microsystem application
briefs.desc: 飛秒雷射由於能夠達到多種奈微米精度的材料特性改變，在近二十年來已成為微製造領域中一種極具發展潛力的工具，被廣 泛應用於不同領域以生產先進微系統諸如電子學、積體光路、微光學、微機電、微流控和生命科學等。本課程旨在使學生了 解（1）飛秒雷射基本原理及雷射脈衝與不同材料相互作用的基礎知識；（2）飛秒雷射在微製造技術中的應用；以及（3）這 些技術在不同產學領域中的應用。 Femtosecond laser has become a promising tool for microfabrication in the past two decades due to its capability of inducing various localized material modifications with micro- and nanoscale resolution. These techniques have found wide-ranging applications in advanced microsystems for electronics, photonics, MEMS, microfluidics, and life science. This course aims to provide students with (1) basic knowledge of femtosecond lasers and the laser-material interactions, (2) an overview of femtosecond laser microfabrication techniques, and (3) their applications in different fields of research and industry.

briefs.name: 製造分析
briefs.tags: 製程分析,複合能量加工,製程參數控制,實驗設計,製程最佳化 Process analysis, Hybrid-energy process, Process parameter control, Design of experiment, Process optimization
briefs.desc: 製造分析主要以綜合能量轉換方法分析製造程序，先由金屬切削到複合能量加工製程解析，建立理論、數值或實驗經驗法等製程 模式，再進入參數控制與最佳化分析，目標期能建立新型材料研發創新製程分析能力。

briefs.tags: 熱輻射, 光, 電磁波, 紅外線, thermal radiation, light, electromagnetic waves, infrared

Discuss basic and advanced concepts of radiative transfer and to review some fundamental experimental facts 3. Provide experience in treating multiple modes (i.e., combined convection, conduction, and radiation) heat transfer problems in which radiation plays an important role

briefs.name: 精準醫學概論
briefs.tags: 生物標記, 微流體, 液態切片, 伴隨式診斷, 精準醫療, 次世代定序, 奈米材料, 硼中子捕獲, 微生物基因體學
briefs.desc: 伴隨式診斷與藥物的結合及次世代定序的進展已形成精準醫學的治療方法也影響藥物開發的模式。奈米材料的應用使藥物的釋 放更為精準及安全。新穎檢測平台的開發及應用使分子診斷更為靈敏。影像醫學及人工智能的結合使病灶辨識的精準度及診療 速度大幅提升。硼中子捕獲達成核醫於精準醫療的應用。本課程結合校內外精準醫學領域專家、臨床醫師、業界實務講師帶領 學員瞭解精準醫學。

briefs.desc: 透過報告學術論文訓練同學下列能力 (1) 主動式閱讀論文 (Active reading comprehension), (2) 邏輯思考能力的訓練 (Logic thinking skills), (3) 表達能力(Presentational skills), (4) 交互討論技巧 (Questionary skills) 。

briefs.name: 資訊工程導論
briefs.tags: 計算機概論, Python程式語言設計, 資料結構與演算法, Computer science introduction, Python programming, Data structure and Algorithms
briefs.desc: 介紹資訊工程基礎知識及程式設計基本概念，目的在於熟悉計算機軟硬體相關知識，培養運用電腦解決問題的能力。課程講授計算機 科學的基礎技術及知識並讓同學們學習如何撰寫程式，並透過程式解決問題。本課程將使用Python作為授課程式語言，將介紹Python 程式開發環境建置、基本語法、資料型態、字串處理、流程控制、函式等基本程式設計方法。課堂上會進行程式撰寫與實作練習，因 於一般教室上課，請自備筆記型電腦。

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: IFRS、Financial Accouting、Accounting Principle
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to develop a comprehensive understanding of the language used in business. To achieve this, students will focus on three key areas. Firstly, they will delve into the trends and advancements of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Secondly, they will learn how to effectively identify, measure, and recognize the various business activities of an entity. Lastly, students will gain a clear understanding of the information conveyed through financial statements.

briefs.name: 會計學一
briefs.tags: 會計，Accounting，Financial Accounting，初級，會計一
briefs.desc: 幫助同學瞭解與學習財務會計的基本原理、原則

briefs.tags: 會計Accounting,會計政策Accounting policy,會計原則Accounting principle,會計紀錄Accounting record,應計基礎Accrual basis,財務報表Financial statements
briefs.desc: 課程簡介 本課程之目標在於使同學瞭解會計學之基本原理原則、會計報表之內涵及其分析方法，讓同學經由財務會計專業知識與理論規範 之學習理解，加強培養財務報告解讀及分析能力，以助於日後了解企業的經營成果，幫助釐清財務環境及運用財務報表制定適切 的決策。

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: financial market, asset pricing
briefs.desc: This course provides an introduction to finance, covering the basic concepts and tools necessary to understand how capital markets work and how financial instruments are used for investments. The course explores core concepts for the financial aspects of decision-making, including the principles of valuation, arbitrage, costs of capital, diversification, risk-return trade-off, and market efficiency. Building on these concepts, we will develop analytical frameworks for the valuation of real and financial assets, portfolio selection, and costs of capital estimation. This knowledge is essential for navigating the uncertainty and financial innovations in current times.

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: 財務管理financial management; 資本預算capital budgeting;財務報表分析financial statement analysis; 風險與報酬risk and return;資本結構capital structure
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of corporate finance. The course has four main topics: 1. Understanding of basic concept of corporate finance and financial statement analysis; 2. Develop an understanding of the tools that are used to value investment projects and companies; 3. Build a basic concept and measurement of financial risk and return; 4. Introductions of firms’ long-term financing instruments, such as stock, bond and other long- term financing tools. 5. Introduction of efficient capital markets.

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: corporate finance; discounted cash flow; bond valuation; stock valuation; return and risk
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to introduce the students to the fundamentals of finance including corporate valuation and financial management, investment decisions, and corporate financing decisions and dividend policies.

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: Financial Management, Corporate Finance
briefs.desc: This course discusses concepts and decisions in financial management, specifically those concerned about corporate finance. Discussion topics are divided into four parts. The first section introduces the fundamental concepts. The second section discusses corporate valuation. The third part talks about investment decisions. Subsequently, the fourth part is concerned about financing decisions and dividend policies. Lectures are designed for an 16-week course. Students are assigned to complete exercises expected to invigorate their understanding on topics discussed in the lectures.

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: financial management, present value, stock, bond, cash flow
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of corporate finance. The overall aim of the course is to give students a critical focus of corporate finance and the functions of the security market and the optimal investment strategy under rational market conditions. Students will develop critical skills in assessing the relevance of the principles of finance to real world situations.

briefs.name: 統計學一
briefs.tags: Descriptive statistics, population, sample, distribution, confidence interval
briefs.desc: The main objective of this course is to provide students the fundamental probability theory and the necessary tools for the analysis of actual and realistic data. To this aim, the course will cover the following topics: numerical descriptive measures, basic probability, some important distributions, sampling distributions, confidence interval estimation, hypothesis testing, and simple linear regression.

briefs.tags: 機率論, 隨機變數, 期望值, 常見分配, 抽樣分配, 極限分配, 統計推論, Probability Theory, Random Variable, Expected Value, Common Distributions, Limiting Distributions, Statistical Inference
briefs.desc: This course concentrates on theoretical statistics using the first principles of probability theory. Our aim is to introduce many fundamentals and lay a solid foundation for students to explore various areas such as data science, quantitative finance, statis- tical signal processing, machine learning, financial mathematics, and econometrics in the future. Many of the results will be delivered in a definition-theorem-proof manner. The prerequisite is one year of calculus. To succeed in this course, some mathematical maturity is expected.

briefs.name: 數理統計一
briefs.tags: 數理統計(mathematical statistics), 機率(probability), 母體(population), 統計推論(inference), 資料(data)
briefs.desc: This is an advanced undergraduate level course which emphasizes the laws of probability needed for making proper inference from data. The objectives of this course are threefold: 1. To be acquainted with the theoretical background of statistical models as a set of suitable probability distributions. 2. To understand the core concepts and fundamental principles of statistical inference. 3. To prepare students with a solid foundation in statistical theory in solving practical problems in the real world.

briefs.name: 衍生性金融市場
briefs.tags: 金融體系、基本金融商品的價格、遠期契約、期貨、利率期限結構
briefs.desc: 本課程的目標是訓練學生未來能在金融工程領域 (金融商品設計，投資銀行業務與資本市場操作，衍生性金融商品投信與投顧，市場、信用、與流動性風險管理，資產價格建模與應用) 就業， 本課程因而極為計算導向 (也因此與其他衍生性金融商品相關課程有很大的差異) 。 整年課程的教程中有超過千條的數學式， 學生必須很快的適應並學會從數學式的推導與演算中獲得金融直覺， 之前沒有一年以上的微積分以及一年以上的統計學準備的同學不太可能跟得上本課程的進度。

briefs.name: 衍生性金融市場
briefs.tags: 期貨 Futures, 避險 Hedging, 利率 Interest rate, 交換 Swaps, 選擇權 Options
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹多項衍生性金融商品之基本結構、交易規範與間斷時間下之訂價原理。內容涵蓋:期貨市場交易、期貨避險、期貨 及遠期合約評價、利率交換、選擇權市場交易、選擇權交易策略，以及選擇權評價之二元樹模型。

briefs.name: 高等微積分二
briefs.tags: 收斂，測距空間，微分，積分，基本定理。Convergence, metric space, differentiation, integration, fundamental theorem.
briefs.desc: 本課程為計財系高等微積分㇐學年課程的下半部分. 主要內容包括㇐些拓樸學基本的概念如開閉集、緊緻集、連通集及連續函數 等的重要性質，以及微積分中多變函數的理論。這門課是許多領域的重要基礎，在工程和金融等方面都有廣泛的應用.

briefs.name: 財務計量經濟學
briefs.tags: Financial Econometrics, Regression Analysis
briefs.desc: This is a course for quantitative method. The materials in this course are arranged according to the estimation methods: least squares method, quasi-maximum or likelihood method. In addition, we will talk about the techniques of text mining. Each chapter will concentrate on a particular estimating method which includes various financial models as examples and exercises. I hope at the end of this semester you will find my efforts are indeed effective. Note that we will NOT have the time to review basic mathematical and statistical concepts in this course. Thus, students who are not familiar with these mathematical tools (e.g., linear algebra, measure theories) are encouraged to read related textbooks and lecture notes on these topics.

briefs.name: 財務決策分析(磨課師)
briefs.tags: 財務分析、公司理財、企業價值、財務風險、財務議題
briefs.desc: 這門課程以淺入深的方式，從基本的財務報表和比率分析開始，逐漸深入公司內部治理和投資決策。學生不僅可以學習實用的財務知識，還 可以了解當前的金融話題，增強他們對金融議題的敏感度。課程還深入剖析公司內部治理和投資決策，讓學生能夠了解公司內部運作的細 節，並瞭解投資決策的重要性。這些知識對學生未來的職業發展非常有益。

briefs.name: 投資實務研討(磨課師)
briefs.tags: 投資學Investments，投資組合Portfolio，股票Stocks，債券Bonds，報酬Return，風險Risk
briefs.desc: 為學生建構正確的投資觀念，有系統的講解金融市場的運作，進而使其有信心地進入投資的世界。教學影片講解清晰，化繁為 簡，並援引生活實例增近學生對於教材的理解及加深對於理論的印象。利用免費平台模擬股市操作，引領學生嘗試接觸投資實 務，將可大大強化其財富智商(MQ)，是每位學生必備的個人理財指引。

briefs.name: 總體金融學
briefs.tags: macroeconomics, financial sectors, crisis, safe assets, inequality
briefs.desc: Macro-Finance is an emerging field after the 2007-08 Great Financial Crisis. Traditional macroeconomic analysis, both the classical and the Keynesian schools, has ignored the role of the financial system in channeling resources across the economy, leading to failure in foreseeing and understanding financial crises and modern global economic issues. The subject bridges the gap between the macroeconomy (GDP, employment, consumption, etc.) and the financial sector (asset prices, credit supply, etc.). It takes the view that financial activity is at the heart of economic fluctuations, and not only during times of severe crisis. The purpose of this course is to understand the two-way interactions between the real economy and the financial sector by digging into the following mechanisms. 1. Amplification and financial acceleration: shocks arising in the real economy can propagate through financial markets and amplify business cycles. 2. Bank runs: banks can be the so

briefs.name: 影響力投資基金管理
briefs.tags: 影響力投資 (Impact Study)、基金(Investing Fund)、創投(Venture Capital)
briefs.desc: 本課程的目標在於培養學生具備： 1. 雙底線：影響力投資的核心思維及能力，並重社會效益＆投資利潤，以建構自己的職涯優勢，同時貢獻社會的永續需求。 2. 跨領域：不同領域同學合組投資團隊，提升跨領域交流與合作的能力。 3. 投資理論與實踐：學生透過課堂學習及實際參訪，將投資及影響力理論，直接應用在投資篩選，調研，議價及報告。最終入選 項目將獲 得實際投資。

briefs.name: 投資學
briefs.tags: 貨幣市場Money markets, 資本市場Capital markets, 共同基金Mutual Funds, 投資組合Portfolio, 資本資產訂價模型CAPM
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹國內外投資環境、可使用的投資工具，以及重要的投資理論。教學內容涵蓋貨幣市場交易、債券市場交易、股票 市場交易、基金與ETF投資。將仔細講解投資組合管理相關理論、資本資產訂價理論、套利訂價理論。最後以股市交易之基本 分析與 技術分析作結。

briefs.name: 投資學
briefs.tags: 金融市場 / Financial Markets, 投資 / Investment, 股票 / Equity, 資產配置 / Asset Allocation, 資本資產訂價模型 / CAPM
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養學生對投資理論與實務的全面理解，使其具備評估與管理投資組合的能力。透過理論講解與實務案例分析，學 生 將學習資產配置、投資評價、風險管理及市場趨勢分析等核心概念，以提升其在金融市場中的決策能力。

briefs.name: 財富管理實務
briefs.tags: 財富管理、理財商品
briefs.desc: 以互動溝通和多元學習方式，幫助學生瞭解財富管理各個實務面向，包括理財商品、金融機構、客戶、及市場 運作等，以期培養 學生具備以下財富管理能力。【前瞻力】闡述金融機構財富管理歷史演進與現 今概況，進而前瞻未來做好準備。 【職場力】探討 組織職務分工與實務運作方式，具備從業人員核心能力與正確心態。 【商品力】瞭解理財商品企劃操作模式與上架銷售流程、客 戶服務與客訴處理心法。 【應變力】透析在多變詭譎環境下如何觀察金融趨勢演變，穩定開創個人與社會財富。

briefs.name: 金融交易實務
briefs.tags: 金融交易,Derivative Trading
briefs.desc: 透過與元大金控產學合作，援引其證券、銀行、期貨及投信等完整的金融業務資源，邀請元大金控主管擔任金融業師，系統性地 介紹國內外金融市場之有價證券、固定收益商品、外匯認購權證等商品現況與交易實務，並介紹國內外衍生性金融之研發、避險 交易及風管理等金融實務與案例，幫助學生提前了解概況， 以協助學生確立其金融專業領域、接軌未來的職涯發展。

briefs.name: 隱型冠軍經營實務與案例研討
briefs.nameEn: Hidden Champion Practice – A Case Study Approach
briefs.tags: 隱型冠軍、策略
briefs.desc: 介紹隱型冠軍的基礎理論，說明隱形冠軍的定義，研究方法論，並介紹一些有名的隱型冠軍公司。

briefs.name: 無形資產評價與分析
briefs.tags: intangibles, patents, trademarks, R&D, valuation
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of intangible assets, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, goodwill, brand value, and proprietary technology. Students will learn various valuation methodologies, regulatory frameworks, and real-world applications of intangible asset evaluation in corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, and financial reporting. As part of the course, students will conduct a real-world case project on intangible asset valuation, applying theoretical concepts to analyze and assess the value of intangible assets in a practical business context.

briefs.name: 財務計量經濟學
briefs.tags: Financial Econometrics, Regression Analysis
briefs.desc: This is the required M.A. course for quantitative method. The materials in this course are arranged according to the estimation methods: least squares method, quasi-maximum likelihood method, and bayesian analysis. Each chapter will concentrate on a particular estimating method which includes various financial models as examples and exercises. I hope at the end of this semester you will find my efforts are indeed effective. Note that we will NOT have the time to review basic mathematical and statistical concepts in this course. Thus, students who are not familiar with these mathematical tools (e.g., linear algebra, measure theories) are encouraged to read related textbooks and lecture notes on these topics

briefs.name: 隨機財務理論
briefs.tags: 隨機過程、衍生性金融商品的價格、連續時間的利率模型、風險中立價格、歐式選擇權的 Black-Scholes 價格
briefs.desc: 本課程的內容包括 一、隨機過程的基本理論： 布朗運動、隨機微分方程式、伊藤定理、對數常態的資產價格、平賭過程、機率測度的轉換、 二、衍生性金融商品的價格： 無套利原則與風險的市場價格、風險中立機率測度、無套利原則與風險中立價格、歐式選擇權的 Black-Scholes 價格、歐式選擇權的隱含波動率、非對數常態的資產價格、利率衍生性金融商品的遠期中立價格、資產價格二元樹與三元樹、衍生性金融商品價格的模擬 三、連續時間的利率模型： 遠期瞬間利率、瞬時利率、仿射模型與常態仿射模型、利率的均衡模型： Vasicek 模型與 CIR 模型、 利率的無套利模型： Ho and Lee 模型與 Hull and White 模型、遠期利率模型： HJM 模型與 LMM 模型、 多因子利率模型： Hull and White 二因子模型與隨機波動模型、利率二元樹與三元樹

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 財務Finance, 經濟Economics, 不動產Real estate, 保險Insurance, 銀行Banking, 財務工程Financial Engineering, 機器學習Machine Learning
briefs.desc: 本課程的設置有兩個目的: 1. 邀請各領域的學者、專家分享其最新的研究成果。 2. 為學生提供一個討論新知識的平台。 This course has two purposes: 1. Invite scholars and experts from various fields to share their recent research findings. 2. Provide a platform for students to discuss new knowledge

briefs.name: 金融計算
briefs.tags: 金融衍生品，定價，避險，投組優化，深度學習，financial derivatives, pricing, hedging, portfolio optimization, deep learning
briefs.desc: 課程說明： 計算金融可視為現代金融理論的主要實踐方法，它針對不同的應用問題發展出特定的演算法，其中有些屬於古典，有些則具研發的性質。本課 程兼具金融研究與實務，介紹並定義相關的計算金融問題，探討適當的數值方法（含AI/ML, GPU, Quantum等），再輔以實際財經資料加以驗 證數學模型。 課程主軸包括 金融工程 (FE, Financial Engineering) 金融科技 (FT, Financial Technology) 去中心化金融 (DeFi, Decentralized Finance) 量子金融 (Quantum Finance) 初探;相關的數值演算法將會加以介紹。

briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis

briefs.name: 公司理財專題
briefs.tags: 公司財務決策,Financial strategy, 公司治理,Corporate governance, 資本結構, Capital structure, 資本預算, capital budgeting, 股利政策, dividend policy
briefs.desc: This course contains some selected topics of corporate finance. We will go through the topics of valuation, corporate financing and agency problem, corporate financing under asymmetric information, corporate governance and calculate in the construction of financial strategy. The detail of those topics will contain a little bit (I will adjust anytime depended on student’s response) financial theory and the application such as empirical evidence.

briefs.name: 數理金融
briefs.tags: Financial Mathematics, Discrete Time Financial Mathematics.
briefs.desc: This is the first course of four sequential courses: Financial Mathematics, Discrete Time Financial Mathematics, Stochastic Financial Theory, and Continuous-Time Financial Mathematics. The four courses are designed to provide the students with a solid background in financial engineering - a topic which becomes more and more important for financial analysts. Financial engineering discusses how to price (evaluate) and hedge (eliminate) risks associated with the uncertainties of asset prices such as stocks, interest rates, credits, energy, loans, insurance, etc.

briefs.name: 衍生性商品實證研究
briefs.tags: empirical studies; derivative market; options; futures; financial econometrics
briefs.desc: Students who are taking this course should have already taken courses of option and future markets (derivative markets) and financial econometrics. This course is an introduction to empirical researches of derivative markets, with focus on a particular topic. This course will focus on the implied information of option markets and introduce several important findings of this topic.

briefs.name: 財務計量實證專題
briefs.tags: 間斷時間-ARCH模型 ARCH models; 連續時間-隨機波動率模型stochastic volatility models; 風險中立機率密度估計 risk-neutral density estimations; 機率密度預測 density forecasting; 風險溢酬 risk premia
briefs.desc: 1. objectives (1) To illustrate how econometric analysis can be applied to learn about the price behavior of financial assets, from the historical asset prices and from the prices of derivatives securities. (2) To provide learners with practical experience of analyzing market prices. 2. Learning outcomes After completing the course, students could: (1) Understand the important features of time series of market prices, (2) Be familiar with appropriate methods for modeling and forecasting prices and volatility, (3) Be able to use option prices to make statements about the distributions of future asset prices, (4) Have acquired experience of applying computational methods, Excel, Matlab, RATS, …etc to market data. (5) Understand the triangular relationships among the risk-neutral density, the real-world density and scaled marginal utility.

briefs.name: 不動產專題研究一
briefs.tags: 不動產real estate, 住宅市場housing market, 住房泡沬housing bubbles, 租屋市場分析rental market analysis, 交易者行為trading behavior
briefs.desc: 本課程探討不動產之相關研究，以當前不動產學術界所關注的焦點議題為其研究討論背景，透過國內外相關的已發表的學術論 文，進一步型碩未來碩博士生的研究方向。 本課程由淺入深，以研究議題為導向的介紹，輔以實證研究方法的教學，帶領學生 由基礎的不動產資料整理開始，進而量化分析不動產市場中的交易者行為、市場限制及特性、政府政策效果等議題。學生透過本 課程將學習，如何連結在財金和計量相關的知識，延伸及應用於不動產的議題研究。

briefs.name: 金融隨機控制專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Stochastic Control in Finance
briefs.tags: 隨機系統, 隨機過程, 隨機控制, 最佳控制, 最佳化, 量化金融, 財務工程, Stochastic Systems, Stochastic Processes, Stochastic Control, Optimization, Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering,
briefs.desc: This course introduces stochastic control theory with applications in finance. The focus is on modeling financial decision-making under uncertainty using stochastic differential equations (SDEs), dynamic programming, and optimal control methods. This course is designed for graduate students in quantitative finance, control theory, and management science. Strong background in probability, (advanced) mathematical analysis, and optimization theory is recommended. Emphasizing a mathematically rigorous approach, key results will be presented in a definition-theorem-proof format. Strong mathematics maturity is needed.

briefs.name: 醫療法律與研究倫理
briefs.tags: 醫藥法規Medical regulations, 研究倫理Research ethics, 生物資料庫Biobank , 細胞治療gene therapy, 智慧醫療Intelligent Healthcare
briefs.desc: 近年來，生醫電資的跨學科研究領域的快速發展，帶動了生技產業的多樣挑戰，其中不論在分子藥物的開發、細胞治療的臨床應用、創新 醫材與前沿穿戴式裝置的普及化，無不帶給傳統法規科學領域巨大的挑戰。簡言之，隨多樣醫藥及商技產品或醫療方法的推出，面對持續 發展中的創新生醫領域，嶄新的醫藥生態，帶給官方、產業及學研界全新的課題。然而，就在整的醫藥界與政府全力投入這些發展之際， 上自學研機構的研究與學術倫理偏差個案，下至主管機關面對的藥證核給或細胞治療得納管爭議，乃至新近攸關整體產業發展的生物資料 庫管理與病歷資料之合憲利用，以及疫苗研發的管制密度等問題，無不嚴重影響我國所追求的生醫產業遠景。準此，本課程之設計將以生 醫研究倫理及醫藥法規為基礎，涵蓋當前主要問題，邀請相關領域的專家，參與主題式的教學，期望能為學員奠定或強化因應當前生醫研 發與創新醫藥、醫材或生醫服務所需之法制基礎。

briefs.name: 藥品法規科學專題研究
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Pharmaceutical Regulatory Science
briefs.tags: 藥品、法規、臨床試驗、藥品開發、藥品批准流程。 Pharmaceuticals, Regulatory Science, Clinical Trial, Drug Administration, Drug Development, Drug Approval Process.
briefs.desc: 新藥研發法律法規：研究新藥開發過程中的法律法規，包括臨床試驗規定、新藥上市許可等。 藥品生產管理法律法規：研究藥品生產過程中的法律法規，包括藥品生產質量管理、藥品製造許可等。 藥品安全監管法律法規：研究藥品安全監管的法律法規，包括藥品不良反應監測、藥品安全風險評估等。 藥品銷售管理法律法規：研究藥品銷售管理的法律法規，包括藥品廣告宣傳、藥品經銷商管理等。 藥品知識產權法律法規：研究藥品知識產權的法律法規，包括藥品專利保護、藥品仿製產品等。 藥物化學和藥物分析：研究藥物的化學結構和分析方法，以及藥物的質量控制。 臨床試驗設計和統計：研究臨床試驗的設計和統計方法，以確保臨床試驗的科學性和可靠性。 藥品法規科學與公共衛生：研究藥品法規科學與公共衛生之間的關係，以促進藥品安全和公共衛生的發展。

briefs.name: 醫材法規科學專題研究
briefs.nameEn: Practice and Research of Regulatory Science for Medical Devices
briefs.tags: 醫療器材Medical Device, 設計管控 Design Control, 法規策略 Regulatory Strategy, 品質系統 Quality System, 風險分析 Risk Analysis
briefs.desc: 本課程由產業實務經驗觀點出發，介紹醫療器材從研究設計、產品開發、測試驗證、到上市申請及上市後監控之完整開發流程， 配合實際產品上市申請案例說明及課題練習，建立學生對於醫療器材法規與實務基礎。

briefs.name: 前瞻醫藥、醫材法規科學專題研究
briefs.nameEn: Prospective research on the scientific research of medicine and medical materials
briefs.tags: 台灣生技醫療產業Taiwan's biotechnology medical industry,細胞治療Cell therapy,藥品與醫療器材之法規科學Regulatory science of drug and medical device,解決問題之技巧Solvent problems skill,產業模式Business mode.
briefs.desc: 1.先介紹了解世界生技業如何積極發展之現況，而後分享經驗使知道台灣生技業地位及未來趨勢，進一步探討台灣細胞生技產業機會 在哪?進而尋找台灣細胞生技產業商機在哪? 並介紹台灣藥品、再生醫療製劑與醫療器材之法規科學，最後分享如何建立台灣優勢及使 學員知道如何扮演積極角色。 2.分組選定主題就主題進行法規及實務探討 3.分組深入剖析各產業相關實務問題，以5W2H2E、FOCUS、SMART等方法學進行實作學習解決問題能力 4.團隊合作及分組報告研究過程、最終成效及有效分享

briefs.name: 書報討論一
briefs.tags: 法規科學(Regulatory Science), 藥物開發(Drug Development), 人體臨床試驗(Human Clinical Trials), 產品查驗登記(Product Registration/Market Authorization), 醫藥產品全球化(Medicinal Product Globalization)
briefs.desc: This course will guide the student to apply the regulatory knowledge that they have learned to investigate the leading innovative drugs and medical devices to treat major diseases. Students will have an oral presentation of their comprehension and insight.

briefs.name: 精準醫療
briefs.tags: 精準醫療Precision medicine,精準健康Precision health,生物資料庫Biobank,標靶治療Target therapy, 智慧醫療eHealth
briefs.desc: 精準醫療的目標為促進使用基因資訊發展精準醫療,並逐步發展健康管理的最佳策略。有別於過往單一疾病基因研究需要招募特 定的疾病參與者與健康對照者，有了足量的常見疾病人數以及沒有此疾病的人數，便可高效同時發展多種疾病的風險評估演算 法。說明及探討唯一華人世代追蹤、垂直整合檢體與資料釋出的台灣生物資料庫。

briefs.name: 醫材產業創業暨商品化實務
briefs.nameEn: The entrepreneurship and commercialization practices in the medical device industry.
briefs.tags: 醫療器材Medical Device、創新創業Innovation and Entrepreneurship、商品化Commercialization、商業模式Business Model、策略規劃 Strategy Planning
briefs.desc: 全球人口高齡化持續發酵下，生醫產業成為各國重點推動方向之一，其中更醫療器材產業市場成長潛力最為快速。然醫療器材產業少 量多樣的特性，考量以市場為導向的商品化流程成為後續能否有效進入市場與販售的重要關鍵。本課程將以產業實務經驗觀點出發， 介紹與探討醫療器材從選題、臨床/市場評估、產品研發、測試驗證、法規申請、行銷策略布局、募資規劃以及新創公司營運等商品化 之各項關鍵要點，建立學生對於醫材創新創業暨商品化過程的完整認知與實務知識。

briefs.name: 論文閱讀與寫作方法
briefs.tags: 論文寫作、研究方法介紹、理論實操、資料運用、閱讀
briefs.desc: 主要透過介紹各種研究方法與閱讀paper等方式，教授學生如何撰寫碩士論文，此外也透過解析論文段落各項練習讓學生深入了解論 文撰寫，創造具說服力、有觀點論述的有力論述，以培養後續書寫學位論文的整體能力。

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 論文寫作, 文獻回顧, 華文文學, 議題研討
briefs.desc: 「研究方法」這門課，希望能夠帶領學生認識華文文學研究現況、入門相關研究方法、熟悉文獻資料，並引領寫作論文的實際過程，祈使學生順利開展研 究生涯。課堂實作內容，包括研究發想、轉譯書寫、文獻回顧、研究計畫發表，由小組到個人，希望能夠循序漸進，引導學生先根據作品／文獻，有組織 地書寫相關主題，再進入研究計畫的規範架構之中，展現思考問題與鋪敘論述的能力。

briefs.name: 小說創作專題
briefs.tags: 小說創作、文本細讀、敘事觀點、人物塑造、Seminar on Fiction Writing
briefs.desc: 本課程分為兩部分，第一部分將以主題單元的方式進行，藉由閱讀小說文本，結合學生的生命經驗，演練說故事的技巧，我們 將在課程中以小說為例，分析如何說故事？以及如何說一個好故事？並於課程中思考數位時代裡，透過好故事與他人溝通的方 法，進而觸動人心，改變他人對事物的觀點。在故事力已成為顯學的時代，我們將藉由「我是誰？」「我在何處？」「我想要 什麼？」「我在此處能做些什麼？」等等問題，從自身的生活歷程出發尋找創意能量，打造專屬於自己風格的故事。第二部分 則閱讀關於小說研究的相關論文，透過前行研究者學術論文的分析，深化學生對於小說文體的理解。

briefs.name: 自傳與回憶書寫專題
briefs.nameEn: A Study of Contemporary Memoir Writing
briefs.tags: 自傳(Autobiography)、回憶錄(Memoirs)、回憶詩學( Reminiscence Poetics )、尋找自我(Finding Oneself,)、生命史(Life History) 、創傷書寫(Trauma Writing)、身份建構(Identity Construction)
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在引導學生探索自傳與回憶錄書寫的多重意義與美學形式，透過理論閱讀、經典文本導讀、當代表現探討與實作創 作，讓學生理解自傳書寫不僅是個體經驗的記錄，更是時代與社會記憶的承載與再現。課程從古今中外的自傳經典出發，結合 「記憶詩學」、「敘事認同」、「創傷理論」等觀點，引導學生思考回憶如何構成個體自我、如何與歷史交織並參與公共記憶。 課程亦設有創作指導與同儕互評環節，協助學生練習自我敘述、感官記憶與創作修訂。最終期許每位學生完成一篇具備深度與風 格的個人回憶作品，或針對某部自傳文本進行深入評論。

briefs.name: 華文文學專題：馬來西亞
briefs.tags: 馬華文學,馬來西亞,東南亞,華人,華文,Chinese Malaysian Literature,Malaysia,Southeast Asia,Chinese
briefs.desc: 本課程以馬來西亞華文文學為探討核心，結合「移民」、「本土」、「族群」、「多元」等關鍵詞，每週選讀代表性作家與經典文本，引領 學生認識馬華文學的主題風貌與歷史脈絡，並透過台馬文學的比較與對話，深化對華文文學多樣面貌的理解。

briefs.name: 東亞僧傳文學專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics in East Asian Buddhist Biographical Literature
briefs.tags: 佛教傳記Buddhism Biography, 高僧傳Biographies of Eminent Monks, 續高僧傳Continued Biography of Eminent Monks, 宋高僧傳Song Biographies of Eminent Monks, 大明高僧傳Ming Biographies of Eminent Monks, 名僧傳抄Ming Seng Chuan Chao, 海東高僧傳Korean Biographies of Eminent Monks, 元亨釋書Genk!3; Shakusho, 比丘尼傳Biographies of Bhikkhuni, 高僧傳記類型與結構Typologies and Structures of Buddhist Biogra
briefs.desc: 本課程以「東亞僧傳文學」為主題，聚焦佛教僧侶傳記於中國的發展與書寫實踐，旨在從文體、敘事、宗教功能等多元角度，系 統性解析東亞僧傳的類型、體例與文化意涵，引導學生掌握其與史傳文學的互文關係與區辨特質。課程首先分析總傳、類傳、別 傳等不同僧傳類型，辨識其立傳目的、入傳標準與敘事風貌，並從史傳與僧傳的文類比較出發，探討僧傳如何延續與改造正史紀 傳體，建構其宗教敘事特徵。其次則專就《高僧傳》加以選讀，透過實際研讀，強化文本分析能力，具體掌握《高僧傳》的文獻 特質與敘事特點。課程內亦將引介敘事學與數位人文方法，發展新視角觀察僧傳文本，提供新方法的創新應用。

briefs.name: 台灣社會與語言變遷專題
briefs.nameEn: Changes of Taiwan Society and Language
briefs.tags: 台灣,台灣南島語,台語,客語,台灣華語,Taiwan, Taiwan Austronesian languages,Taiwanese Hokkien, Hakka, Taiwan Mandarin,
briefs.desc: 本課程帶領同學認識台灣社會與語言變遷的實況，探究台灣社會與語言變遷的趨勢及成因。 讓同學對於台灣各族群語言在社會中使用的諸多現象及爭議，有深入的瞭解及思考。本課 程將著重於以下這些議題，如台灣社會高低階語言的現象，剖析生活中的語言現象，例如 思考現今雙語政策的問題，了解台灣南島語、台語、客語及華語的現況及 變遷，並思考語言政策對台灣語言的影響，探究語言轉移及語言死亡等議題。

briefs.desc: To enhance the learning experiences as a student, students are expected to attend and participate in the school's Weekly Seminar Series. These seminars feature the latest cutting edge research and can expend their research interests.

briefs.tags: graph theory, networks, text mining, AI, data mining
briefs.desc: Outline: The objective of this course is to assist students to understand the major concepts involved in social network analysis. Through lectures and lab assignments, students can obtain the ability to conduct research studies related to social networks. The subjects in this course are divided into the following themes: 1. Graph analysis: community detection, and graph embedding 2. Social network analysis: link prediction and privacy in social networks 3. User profiling and recommendation systems in social networks 4. Text mining and analysis in social networks

briefs.name: 人智計算
briefs.tags: Multimedia, music, deep learning, image processing 多媒體,音樂,深度學習,影像處理
briefs.desc: For Human-Centered Computing, not only multimedia contents are included, but also social comments, social links, and social interactions are considered, so that the result of analysis will be more accurate and meet the requirements more precisely. Multimedia data is linked widely in multiple dimensions, so the topic of privacy has been concerned over the recent years. The analysis and search of music content also become a new rising research area in recent years. Many innovative research issues such as music classifications, recommendations, and watermarks are all very important.

briefs.name: 民族誌：經典與實作
briefs.tags: 田野工作、參與觀察、方法論、研究倫理
briefs.desc: 這門課程希望帶領同學一起來解讀、分析和評論民族誌的經典，也期望你能夠從中學習田野實作的邏輯來進行你感興趣的田野。 這門課程主要分成兩個層次：第一、研讀在不同田野場域所寫就的民族誌經典，包括：原住民部落、社區、工廠、學校、機構、 家庭……等場域。第二、評述當代或台灣的民族誌研究，講授民族誌的技法和實作邏輯。尤其是後者，期待同學有自己的田野來進 行參與觀察、訪談或實作，據以相互參照，彼此激盪和成長。

briefs.name: 政治社會學
briefs.tags: 政治社會學、權力、文化、political sociology, power, culture
briefs.desc: 政治社會學的核心是從社會學的角度探討社會(政治)秩序的形成、維持與改變，相較於政治學，儘管兩者在研究對象與旨趣 上有著某些的重疊，整體來說，政治社會學把「政治」想像得更寬廣、更為變動與更為人為：政治學的研究對象為正式制度， 政治社會學則擴及到非正式的場域；政治學關注正式制度本身，政治社會學則關心正式制度與社會因素的關係；政治學習慣採 取量化與形式(formal)的研究取徑，政治社會學則有更多敘事(narrative)與比較的分析；最後，政治學多採取客觀的立 場，了解正式制度的運行，政治社會學則帶有規範性(normative)的意味，對於各種政治制度採取批判的態度。 根據以上的說明，我們不難理解政治社會學的範圍廣泛，包含各種不同的理論觀點與研究主題，因此我們不可能在這門課中包 山包海地涵蓋所有的理論觀點與研究主題。換言之，這門課的目的在於讓大家對於政治社會學有著基本的認識，我用以下幾個 主題來組織這麼課程。首先，我們將討論權力(power)，權力是政治社會學的核心概念，我們將討論什麼是權力、權力的類型 與權力的運作。接著，我們把焦點轉向三個政治社會學的古典研究取徑：Karl Marx的經濟取徑、Max Weber的組織與菁英取 徑以及Alexis

briefs.name: 社區田野調查與地方誌書寫
briefs.nameEn: Community Fieldwork and Ethnography Writing: Practicum
briefs.tags: 麥寮、六輕、社區研究、田野工作、地方誌
briefs.desc: 這是一門結合社區田野調查及地方誌書寫的實作課程，目的在訓練以下三種能力：1.如何規劃和進行社區田野調查；2.如何整 理及分析田野調查所得資料；3.如何將田野調查所得書寫成報導和論文。雲林縣麥寮鄉為本課程的研究地區。

briefs.name: 土地的文化政治
briefs.tags: 民族國家nation-state、地方社會local society、民主化democratization、文化運動cultural movement、社區community、地方locality
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在探討以土地為核心概念所進行的文化行動及其政治效果。我們將考察二十世紀發生在臺灣的文化運動及政策，探討 「土地」如何在不同的社會脈絡下產生及轉化。

briefs.name: 專業社會學
briefs.tags: 專業社會學Sociology of Professions, 專業Professions, 專業系統System of Professions, 管轄權Jurisdiction, 自我管制之專業Self-Regulating Professions
briefs.desc: 本課程希望介紹「專業社會學」（sociology of the professions）這個次領域，將重心放在1980年代後的多元發展。其 中，以Andrew Abbott（1988）的System of Professions被認為是一個既推進又解構了此前之「專業社會學」的關鍵分水 嶺。依此，專業社會學在1990年代開始，可被視為處於一種Post-Abbott狀態。針對這樣的狀況，本課程分為四個部分來講 授：1.第一至三週，課程簡介與回顧台灣社會學界對於「專業」的研究狀況、2.第四至六週，共同閱讀Abbott的經典著作、 3.第九至十二週，介紹修正Abbott的四種延伸取徑（鍵結、網絡、劃界）、4.第十三至十五週，以歐美社會為主的幾個研究 論題（制衡權力、再階層化、新韋伯論）來看待近年重新浮現的跨國比較視野。此外，搭配課程內容的進行，修課學生也將 在本課程練習一個小型獨立研究，分別以期中、期末報告兩階段完成。同時，我們也安排兩種實作練習，分別以次級資料 （立法資料/新聞報導）、初級資料（新竹地院法庭觀察）為對象。

briefs.name: 制度分析
briefs.tags: 制度、制度化、制度變遷、場域、資本主義多樣性
briefs.desc: 制度，是社會生活賴以建立的基礎。制度通常是由正式與非正式規則、監督與執行機制，和意義體系三者所構成。在這套架 構下，它形成個人、公司、協會、政府等組織的互動基礎。缺乏制度，社會生活將變得失序、艱難。 制度分析是當前社會科學最有活力的研究領域之一，由經濟學、政治學、社會這三門學科共同奠定其理論發展基礎。制度論 者關心制度如何形成、維繫，制度變遷的路徑選擇與因果機制，以及制度對人類生活帶來的可能影響。更具體來說，行動者 是處在多重制度脈絡下，透過目的性的行動，彈性詮釋形式化的制度規則，進而創造、維繫、改變制度結構。亦即，制度安 排通常是行動者鬥爭、議價與協商過程的產物，並且反映出資源分配的差異。制度一旦形成，也會反過來影響行動者如何認 知世界，並且規範衝突，促成社會穩定。 本課程將先從介紹制度分析的定義、邏輯與研究架構出發，進而探討新制度經濟學、組織新制度論（社會學）和歷史制度論 （政治學）這三種作為制度分析理論起源的觀點，解釋彼此之間的差異以及共同面臨的挑戰。課程第三部分將焦點放在制度 建構與制度變遷的動態過程，特別著重在釐清制度變遷的因果機制。第四部份則結合理論與經驗研究，從歷史比

briefs.name: (後)殖民科技與醫療
briefs.tags: 科學，技術與醫療；殖民主義；東亞
briefs.desc: 在這門開給研究所學生的課程中，我們將探討自十九世紀開始的一些重要科技與醫療過程，其中尤其重要的是，殖民帝國的存續與崩解以及前殖 民地社會在二次戰後的社會發展如何形塑科學知識與技術的演變。自十九世紀以來歐洲權力開始往非洲與亞洲擴展，自然及人文科學都發生了爆 炸性的發展。雖然並不是所有的科學知識與技術都與殖民主義有直接的關聯，但是這一波科學發展與殖民主義共享了一種積極向外探索與獲取的 世界觀。理解了這樣的歷史脈絡之後，我們將深入討論下列幾個相互關聯的主題：（一）後殖民科技與醫療的發展及其對西方典範的挑戰； （二）女性主義的科技與社會理解框架；（三）科學實作下的核心與邊緣；（四）科學、技術與醫療如何被用作一種統治工具。

briefs.name: 醫療社會學
briefs.tags: 健康、病痛、疾病、醫療、照護
briefs.desc: 醫療社會學致力於以社會（科）學的視角，來認識健康、病痛、疾病、醫療、醫學與照護。不同於將健康與病痛化約為生物學的 觀點，也不同於將健康實作和醫療視為存在於社會真空之中，醫療社會學（部分結合科技與社會的觀點）視健康、病痛、疾病、 醫療與照護為特定社會文化、政治經濟、科學技術與物質環境的產物，但也形塑著社會秩序、行動和主體。

briefs.name: 中國研究導論
briefs.tags: 中國研究（China Studies）, 工作坊（Workshop）, 演講（Lecture）, 摘要（abstract）, 通訊（Newsletter）
briefs.desc: 本課程是清華大學與中央研究院合作設立之「中國研究學程」（社會所乙組）的碩士班必修導論課。清華中國 研究學程的特色之一，在於兼重「系統的社會科學方法」及「敏銳的田野觸覺」，以拓展「當代中國研究」的 想像與視野。基於這個思路，本課程透過相關主題的歷史脈絡、重要文獻、實踐經驗和時事觀察，結合《中國 研究工作坊》、《當代中國研究通訊》的研討活動，以及不定期移地學習的參與實作，引導同學在系統的社會 科學知識基礎上「浸入」當代中國在境內及全球的特定群體或議題場域，理解行動現象及其脈絡意義，從而尋 覓、選擇並深入「與自身經驗有所共鳴」的研究主題。 課程內容將分為四個相應重心：（一）代表性學術著作導讀、研討；（二）重要民族志、口述史、回憶錄和歷 史文件的閱讀；（三）田野研究技藝的臨摹，包括訪談記錄、紀要及心得整理；（四）當前中國社會、政治議 題及影響力的追蹤、觀察、解讀，並逐漸養成日常興趣、習慣；（五）鼓勵同學參與各種交換、實習、發表與 訪問等活動場合，與海內外不同背景經歷的相關學者、學生、人員往來，相互認識，彼此理解。

briefs.name: 中國研究工作坊
briefs.tags: 中國研究（China Studies）, 工作坊（Workshop）, 演講（Lecture）, 摘要（abstract）, 通訊（Newsletter）
briefs.desc: 「中國研究工作坊」為清華社會所碩士班乙組一、二年級必修（零學分）課程。我們邀請當代中國研究相關領域學 者、專業人士，前來分享思路視角、研究成果及實踐經驗。針對特定領域或議題，進行深入分析與問答討論，拓展視 野，補充滋養正式課程。修課同學需要每次出席，積極提問，參與討論，輪流撰寫演講摘要，並呈現為學術紀要，刊 載於《當代中國研究通訊》。

briefs.name: 國際經濟與國家安全
briefs.tags: 貿易與自給自足（trade and autarky）、保護主義（protectionism）、重商主義（Mercantilism）、美元的角色（role of dollar）、經濟互賴（economic interdependence）、地緣經濟（geoeconomics）、經濟安全（economic security）、戰爭與和平（war and peace）
briefs.desc: 簡介：當前的時代精神（Zeitgeist）涵蓋數位（技術）、民粹（政治）和不安（經濟）等三大特色。川普2.0更已劇烈改變全球 經貿秩序和多邊合作體制，而主流（傳統）經濟學更受到嚴厲挑戰。 本堂課旨在透過課程設計，提昇學生對全球重大經貿議題和財經新聞的理解與判斷能力，特別側重「經濟與安全」這兩大知識領域 的連結。

briefs.name: 當代中國國家與宗教關係
briefs.nameEn: State and religion in contemporary China
briefs.tags: 中國研究, 國家與宗教關係, 宗教社會學, 宗教變遷, China Studies, Religion–State Relations, Religious Changes in China
briefs.desc: 本課討論當代中國的國家與宗教關係。由於關心現代國家與宗教的互動，本課的學術讀物範疇並不涵蓋各類宗教哲學與神學論文，也無法含 括中國宗教性（religiosities）的歷史多元。本課討論的範圍限縮在20世紀初、中共建政，以及改革開放宗教復甦這三個歷史時間點， 國家為何以及如何定位與治理複雜多元的宗教現象、以及國家與宗教之間的互動。選擇的讀物，在分析的取徑上，也多半不是採取「中共無 神論國家打壓宗教」這樣的二元分化式的架構，而更多去探究在特定的歷史時刻中國家治理性下對宗教的定位與形塑、制度化的過程與後 果、以及宗教實踐如何與國家發展出複雜的互動關係，這裡的互動關係當然包括壓制與抵抗，但還包括協力與合作。本課的讀物中，我們可 以看到國家的行動者涉及不同類型與不同層次，也可以看到不同類型的宗教，其中的多重行動者，以及跨越宗教範疇的實踐。透過這些實證 研究，希望引領學生熟悉一些重要的分析架構，探討當代中國國家與宗教的複雜關係。

briefs.name: 社會分析基本著作
briefs.tags: 社會學理論、社會基本分析、現代社會的形成、資本主義、社會文化
briefs.desc: 社會學理論」與「社會學方法論」一向是台灣的社會學研究所必修的兩門課。不論各自的內容為何，這兩門課是分別開授。這樣的設計，預設了所謂 的「理論」與所謂的「方法」是二分的。如果我們以類似的設計來教人騎腳踏車，就會有兩門課：「騎腳踏車的理論」與「騎腳踏車的方法論」。但 這樣是否能教會一個人騎腳踏車？可以嘗試的一個方向是將這兩門課結合在一起，然後重新設計出兩門課：「社會分析基本著作」與「研究實作」。 這門課的重點擺在前者。 這門課的基本精神是透過整本的具體著作，讓我們同時學習到： 如何對社會現象提問？ 如何建構（勾繪）社會現象？ 如何掌握人類社會的歷史進程？ 如何熟悉分析社會現象時必然碰到的課題與觀點？
